Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs) Citizenship and cultural awareness is enhanced as the learner teams up with peers to tell stories from their communities to teach etiquette. Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate the concept of politeness and etiquette in language to their learning English and Kiswahli languages

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.2 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 3.2.1 Reading Words and Sentences. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify words related to good manners in a written text, b) read words and sentences related to good manners, c) develop interest in reading words and simple sentences. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  identify courteous words in texts,  read words on flash cards related to good manners,  work collaboratively to build a vocabulary bank for words related to good manners,  compose simple sentences using the collection of words,  re-arrange jumbled words to make meaningful KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why should we use courtesy in communication? 2. How do we form sentences? sentences,  take turns to play reading games,  use digital devices to search for texts (stories, poems or songs) related to good manners, Core Competencies to be developed:  Learning to learn is enhanced as the learner works with peers to search and build a vocabulary bank for etiquette words  Critical thinking and problem solving is developed as the learner rearranges jumbled words to make meaningful sentences. Values:  Responsibility is developed as the learner observes integrity as they use digital devices to search for texts related to good manners.  Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates participation of peers as they take turns to play reading games. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Digital literacy is promoted as the learner is able to confidently and responsibly use digital devices to search for texts related to politeness and etiquette. Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate the concept of word and sentence formation to their learning of Kiswahili and Foreign Languages

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.3 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 3.3.1 Spelling. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) spell simple words related to good manners accurately, b) use simple words related to good manners to make simple sentences, c) enjoy writing texts accurately for communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  spell simple words related to theme,  practice joining dots to create words related to good manners,  copy courteous words neatly and legibly,  write words from a dictation,  play spelling games with peers,  work collaboratively with peers to form polite words from jumbled letters,  use the words formed to write simple sentences,  fill in missing words in sentences correctly. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is spelling important in writing? Core Competencies to be developed:  Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner works with peers to form polite words from jumbled letters.  Learning to learn is developed as the learner spells words correctly as they engage in a spelling game with peers. Values:  Respect is enhanced as the learner shows love and tolerance to ideas of their peers as they play spelling games.  Unity is achieved as the learner works collaboratively with peers to form polite words from jumbled letters. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs) Healthy inter and intra personal relations are enhanced as the learner engages peers as they play spelling games. Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to apply the concept of accurate spelling of words to their learning and use of Kiswahili language in communication.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.1 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 4.1.1 Songs. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify personal hygiene practices from songs for comprehension, b) pronounce words to describe parts of the body, c) develop interest in the use of songs to promote good personal hygiene practices. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  identify parts of the body mentioned in the song,  sing rhymes related to personal hygiene,  work jointly with peers to identify personal hygiene practices for different parts of the body (e.g. face, hands, legs, nose, hair, teeth),  listen to songs and rhymes on personal hygiene and sing along,  collaboratively use digital devices to record themselves as they sing songs and rhymes on personal hygiene,  work with peers to role play personal hygiene practices. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do songs help us in learning? 2. Why should we maintain good hygiene practice? Core Competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to use digital devices to record themselves as they sing songs and rhymes on personal hygiene.  Self-efficacy is developed as the learner works confidently with peers to role-play personal hygiene practices. Values:  Respect is enhanced as the learner teams up with peers and accommodates divergent ideas as they perform tasks such as singing and role-play.  Responsibility is developed as the learner uses digital devices carefully and appropriately to record themselves singing songs and rhymes on personal hygiene. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Health Education on personal hygiene is promoted as the learner works with peers to identify personal hygiene practices and sing songs based on theme Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate the concept and skills of singing songs and rhymes to their learning in Creative Arts.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.2 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 4.2.1 Reading Simple Texts. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key messages related to personal hygiene from simple texts, b) read simple texts on personal hygiene for comprehension, c) develop interest in reading simple texts for information. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read simple texts based on the theme aloud individually,  identify key messages from simple texts,  identify vocabulary from the texts,  work together to find out the meaning of the vocabulary,  organize the new words in a vocabulary bank or portfolio,  arrange word and sentence cards to form a short story on personal KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is reading important? hygiene,  take turns to play reading games,  team up to read a variety of reading materials on personal hygiene, Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration is developed as the learner teams up with peers to play reading games harmoniously.  Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner arranges word and sentence cards to create a story. Values:  Responsibility is enhanced as the learner take personal initiative to organise words to create a vocabulary bank or portfolio.  Unity is achieved as the learner works with peers collaboratively to find out the meaning of the vocabulary. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Social justice is enhanced as the learner teams up with peers and share roles as they read variety of materials on personal hygiene collaboratively. Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate and apply simple text reading skills to their reading activities in Kiswahili learning area.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.4 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 4.4.1 Creative Writing. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) write simple words related to personal SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The Learner is guided to:  practice word building using letter flash cards and letter cut outs,  arrange jumbled up letters to form words related to the theme, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we write creatively? hygiene for expression, b) use words related to personal hygiene to make sentences for communication, c) enjoy creating texts on personal hygiene for information.  complete word puzzles with peers,  fill in missing letters to complete words on personal hygiene,  match pictures of parts of the body and hygiene practice items to their names,  fill in words in simple sentences with peers,  collaborate in writing simple sentences related to personal hygiene,  work jointly to develop a simple story by sequencing jumbled sentences strips. Core Competencies to be developed:  Citizenship in enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers peacefully to write simple sentences related to personal hygiene.  Critical thinking and problem solving is promoted as the learner arranges jumbled up letters to form words. Values:  Responsibility is achieved as the learner takes up group tasks as they sequence jumbled sentences strips to develop a simple story by about personal hygiene.  Love is enhanced as the learners shows care to assist peers create a story from sentence strips and complete word puzzles Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Personal hygiene is enhanced as the learner works with peers to identify and match parts of the body with respective personal hygiene items. Link to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to connect the skills and concepts of creative writing to their learning in Kiswahili and English Languages.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.1 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 5.1.1 Responding to Information. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) pronounce words correctly to express different aspects of time for clarity, b) listen and respond to instructions related to time for communication, c) enjoy giving and responding to instructions in varied communication contexts. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to simple stories on times of the day, the week and months of the year,  pronounce words on different times correctly from the stories,  listen to a resource person talk about different times and activities that take place at those times.  respond to questions on times of the day, week and months of the year,  work collaboratively to sing rhymes and songs to depict various times of the day, week and months of the year,  role play various activities carried out in the community at various times. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we tell time? Core Competencies to be developed:  Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner role plays various activities carried out in the community at various times, days, weeks and months of the year.  Communication and collaboration is enhanced as the learner works harmoniously with peers to sing rhymes and songs to depict various times of the day, days of the week and months of the year Values:  Respect is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively and understanding with peers to sing rhymes and songs to depict various times.  Peace is developed as the learner works with peers mutually to role play various activities carried out in the community at various times. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Cultural Awareness is promoted as the learner engages with the resource person to understand various activities that happen in their community at various times of the day, week and year. Links to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate and apply the skills of giving and responding to information to their learning and communication in Kiswahili language.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.2 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 5.2.1 Reading for Understanding. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: At the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify key messages in written texts related to time for comprehension, b) respond questions on simple texts related to time SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  work with peers to interpret the meaning of pictures related to time, days, week and months  read words related to time from flash card, charts or digital devices  construct simple sentences using the words provided,  collect simple stories from the community and organise them in story baskets,  read simple community stories related to time, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we read to understand texts? for comprehension, c) enjoy reading simple texts related to time for information.  identify the main ideas from simple stories,  team up with peers to respond to questions related to the stories,  collaborate to play games involving words and simple sentences related to time. Core Competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy is enhanced as the learner manipulates digital devices to read texts and identify words related to time.  Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner constructs sentences using the words provided. Values:  Responsibility is developed as the learner takes initiative to read words and respond to questions from texts  Unity is achieved as the learner collaborates and cooperates with peers to play games involving words and simple sentences on time. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Peer teaching is promoted as the learner assists peers to respond to questions related to the stories correctly Links to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to relate the comprehension reading strategies and sentence construction to their learning in English.

chunks.subject: Indigenous Language
chunks.text: STRAND: 5. 3 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 5.3.1 Descriptive Writing- paragraph. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) write a simple text about what SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  work with peers to play syllable fishing games to create names on time and seasons,  write names of different times of the KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How are ideas organised to form story? happens at different times for communication, b) use the vocabulary acquired to write events at different times in sequence, c) Appreciate writing of texts for self- expression. days, weeks and months as dictated,  combine jumbled up words from cards to form correct sentences,  work jointly to sequence jumbled up sentences to form a text,  observe drawings and paintings describing different times,  work with peers to describe the pictures in a paragraph  team up to conduct a Pictionary session competition with peers to draw and paint different events at different times,  display pictures for a gallery walk to give feedback. Core Competencies to be developed:  Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner works jointly with peers to sequence jumbled up sentences to form creative texts.  Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner teams up with peers to conduct a competition to draw and paint different events at different times. Values:  Integrity is enhanced as the learner gives honest feedback as they conduct a gallery walk for the picture displays.  Unity is enhanced as the learner cooperates with peers to conduct a drawing and painting competition. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner work and relates positively with peers as they describe the pictures and participate in Pictionary session competition. Links to Other Learning Areas: The learner is able to apply the descriptive writing skills acquired to their learning of writing in English and Kiswahili Languages.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Quran. SUB-STRAND: 1.1 Arabic Alphabets (10 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) identify the Arabic alphabets in three letter words in readiness for reading the Qur’an, b) listen actively to three letter words to enhance fluency in reading the Quran, c) read correctly three letter words with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an, d) appreciate the role of Arabic alphabets and vowels in the reading of the Qur’an. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● Arabic alphabets in three-letter words from flash cards/charts/digital devices and read them. ● listen to three-letter words with vowels from a digital device/resource person/teacher/peer and imitate them, ● read three-letter words with harakat or vowels (fat-hatain, dhumatain, kasratain and sukun) from flash cards and correct one another, ● pick three letter words from a box and read them, ● pick alphabets with harakat (vowels), form three-letter words and read them, ● sort and group three letter words from a basket/box and pronounce them. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why should one learn Arabic alphabets? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration; skills of listening and speaking enhanced as learners listen and imitate three-letter words with vowels. Values: Values: unity, cooperation as learners cooperate with others while sorting and grouping three letter words from a basket/box and pronouncing them. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills, Effective communication as learners read and pronounce three-letter words with vowels correctly. Link to other Learning Activity Areas: - Reading and listening skills as in language Activities.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 1.2 Selected Surah 1.2.1 Al-Fatiha (reading, reciting, memorization and using) Suggested Time
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Selected Surah 1.2.1 Al-Fatiha (reading, reciting, memorization and using) Suggested Time (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) read Surah Al-Fatiha correctly in readiness for swalah, b) recite Surah Al-Fatiha in swalah, c) memorise Surah Al-Fatiha in readiness for swalah, d) appreciate the recitation of the Qur’an for spiritual nourishment. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to verses of the selected surah Al-Fatiha from a teacher/resource person/digital device and repeat, ● complete verses of Surah Al- Fatiha using words from flash cards, ● sort and arrange the verses of Surah Al-Fatiha from pocket boards and read them aloud, ● turn-take to read Surah Al-Fatiha and correct one another. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why do Muslims recite Surah Al-Fatiha? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Sorting- as learners sort and arrange the verses of Surah Al-Fatiha Values: Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills- effective communication as learners express themselves effectively when reciting/reading Surah Al-Fatiha. Link to other Learning Activity Areas: learners read/recite/memorise Surah Al-Fatiha -related to Language Activities.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 1.2 Selected Surah 1.2.2 An-Naas (reading, reciting memorization and use)
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Selected Surah 1.2.2 An-Naas (reading, reciting memorization and use) (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) read Surah An-Naas correctly in readiness for swalah, b) recite Surah An-Naas in swalah, c) memorise Surah An-Naas in readiness for swalah, d) appreciate the recitation of the Qur’an for spiritual nourishment. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to verses of Surah An-Naas from a teacher/resource person/digital device and repeat, ● complete verses of Surah An- Naas using words from flash cards, ● sort and arrange the verses of Surah An-Naas from pocket boards and read them aloud, ● turn-take to read Surah An-Naas and correct one another. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why do Muslims recite Surah An- Naas? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Sorting- as learners sort and arrange the verses of Surah An-Naas Values: Unity, cooperation enhanced as learners collaboratively turn-take to read the verses of Surah An-Naas and correct one another Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Link to other Learning Activity Areas: Learners read/recite/memorise Surah An-Naas- related to Language Activity.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Hadith. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Hadith on obedience to parents (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand the learner should be able to: a) recite the Hadith on obedience to parents as a basis for moral development, b) practise the Hadith on obedience to parents in day- to-day life, c) appreciate the Hadith on obedience to parents to earn rewards from Allah (SWT). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● recite the Hadith on obedience to parents individually; ‘Allah (SWT)’s pleasure is in parents’ pleasure and Allah (SWT) anger is in parents’ anger,’’ ● pick flashcards to complete the Hadith on obedience to parents, ● roleplay situations depicting obedience to parents, ● story tell instances where obedience is practised in their daily life. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you show obedience to parents/teachers? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn; Self-discipline as learners work collaboratively while roleplaying situations depicting obedience to parents Values: Responsibility, accountability is enhanced as learners engage in assigned roles as they roleplay and story tell situations/instances where obedience is practised Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills tolerance enhanced as learners roleplay situations depicting obedience to parents Link to other Learning Activity Areas: as they learn about the family in Environmental Activities

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Hadith. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Hadith on cleanliness (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) recite the Hadith on cleanliness as a basis for moral development, b) Apply the teachings of the Hadith on cleanliness in day-to-day life, c) appreciate the Hadith on cleanliness to earn rewards from Allah (SWT). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● read after the teacher the Hadith on cleanliness displayed on a chart, ● recite the Hadith on cleanliness: ‘Cleanliness is part of faith…” and correct each other, ● sing songs on the importance of cleanliness and personal hygiene, ● engage cleaning activities such as cleaning the school compound, washing hands etc. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you uphold cleanliness? 2. Why should a Muslim maintain cleanliness? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn; learn independently as learners work on their own while cleaning the classroom Values: Responsibility, accountability is enhanced as learners engage in cleaning activities. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Health promotion issues, preventive health as learners engage in cleaning activities Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Hygiene and Nutrition Activity when they engage in cleaning tasks.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 3.1 Belief in Allah (SWT). Attributes of Allah (SWT) (Al-Khaaliq, Al-Razaaq)
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Pillars of Iman. SUB-STRAND: 3.1 Belief in Allah (SWT). Attributes of Allah (SWT) (Al-Khaaliq, Al-Razaaq) (7 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand the learner should be able to: a) mention the attributes of Allah (SWT) that describes Him as the Creator and the Provider to strengthen their Iman, b) use the selected attributes of Allah (SWT) in day-to-day life, c) appreciate the bounties Created and Provided by Allah (SWT). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to the teacher/resource person/peer/digital device mentioning the attributes of Allah (SWT), (Al-Khaaliq, Al-Razaaq) and repeat after him/her ● sort and match the attributes of Allah (SWT) with their corresponding meaning using flashcards individually or in pairs, ● observe the creation of Allah (SWT) outside the classroom and mention their names, ● model/draw/paint/colour the creation of Allah (SWT) observed outside the classroom, ● watch pictures/videos of Allah (SWT)’s creation and mention their names, ● sing and listen to qasida with the attributes of Allah (SWT) as Creator and Provider. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you benefit from Allah (SWT)’s creation? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination; Discovering fresh things, as learners observe in their immediate environment and model/draw/paint/colour Allah (SWT)’s creation. Values: Unity, cooperation as learners display team spirit while listen to and sing qasida with the attributes of Allah (SWT) in groups Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills, developmental perspective as the learners model/draw/paint/colour Allah (SWT)’s creation Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Creative Arts as learners model/draw/paint/colour

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Pillars of Iman. SUB-STRAND: 3.2 Belief in Angels (Raqib and Atid) (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand the learner should be able to: a) name the angels of Allah (SWT) responsible for recording of deeds to strengthen Iman, b) mention the duties performed by angels Raqib and Atid for spiritual nourishment, c) appreciate the duties performed by angels Raqib and Atid as a Pillar of iman. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guide to: ● listen to and sing qasida on the angels Raqib and Atid. ● pick names of the selected angels from a pocket board and read the names aloud. ● play games depicting good and bad deeds and differentiating them such as ‘nyama nyama nyama’. ● Match and sort the duties of the selected angels using flush cards KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are the duties of angels? 2. What are the benefits of doing good deeds? Core Competencies to be developed: Values: Peace; love as learners display tolerance while playing games such as ‘nyama nyama nyama’, depicting good and bad deeds and differentiating them Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills, responsibility as learners pick names of the selected angels from a pocket board and read the names aloud Link to other Learning Activity Areas: Creative Arts Activities when playing games.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 4.1 Pillars of Islam Shahada Swalah Saum Zakat Hajj
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.1 Pillars of Islam Shahada Swalah Saum Zakat Hajj (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) name the five pillars of Islam to strengthen their faith, b) recite the five pillars of Islam in sequence. c) appreciate the five pillars of Islam as a foundation of Islam. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● sing songs or poems on the pillars of Islam, ● arrange pillars of Islam using flash cards in their sequence, ● participate in a game involving the mentioning of the five pillars of Islam in sequence, ● take turns to recite the five pillars of Islam and correct one another, ● draw a house/tree with 5 pillars representing the five pillars of Islam, colour and display in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are the things that a Muslim should do to obey Allah? 2. How can you identify a true Muslim? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration- listen critically and demonstrate understanding by reciting the five pillars of Islam in sequence. Values: Unity, Cooperation enhanced as learners display teamspirit participate in a game involving the mentioning of the five pillars of Islam in sequence. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills, developmental perspective as learners draws the five pillars of Islam using locally available materials and display Link to Other Learning Activity Areas. Creative Arts Activity as they draw and colour.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.2 Shahadah (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) recite the Shahadah as a pillar of Islam to strengthen their faith, b) demonstrate the occasions when the Shahadah is proclaimed in day-to- day life, c) appreciate the use of Shahadah in the life of a Muslim. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● sing songs or poems on the shahada ● pick flashcards from a pocket board to from the shahada ● take-turns to recite the Shahada and correct one another, ● roleplay occasions when the Shahada is said (for example when converting to Islam, in the tashahud, in the adhan, at the onset of death) and share experiences. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. When do we say the shahada? 2. Why do Muslims say the Shahada? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn; reflection on own as learners share experiences on occasions when Shahada is used Values: Unity, cooperation enhanced as learners collaboratively roleplay occasions when the Shahada is said. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills, Effective communication as learners sing songs or poems on the shahada Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Language Activities when reciting the shahadah

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.3 Wudhu (steps and performance of wudhu) (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand the learner should be able to: a) name the steps of wudhu in preparation for swalah, b) perform wudhu systematically as a prerequisite for performance of prayers, c) appreciate wudhu as a purification requirement before performing swalah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  watch a video clip showing the correct steps in the performance of wudhu and describe what they have observed,  watch the teacher/resource person/peer demonstrating the steps of wudhu (washing the hands, rinsing the mouth, rinsing the nostrils, washing the face, washing the two arms, wiping the head, wiping the ears, washing the feet) and repeat,  pick flashcards with steps of wudhu and arrange them in sequence,  sing qasida on steps of wudhu with appropriate gesture/movement  demonstrate the performance of wudhu in the correct order, record themselves and share with friends using a digital device. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What do you do before you pray? 2. Which body parts are washed during wudhu? Core Competencies to be developed: Digital literacy; connecting using technology as learners connect to the internet to watch video clips on steps of wudhu. Values: Unity; cooperation as learners cooperates with others when picking flashcards with steps of wudhu and arrange them in sequence. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Socio-economic and environmental issues, financial literacy as learners use water sparingly when performing wudhu Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Environmental Activities as they wash body parts while performing wudhu.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 AKHLAQ (Moral Teachings). SUB-STRAND: 5. 1 Relationship 5.1.1 Love for Allah (SWT)’s bounties (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) identify five bounties of Allah (SWT) in the immediate environment to enhance love for Allah (SWT), b) utilise the bounties of Allah (SWT) appropriately to earn His blessings, c) appreciate the bounties of Allah (SWT) as a sign of love to mankind. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● watch video clips/pictures/paper cuttings showing bounties of Allah (SWT) (for example, plants, animals, self-body parts) and name them, ● play games involving touching and naming body parts as part of Allah (SWT)’s bounties (For example. ‘head- shoulder’) ● carry out simple activities using their hands, legs and eyes to appreciate the bounties of the body parts, ● listen/sing qasida/ recite poems on Allah (SWT)’s favours, ● draw and colour, trees, animals as part of creation of Allah (SWT) from the immediate environment, ● cut, mount pictures of plants and animals; and display in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Which bounties of Allah (SWT) are in your immediate environment? 2. How do you take care of Allah (SWT)’s creation? Core Competencies to be developed: Self efficacy; Identify who they are as learners touch and name body parts as bounties of Allah. Values: Responsibility; accountability as learners carry out simple activities using their hands, legs and eyes to reflect on the bounties of their body parts Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life Skills; self-awareness as learners name and carry out simple activities using their body parts. Link to other Learning Activity Areas: Creative Arts Activities as learners draw and colour

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Teachings). SUB-STRAND: 5.1.2 Love for parents (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) state five ways of show love to their parents/guardians, b) demonstrate ways of showing love to parents/guardians in day-to-day life, c) appreciate love accorded to parents/guardians in their day-to- day life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to short stories on love to parents and mention the ways described in the stories, ● roleplay ways of showing love to parents/guardians (for example, children greeting their parents, giving gifts to them, helping with small errands at home; responding to their call, obeying them etc), ● make paper cutouts with different ways of treating parents and mount them on a charts, ● sort from a box/basket paper cutouts with different ways of treating parents, isolating good from bad ways, ● sing qasidas and songs on love for parents, ● keep a journal record on ways they have shown love to their parents/guardians. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do we treat our parents? 2. How do you show love to your parents? Core Competencies to be developed: Critical Thinking and Problem Solving; as learners justify proper ways of showing love to parents from the stories. Values: Responsibility, accountability as learners engage in assigned roles and duties while roleplaying ways of showing love to parents/guardians. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life Skills; making choices as learners choose various options to show love to parents. Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Environmental Activities when learning care for members of the family.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Teachings). SUB-STRAND: 5.2 Care for the Environment- home (5 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) outline ways of maintaining cleanliness in the home for healthy living, b) practice cleanliness of home compound to facilitate healthy living, c) appreciate the importance of maintaining a clean home environment as an act of ibadah SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● mention the items used for cleaning the home environment and draw them, ● clean their home compound, record themselves using digital devices and present in class, ● improvise simple cleaning items and display them in the classroom, ● sing qasidas on the importance of cleanliness. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can we keep our compound clean? 2. Why should we keep our school compound clean? 3. What items do we use to clean the home? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and Imagination; adopt and change one’s ideas in response to feedback as learners improvise items used for cleaning. Values: Responsibility; hard work as learners care for own property and those of others while cleaning their home environment Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life Skills; Effective communication as learners draw the items used in cleaning the home environment. Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: Hygiene and Nutrition

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 Siirah (Life of Prophet S.A.W). SUB-STRAND: 6.1 Birth of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W) (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand the learner should be able to: a) identify the name given to the Prophet (S.A.W) at birth, b) narrate the event of the birth of the Prophet (S.A.W), c) appreciate the birthplace of the Prophet as the holy city of Muslims SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● pick out the name of the Prophet (S.A.W) from a set of flash cards containing other names, ● listen to the story about the events of the Amul-fiil (Year of the Elephant) from a video clip/teacher and narrate the events of Amul- fiil ● are guided to name the date, month and year of birth of the Prophet (SAW) ● draw and colour the Kaaba, elephant and birds ● sing qasida on the birth of the Prophet (S.A.W) KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What events took place during the birth of the Prophet (S.A.W) Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to Learn-develop relationship as they carry out activities with peers Values: Unity -cooperation-enhanced as learners collaborate with others while singing qasida on the birth of the Prophet (S.A.W) Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life Skills –Effective communication-as they draw and colour the Kaaba. Link to other Learning Activity Areas: as they learn about people and events in Environmental Activities

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 Islamic Festivals. SUB-STRAND: 7.1 Eid ul-Fitr (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) identify the Islamic month on which Eid ul-Fitr falls as part of the history of Islam, b) mention the activities carried out during Eid ul-Fitr festival in the Islamic calendar, c) appreciate Eid ul-Fitr celebrations as an important festival among Muslims. Core Competencies to be developed: Citizenship- active community life skills -as learners narrate the activities that take place before and during Eid celebrations. Values: Responsibility – Accountability enhanced as learners roleplay the activities that take place during the Eid celebrations Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Social Economic & Environmental Issues-Financial Literacy- role play the activities that take place during the Eid celebration Link to Other Learning Activity Areas: concept on celebration of national holidays such as Mashujaa day in Environmental Activities.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 Islamic Festivals. SUB-STRAND: 7.1 Eid ul-Adha (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to: a) identify the Islamic month on which the Eid ul-Adha falls as part of the history of Islam, b) mention the activities carried out during the Eid ul-Adha festival in the Islamic calendar, c) appreciate Eid ul-Adha celebrations as an important festival among Muslims. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● watch video clips on the celebration of Eid ul- Adha and mention the date, month and activities observed, ● listen to the activities undertaken during the Eid ul-Adha from a resource person/teacher and narrate the activities that take place before and during the Eid festival, ● role play the activities that take place during the Eid celebrations (for example, taking bath, wearing clean clothes, attending the Eid prayer, reciting the takbir, slaughtering, feasting, exchange of gifts etc). KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you prepare for Eid celebrations? 2. Why do Muslims celebrate Eid ul- Adha? Core Competencies to be developed: Citizenship-People and Public events in community-as learner narrate the activities that takes place before and during Eid celebrations. Values: Responsibility – Accountability enhanced as learners roleplay the activities that take place during the Eid celebrations Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Social Economic & Environmental Issues-Financial Literacy- role play the activities that take place during the Eid celebration Link to other Learning Activity Areas: as they learn national celebrations in Environmental Activities. Suggested Resources

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 1.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno yanayotumiwa katika maamkuzi na maagano, b) kuamkua na kuitikia maamkuzi na maagano ipasavyo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano, c) kuchangamkia maamkuzi na maagano katika maisha ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua maneno ya maamkuzi (Hujambo? Hamjambo? Habari? Sijambo, Hatujambo, Nzuri) na maagano (Kwaheri, Kwaheri ya kuonana) kwa kutumia kadi maneno, michoro, chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno n.k. akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusikiliza kifungu kifupi cha hadithi kuhusu maamkuzi na maagano mepesi kikisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali,  kutambua maamkuzi na maagano yaliyotumiwa katika hadithi aliyoisikiliza akishirikiana na wenzake,  kujadili michoro au picha zenye watu wanaoamkuana na wanaoagana akishirikiana na mwenzake,  kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano (k.v. Hujambo - Sijambo; Hamjambo- Hatujambo; Habari - Njema/Nzuri; Kwaheri - KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unatumia maneno gani kuwasalimu na kuwaaga watu?  Kwaheri ya kuonana) darasani akishirikiana na mwenzake au katika kikundi kwa kuzingatia umoja, upendo na heshima kwa wenzake,  kueleza wenzake kuhusu maamkuzi na maagano aliyojadili na mzazi au mlezi wake. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kikundi, kusikiliza na kutoa maoni yake kikamilifu. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kujifunzia maamkuzi na maagano. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapojifunza maamkuzi na maagano yanayotumiwa katika jamii yake. ● Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapoigiza maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali. Maadili ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji wa maamkuzi na maagano. ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuamkuana na kuagana. ● Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapojadili na mzazi au mlezi kuhusu maamkuzi katika jamii yake. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anapoamkuana na wenzake kwa utulivu. ● Uadilifu - mwanafunzi anapomwamkua mzazi au mlezi ifaavyo kwa heshima. Masuala mtambuko Mshikamano wa kijamii- mwanafunzi anapotumia maamkuzi na maagano katika jamii anaimarisha mahusiano ya kijamii.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 1.2.1 Usomaji Mwafaka (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua namna ifaayo ya kuketi anaposoma, b) kutambua jinsi ya kushika kitabu ipasavyo anaposoma, c) kuelekeza macho kutoka kushoto hadi kulia na kutoka juu ya ukurasa hadi chini anaposoma, d) kuonea fahari usomaji mwafaka maishani. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua namna ya kuketi anaposoma (k.v. kutoinama sana, kuketi wima, kutoning’iniza miguu) kutoka kwenye picha, michoro, magazeti, vitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kufanya mazoezi ya kuketi ipasavyo anaposoma, ● kutambua jinsi ya kushika kitabu ipasavyo kwa kutazama picha au michoro kwenye magazeti, chati, mabango, vitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali n.k. akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kufanya mazoezi ya kushika kitabu ipasavyo anaposoma, ● kuelekeza macho kutoka kushoto hadi kulia na kutoka juu ya ukurasa hadi chini akiongozwa na mwalimu, ● kutazama picha mbalimbali zinazotoka kushoto kwenda kulia na juu kwenda chini, ● kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua kurasa za KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia mambo gani unaposoma? kitabu ipasavyo, ● amsomee mzazi au mlezi kwa kuzingatia namna ifaayo ya kuketi na kushika kitabu. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kikundi kuonyesha jinsi ya kuketi ifaavyo, kushika kalamu na kuelekeza macho ipasavyo ili kusoma. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutazama namna ifaayo ya kutekeleza shughuli ya kusoma. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi kuonyesha jinsi ya kusoma ifaavyo. Maadili ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kusoma katika kikundi. ● Amani - mwanafunzi anapoonyesha utulivu akishiriki katika kikundi. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika kikundi. Masuala mtambuko ● Haki za watoto- mwanafunzi anajitambua anapojifunza namna ya kuketi, kushika kitabu na kuelekeza macho ipasavyo anaposoma. ● Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutazama picha au michoro. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities - masomo haya pia yanashughulikia matayarisho ya kusoma.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 1.3.1 Uandishi Bora (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua namna ifaayo ya kuketi anapoandika, b) kuketi ifaavyo wakati wa kuandika, c) kutambua jinsi ya kushika kalamu anapoandika, d) kuandika kutoka kushoto hadi kulia kwa hati za mkono, e) kuonea fahari uandishi mwafaka maishani. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutazama picha zinazoonyesha jinsi ya kuketi na kushika kalamu katika vitabu au katika kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutambua jinsi ya kuketi vizuri wakati wa kuandika kutoka kwenye picha, ● kuketi ipasavyo wakati wa kuandika, ● kumwonyesha mwenzake jinsi ya kuketi wakati wa kuandika, ● kutambua namna ya kushika kalamu kutoka kwenye picha, michoro, magazeti, vitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali n.k akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kushika kalamu na kuidhibiti ipasavyo, ● kuwaonyesha wenzake jinsi ya kushika kalamu vizuri wakati wa kuandika, ● kuandika (kwa mfano kuchora kifaa cha darasani kama vile kiti, kitabu, kalamu, meza) kwa kushika kalamu ipasavyo na kuidhibiti, ● kuwapa wenzake kazi yake waipitie ili KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni mambo gani unapaswa kuzingatia wakati wa kuandika? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapowaeleza wenzake kuhusu namna ya kuketi na kushika kalamu na kisha kuwasikiliza wakitoa maoni yao. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutazama jinsi ya kuketi na kushika kalamu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi nyumbani kutazama video kuhusu jinsi ya kuketi na kushika kalamu ipasavyo wakati wa kuandika. Maadili ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za matayarisho ya kuandika na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Uwajibikaji- mwanafunzi anapobadilishana kazi na wenzake ili wasahihishiane na kutoleana maoni. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kuonyeshana jinsi ya kuketi. Masuala mtambuko Masuala ya kijinsia- mwanafunzi anajitambua anapojifunza namna ya kuketi, kushika kitabu na kuelekeza macho ipasavyo anapoandika. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities - masomo haya pia yanashughulikia uandishi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.1 Matumizi ya Mimi na Sisi (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua neno mimi na sisi katika sentensi alizopewa, b) kutumia neno mimi na sisi ipasavyo katika sentensi alizopewa, c) kufurahia kutumia neno mimi na sisi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusikiliza wimbo unaotumia neno mimi na sisi kutoka kwa mwalimu au kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kusoma sentensi fupi zilizoandikwa kwa kutumia neno mimi na sisi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia mimi na sisi, ● kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizokamilisha kwa kujaza nafasi akitumia mimi na sisi ili ampe maoni yake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Neno mimi na sisi hutumiwa kwa maana gani katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kutoa mifano kwa kutumia neno mimi na sisi. ● Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya neno mimi na sisi darasani. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza matumizi ya neno mimi na sisi. ● Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia neno mimi na sisi ifaavyo. Maadili: ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kuigiza matumizi ya neno mimi na sisi. ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi. ● Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia neno mimi na sisi katika mawasiliano kwa kutunga sentensi zenye maadili. Masuala Mtambuko: ● Afya ya mtu binafsi- mwanafunzi anapojitambua na kutambua wenzake anapotunga sentensi kuhusu neno mimi na sisi. ● Elimu ya mazingira– mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine:English Language Activities - somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya nafsi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungum za. SUB-STRAND: 2.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kadi maneno, b) kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mazungumzo, c) kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa ipasavyo, d) kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa, e) kuchangamkia nafasi ya matamshi bora katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/m/, /a/, /u/, /k/, /t/ /l/) katika kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno, au kifaa cha kidijitali) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia teknolojia (k.v. papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa, ● kusikiliza mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa akitamka sauti lengwa, ● kutamka sauti pamoja na mwalimu, ● kutamka sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kinasasauti au rununu) akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa alizosikiliza akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusikiliza maneno yenye sauti lengwa yakisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unaweza kutamka sauti zipi? au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali, ● kutamka maneno ya sauti lengwa ifaavyo akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutamkia mzazi au mlezi maneno yenye sauti lengwa ipasavyo. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua na kutamka sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa. ● Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapotamka sauti lengwa na silabi ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujifunza matamshi ya sauti lengwa na silabi. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa. ● Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali. Masuala mtambuko: ● Mahusiano ya kifamilia – mwanafunzi anapotaja majina kuhusiana na suala lengwa k.v. kaka, mama. ● Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake au na mgeni mwaalikwa kutamka sauti lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities - masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya matamshi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi, b) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, d) kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo, e) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/m/, /a/, /u/, /k/, /t/, /l/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa, kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 5 kwa dakika na kwa kuizingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijtali akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, ni maneno yapi unayojua kusoma? 2. Je, kwa nini ni muhimu kusoma kwa sauti inayosikika? kufanikisha mawasiliano. ● kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma silabi na maneno. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua na kusoma silabi na maneno yenye sauti lengwa. ● Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapomudu kusoma silabi na maneno yenye sauti lengwa. Maadili: ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za kutambua sauti na kusoma kwa ufasaha. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani. ● Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kusoma na kuheshimu maoni ya wenzake kuhusu usomaji wake. Masuala Mtambuko: Mahusiano ya kifamilia – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language activities - masomo haya pia hushughulikia dhana ya kusoma kwa ufasaha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 2.3.1 Hati Nadhifu Herufi kubwa (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maumbo ya herufi kubwa, b) kuandika herufi kubwa ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia maumbo yake, c) kufurahia kuandika herufi kubwa ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia maumbo yake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushirikiana na wenzake kutambua herufi kubwa kwenye kitabu, kadi maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidjitali, ● kutambua maumbo ya herufi kubwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kushirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuandika herufi kubwa ipasavyo, ● kuandika herufi kubwa ipasavyo kitabuni au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kushirikiana na wenzake kutathmini herufi kubwa alizoandika. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni herufi gani kubwa unazojua kuandika? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano -mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua maumbo ya herufi kubwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika herufi kubwa akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji -mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kuandika herufi kubwa akiwa nyumbani kwa kuzingatia maumbo yafaayo. ● Kujiamini-mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika herufi kubwa ipasavyo. . Maadili ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kutathmini herufi kubwa alizoandika. Masuala mtambuko ● Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu- mwanafunzi anapojitahidi kuandika herufi kubwa kwa kuzingatia maumbo yake, ukakamavu wake unajengeka. ● Haki na majukumu ya kibinadamu- mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake na kushirikiana katika shughuli za kikundi Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language activities - masomo haya pia yanashughulikia kuandika herufi kubwa.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 2.4.1 Umoja na Wingi wa Majina (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, b) kuandika majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, c) kuchangamkia kuzungumzia vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake kwa kutazama vitu halisi, picha au vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. vifaa vya nyumbani, ● kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuimba wimbo unaotaja vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma majina ya vitu katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuandika majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, ● kuambatanisha michoro na majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake akishirikiana KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vitu gani hupatikana katika mazingira ya darasani na nyumbani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu katika kutambua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotaka kujua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunzia majina ya vitu vinavyopatikana katika mazingira yake. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutaja majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kutaja majina ya vitu katika umoja na wingi. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapoimba wimbo unaotaja vitu katika mazingira yake. Masuala mtambuko: ● Afya ya mtu binafsi- mwanafunzi anapoandika majina ya vitu vya nyumbani vinavyotumiwa katika kudumisha afya. ● Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua umoja na wingi wa vitu katika mazingira yao. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya umoja na wingi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.1Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 3.1.1 Maneno ya Adabu na Heshima (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno ya adabu na heshima yanayotumiwa katika jamii, b) kutumia ipasavyo maneno ya adabu na heshima katika mawasiliano, c) kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima katika mawasiliano ya kila siku SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maneno ya heshima(asante, pole, tafadhali) kutoka kwenye chati, kadi maneno, mti maneno, kitabu n.k akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutazama michoro mbalimbali na kujadili neno linalofaa kutumiwa katika shughuli husika (k.v. mtu akipokea zawadi, mtu akitaka kupishwa apite) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza mazungumzo (k.v. kutoka kwa wanafunzi wenzake, kifungu katika kifaa cha kidijitali) kisha kutambua maneno ya adabu na heshima yaliyotumika, ● kuigiza mazungumzo mafupi yanayotumia maneno ya heshima wakiwa na wenzake, ● kuzungumza na mzazi au mlezi katika mazungumzo huku wakitumia maneno ya heshima yanayotumiwa katika jamii KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, tunaweza kuonyesha heshima na adabu kwa wenzetu kwa kufanya nini? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu pamoja na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili matumizi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunza matumizi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima yanayotumiwa katika jamii yake. ● Uraia – mwanafunzi anapojua kutumia maneno ya adabu heshima ipasavyo. Maadili ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali ambavyo anatumia kujifunzia maneno ya adabu na heshima. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojifunza matumizi ya maneno ya heshima. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake bila kuzozana katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya adabu na heshima katika mawasiliano. Masuala mtambuko Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya adabu kuonyesha heshima kwa wenzake na jamii. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English Language Activities, Indigenous Language Activities na Religious Education Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia matumizi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, b) kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, c) kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 6-12 kuhusu suala lengwa na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v moja, mbili, tatu, nne, tano, sita, saba, nano, tisa, kumi) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano, ● kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, ● kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu alichokisoma, ● kumweleza mzazi au mlezi kuhusu tarakimu alizojifunza. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unajua hadithi kuhusu nini? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kuhesabu nambari moja hadi kumi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutazama na kusikiliza wimbo kuhusu tarakimu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake katika kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye kitabu au mtandaoni. Maadili: ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuhesabu tarakimu na kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu. ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kutoa maoni yao katika kikundi wanapojadili ujumbe katika kifungu. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano. Masuala Mtambuko: Elimu ya pesa– mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities, Indigenous Language Activities– masomo haya pia hushughulikia kusoma ufahamu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 3.3.1 Hati Nadhifu Herufi Ndogo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maumbo ya herufi ndogo katika maandishi, b) kuandika herufi ndogo kwa kuzingatia maumbo yake, c) kufurahia kuandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maumbo ya herufi ndogo kwenye kitabu, chati au chombo cha kidijitali, ● kushirikiana na wenzake kutambua herufi ndogo kwenye kitabu, chati au chombo cha kidjitali, ● kuandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo kitabuni au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kushirikiana na wenzake kutambua maumbo ya herufi ndogo kwenye chati, kitabuni, au chombo cha kidjitali, ● kushiriki kuimba nyimbo kuhusu herufi ndogo, ● kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi herufi alizoandika. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika kwa hati nadhifu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano -mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua herufi ndogo kwenye kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidjitali. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapoandika herufi ndogo akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoendelea kuandika herufi na maneno akishirikiana na mzazi au mlezi, kutambua na kuandika herufi ndogo akiwa nyumbani. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi huku akiheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo kitabuni au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Amani - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kutambua herufi ndogo kwenye kitabu, chati au chombo cha kidjitali. Masuala Mtambuko: Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya hati nadhifu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 3.4.1 Matumizi ya Huyu na Hawa (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matumizi ya huyu na hawa kutokana na picha, b) kutumia huyu na hawa ipasavyo katika mazungumzo, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya huyu na hawa katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua matumizi ya huyu na hawa katika picha, ● akiwa kwenye kikundi kutumia huyu na hawa k.v. Mwanafunzi huyu - wanafunzi hawa, ● kutunga sentensi zinazojumuisha matumizi ya huyu na hawa, ● kusoma sentensi zinazojumuisha matumizi ya huyu na hawa, ● kumtungia mwenzake sentensi kwa kutumia huyu na hawa katika kikundi, ● kujaza nafasi katika daftari kwa kutumia huyu na hawa. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Maneno huyu na hawa hutumikaje katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutunga sentensi akitumia huyu na hawa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kuburura majibu sahihi na kuyatia kapuni. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia huyu na hawa. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia huyu na hawa ipasavyo katika sentensi. Maadili ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kufanya zoezi huku akizingatia utunzaji unaofaa. ● Umoja, heshima na upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kutumia huyu na hawa. ● Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapomtungia mwenzake katika kikundi sentensi zenye maadili kwa kutumia huyu na hawa. ● Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu sentensi atakazotunga. Masuala Mtambuko: Uongozi na utawala mwema– mwanafunzi anapowaongoza wenzake kutunga sentensi katika kikundi. Uhusiano na Masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia viwakilishi na vivumishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 4.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kadi maneno, b) kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mazungumzo, c) kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa ipasavyo, d) kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa, e) kuchangamkia SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/n/, /o/, /w/, /e/, /i/, /h/) katika kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali) akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutumia teknolojia (k.v. papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa, ● kusikiliza mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa akitamka sauti lengwa, ● kutamka sauti pamoja na mwalimu, ● kutamka sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. kinasasauti na rununu kisha kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni sauti zipi unazojua kutamka vizuri? nafasi ya matamshi bora katika mawasiliano. ● kusikiliza maneno yenye sauti lengwa yakisomwa na mwalimu kisha kutamka maneno hayo, ● kumtamkia mzazi au mlezi sauti alizojifunza. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua na kutamka sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutamka sauti lengwa na silabi ipasavyo. Masuala Mtambuko: Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake au na mgeni mwaalikwa kutamka sauti na maneno. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya matamshi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi, b) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti d) kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/n/, /o/, /w/, /e/, /i/, /h/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa peke yake, na wenzake ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 15 kwa dakika na kwa kuizingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kita au kifaa cha kidijtali akishirikiana na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unaweza kusoma silabi zipi? ifaayo e) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. wenzake, akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, ● amsomee mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kusoma kifungu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu chepesi kwa kuzingatia sauti lengwa. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kwa ufasaha. Maadili ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za kutambua sauti na kusoma kwa ufasaha. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani. ● Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kusoma na kuheshimu maoni ya wenzake kuhusu usomaji wake. Masuala Mtambuko: Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kusoma kifungu hadi wamalize wakiwemo wale wasiosoma kwa kasi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia dhana ya sauti.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 4.3.1 Hati Nadhifu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nafasi baina ya herufi katika maneno, b) kuandika maneno kwa kuunganisha silabi, c) kufurahia kuandika maneno kwa kuzingatia nafasi ifaayo baina ya herufi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kuonyesha nafasi baina ya herufi zinazounda maneno kwenye kitabu, chati au chombo cha kidijitali, ● kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kutambua nafasi baina ya herufi katika maneno, ● kuandika daftarini maneno kwa kuunganisha silabi akizingatia nafasi ifaayo baina ya herufi zinazounda maneno. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, kwa nini tunafaa kuandika kwa hati nadhifu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua nafasi baina ya herufi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika maneno kwa kuzingatia nafasi ifaayo baina ya herufi kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nafasi baina ya herufi katika maneno. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi wanapofanya shughuli ya kikundi kwa pamoja. Masuala mtambuko: Mshikamano wa kijamii– mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake wanaposhirikiana katika shughuli za kikundi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya kuandika herufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 4.4.1 Umoja na Wingi wa Majina (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, b) kutumia majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, c) kuchangamkia kuzungumzia vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake ya darasani kwa kutazama vitu halisi, picha au vifaa vya kidijitali, ● kuimba wimbo unaotaja vitu katika mazingira yake, ● kusoma majina ya vitu vinavyopatikana katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, ● kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi, ● kumzungumzia mzazi au mlezi wake vitu katika mazingira ya nyumbani kwa kutumia majina yafaayo katika umoja na wingi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vitu gani vya darasani unavyoweza kutaja katika umoja na wingi? Umilisi wa Kimsingi Unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutambua vitu katika mazingira yake. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapojitahidi kujua majina ya vitu katika mazingira yake katika umoja na wingi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunzia majina ya vitu katika umoja na wingi. Maadili: ● Umoja - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kutumia umoja na wingi. ● Heshima - mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi. ● Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia umoja na wingi katika mawasiliano kwa kutunga sentensi zenye maadili. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapoimba na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko: Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi-mwanafunzi anapotaja vitu katika mazingirayake kwa umoja na wingi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities – somo hili pia linashughulikia dhana ya umoja na wingi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 5.1.1 Kifungu cha Hadithi. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa katika kifungu, b) kutunga sentensi sahihi akitumia msamiati uliotumiwa, c) kusikiliza kifungu anachosomewa cha maneno kati ya 15-20 na kupata ujumbe, d) kujibu maswali kuhusu hadithi aliyosikiliza, e) kuchangamkia kusikiliza kifungu ili kujenga ari ya kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushirikiana na wengine kujadili picha zilizojumuishwa kwenye hadithi, ● kutabiri kitakachotokea kwenye hadithi, ● kuthibitisha utabiri wake baada ya kusikiliza hadithi, ● kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati uliotumika kwenye hadithi, ● kusikiliza kifungu cha maneno kati ya 15-20 kikisomwa na mwalimu au kupitia vifaa vya kiteknolojia ● kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu, ● kujadiliane kuhusu hadithi waliyosomewa katika kikundi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unatarajiwa kufanya nini unaposomew a hadithi? 2. Unawezaje kupata ujumbe katika kifungu cha hadithi unachosome wa? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili picha katika hadithi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika ujifunzaji. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza kifungu kikisomwa. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotabiri matukio ya hadithi. ● Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria maana ya msamiati na kuutumia katika sentensi. Masuala Mtambuko ● Mahusiano ya kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili picha kwenye kifungu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia stadi za kusikiliza na kuzungumza.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze; a) kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, b) kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, c) kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. mimi, wenzangu) kutoka kwenye kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 13- 16 kuhusu suala lengwa na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kumweleza mzazi au mlezi kuhusu ujumbe aliopata kutokana na kifungu alichosoma. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni mambo gani unayoweza kujifunza katika hadithi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua ujumbe katika kifungu. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kifungu na kueleza ujumbe. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kujifunzia. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kusoma ufahamu kuhusu suala lengwa na kueleza ujumbe. Maadili ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kujadili picha na ujumbe katika kifungu. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika kikundi. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusoma kifungu. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu na kumweleza mzazi au mlezi ujumbe aliopata. Masuala mtambuko: Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia kusoma kwa ufahamu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 5.3.1 Matumizi ya Kikomo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua alama ya kikomo katika maandishi, b) kuandika alama ya kikomo ifaavyo katika daftari, c) kutumia ipasavyo alama ya kikomo katika sentensi, d) kufurahia kutumia alama ya kikomo ipasavyo katika sentensi.
