SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua alama ya kikomo (.) katika sentensi kitabuni, kwenye chati au kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuandika sentensi daftarini au kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kisha aweke alama ya kikomo, ● kutumia alama ya kikomo ipasavyo mwishoni mwa sentensi akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi alama ya kikomo na kuitumia ipasavyo katika sentensi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Alama gani zinazotumika katika kuandika sentensi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua alama ya kikomo na kuitumia katika sentensi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapoandika alama ya kikomo akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotambua alama ya kikomo. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia alama ya kikomo kuandika sentensi. Maadili ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika katika kikundi. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko: Kujitambua-mwanafunzi anapoandika alama ya kikomo kwa usahihi na kuwaonyesha wenzake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia matumizi ya alama ya kikomo.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 5.4.1 Matumizi ya -angu na -etu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matumizi ya -angu na -etu katika miktadha mbalimbali, b) kutumia -angu na - etu katika mazungumzo kwa ufasaha ili kuimarisha mawasiliano, c) kufurahia kutumia - angu na -etu katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua matumizi ya -angu na - etu kwa kurejelea vitu katika mazingira yake, ● kuigiza matumizi ya -angu na -etu akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi kwa kutumia vitu anavyomiliki k.v. kitabu changu – vitabu vyetu; rafiki yangu - marafiki zetu, ● kusoma sentensi zinazotumia maneno - angu na –etu, ● kukamilisha sentensi zenye matumizi ya -angu na –etu, ● kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia -angu na -etu. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni maneno gani unayotumia kuonyesha kuwa kitu ni chako au ni chenu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kujadili matumizi ya -angu na –etu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia -angu na -etu katika mawasiliano. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya -angu na -etu. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuigiza matumizi ya -angu na -etu. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika kikundi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya -angu na -etu akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi. Masuala mtambuko: ● Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anaposoma sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Mahusiano ya kijamii-mwanafunzi anapowasiliana na wenzake kwa ufasaha akitumia –angu na –etu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities – somo hili pia linashughulikia dhana ya -angu na -etu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 6.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kadi maneno, b) kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mazungumzo, c) kutamkasilabi za sautilengwa ipasavyo, d) kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa, e) kuchangamkia nafasi ya matamshi bora f) katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushiriki katika kutambua sauti lengwa (/s/, /b/, /y/, /z/, /g/, /d/) katika kadi maneno, ● kusikiliza matamshi ya sauti lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kutamka sauti lengwa akiwa na mwalimu kisha akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. kinasasauti na rununu, ● kutamka silabi alizozisikiliza ipasavyo akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni sauti zipi unazojua kutamka? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua na kutamka sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kujifunza matamshi ya sauti lengwa. ● kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti na silabi za sauti lengwa. Masuala Mtambuko: ● Usafi wa kibinafsi – mwanafunzi anapotamka maneno ya sauti lengwa kuhusu suala lengwa k.v. usafi, sabuni na bafu. ● Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake au na mgeni mwalikwa kutamka sauti na maneno. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities and Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya yanashughulikia dhana ya matamshi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi, b) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa c) kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, d) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa e) kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, f) kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo, g) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/s/, /b/, /y/, /z/, /g/, /d/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 20 kwa dakika na kwa kuizingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake, kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, nk akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni kwa nini unafaa kutamka maneno vizuri unaposoma?  kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kwa sauti inayosikika,  amsomee mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kusoma kifungu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu chepesi kwa kuzingatia sauti lengwa. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowashirikisha wengine wanaposhirikiana kutamka sauti lengwa katika kikundi. ● Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kusoma na kuheshimu maoni ya wenzake kuhusu usomaji wake. Masuala Mtambuko: ● Usafi wa kibinafsi – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Haki za watoto– mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia matumizi ya sauti za herufi kusoma maneno.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 6.3.1 Tahajia Imla (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu kutokana na suala lengwa, b) kuandika kwa usahihi maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu kwa kuunganisha silabi kuunda neno, c) kufurahia kuandika maneno kwa usahihi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu kutokana na suala lengwa kwa kusomewa na mwalimu au katika kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kusikiliza maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu ya kiwango chake yakisomwa na mwalimu au kutoka kwa kifaa cha kidigitali (k.v radio) na kuyaandika, ● kushirikiana na wenzake kuandika maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu ya kiwango chake, kwa kuunganisha silabi kuunda neno, ● kuyakosoa maneno aliyoyaendeleza visivyofaa. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni maneno gani ya silabi tatu unayajua? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kupitia kazi ya imla. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusikiliza maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika maneno aliyosomewa yasiyozidi silabi tatu kwa usahihi. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kuandika maneno yasiyozidi silabi tatu. Masuala mtambuko: Usafi wa mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapoandika maneno kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanafunza imla.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 6.4.1 Matumizi ya -zuri na – baya (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matumizi ya – zuri na – baya katika kifungu, b) kutumia –zuri na – baya katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano, c) kufurahia kutumia –zuri na –baya katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua matumizi ya -zuri na -baya kwa kurejelea vitu katika mazingira yake, ● kutumia -zuri na -baya akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi kurejelea vitu katika mazingira yake, ● kusikiliza matumizi ya –zuri na – baya kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kusoma sentensi zinazotumia maneno - zuri na –baya, ● kukamilisha sentensi zenye matumizi ya -zuri na –baya, ● kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia - zuri na –baya, ● kumtajia mzazi au mlezi vitu nyumbani kutumia –zuri na – baya. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni maneno gani unayotumia kuelezea vitu vinavyokupendeza au visivyokupendeza? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapotumia -zuri na-baya akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusikiliza matumizi ya-zuri na -baya. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia -zuri na -baya akiwa na mzazi au mlezi nyumbani na katika maisha yake ya kila siku. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia -zuri na –baya. ● Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapotumia -zuri na –baya. Maadili: ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kwa heshima katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Amani - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kutumia anapotumia -zuri na –baya. Masuala mtambuko ● Afya na usafi- mwanafunzi anaposoma sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Mahusiano ya jamii-mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akiwa na wenzake kurejeleavitu katika mazingira yake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities and Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia huhusisha dhana ya vivumishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 7.1.1 Maagizo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maagizo mepesi yanayotolewa darasani, b) kutoa na kufuata maagizo mepesi yanayotumiwa darasani, c) kubainisha maagizo yanayopaswa kufuatwa katika mazingira yake, d) kuthamini umuhimu wa maagizo katika maisha ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maagizo kwa kutazama video ya maagizo, ● kutoa na kufuata maagizo (kama vile simama, keti, andika na chora) akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi, ● kueleza kuhusu maagizo yafaayo na yasiyofaa kufuatwa, ● kushiriki katika azungumzo ya matokeo ya kufuata na kutofuata maagizo, ● kuimba na kuigiza nyimbo zinazohusu maagizo. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni maagizo yapi yanayotaki wa kufuatwa na yasiyotaki wa kufuatwa katika mazingira tofauti? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu katika kutoa na kuitikia maagizo ipasavyo. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kujifunzia maagizo. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapojifunza maagizo yanayotumiwa katika jamii yake. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotambua na kufuata maagizo yafaayo. Maadili ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapofuata maagizo na kuheshimu nafasi za wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua na kutumia maagizo. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutoa na kufuata maagizo akiwa na wenzake. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutoa na kufuata maagizo akiwa na wenzake kwa utulivu. ● Uadilifu - mwanafunzi anapotoa na kufuata maagizo yafaayo. Masuala mtambuko: Afya na usafi – mwanafunzi anapotoa au kufuata maagizo kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya yanashughulikia dhana ya maagizo.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, b) kutabiri yatakayotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu kwa kuzingatia picha, c) kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, d) kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, e) kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusikiliza au atazame nyimbo kuhusu usafi wa mwili kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuimba wimbo kuhusu usafi wa mwili akiwa na wenzake, ● kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 17- 22 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v oga, nawa osha, maji, sabuni) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unapenda kusoma kuhusu nini? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika kikundi kutabiri kwa kutazama picha na kusoma hadithi. ● Uwazaji kwa kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapotabiri yatakayotokea katika hadithi kwa kuzingatia picha. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kujifunzia. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapowaeleza wenzake kuhusu hadithi aliyosoma. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo kuhusu usafi wa mwili. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa kikundi kujadili ujumbe katika kifungu na kutabiri yatakayotokea katika hadithi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapowaeleza wenzake ujumbe aliopata kutokana na kifungu. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anapowaeleza wenzake kwa utulivu ujumbe aliopata kutokana na kifungu alichosoma. Masuala mtambuko:  Kujithamini– mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake fursa ya kujieleza katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Afya na usafi – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia kusoma kwa ufahamu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 7.3.1 Kuandika maneno ipasavyo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno yanayotokana na suala lengwa, b) kuandika maneno yanayohusu suala lengwa kwa kuunganisha silabi ili kuunda neno, c) kufurahia uandishi wa maneno katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maneno mepesi yanayotokana na suala lengwa (kama vile: oga, nawa, osha, maji, sabuni), ● kuandika maneno yanayotokana na suala lengwa daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali kwa kuunganisha silabi kuunda neno akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili na kurekebisha makosa katika maandishi yake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni maneno gani unayoweza kuandika kwa kuunganisha silabi? 2. Kwa nini ni muhimu kujifunza kuandika? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuandika maneno kwa kuunganisha silabi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika maneno. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika maneno ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi za kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika maneno kuhusu suala lengwa. Masuala mtambuko: ● Afya na usafi – mwanafunzi anapoandika maneno kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anapojadili kuhusu matumizi ya vitu vya kudumisha usafi k.v. sabuni, maji na nguo. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia mada ya kuandika.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.1 Ukanushaji (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza umoja na wingi katika vifungu, b) kutumia ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza umoja na wingi katika kifungu kwa usahihi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza umoja na wingi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutenda vitendo atakavyoagizwa na mwalimu kuashiria nafsi ya kwanza umoja,  kutenda vitendo vyake mwenyewe na kusema anachokifanya,  kutambua ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza umoja,  kushirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kukanusha sentensi katika nafsi ya kwanza umoja,  kukamilisha sentensi zinazoashiria ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza umoja kwa kuelekezwa na mwalimu,  kusikiliza sentensi kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidigitali zilizokanushwa akielekezwa na mwalimu. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unafanya nini sasa? 2. Kama haukufanya mambo uliyotaja ungesemaje? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kutunga sentensi akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotungia mwenzake sentensi katika kikundi akitumia ukanusho wa nafsi ya kwanza. Maadili: ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi kufanya zoezi kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali na kukitunza ipasavyo. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa utulivu akiwa na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko: ● Afya na usafi – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno kuhusu vitu vya kudumisha usafi k.v. sabuni, maji na nguo. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya ukanusho.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 8.1.1 Matams hi bora (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kadi maneno, b) kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mazungumzo, c) kutamka silabi za sauti sauti lengwa ipasavyo, d) kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa, e) kuchangamkia nafasi ya matamshi bora katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushiriki katika kutambua sauti lengwa (/j/, /r/, /p/, /f/, /v/, /sh/) katika kadi maneno, ● kusikiliza mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa akitamka sauti lengwa, ● kutamka sauti alizozisikiliza pamoja na mwalimu na mwishowe kutamka akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kwa ninini muhimu kutamka maneno ipasavyo? ● kutamka sauti lengwa ashirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. kinasasauti na rununu, ● kutamka silabi alizozisikiliza ipasavyo ashirikiana na wenzake, ● kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa akiwa na wenzake, ● kumwomba mzazi au mlezi kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kama vile simu ili kusikiliza matamshi ya sauti lengwa. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirki kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi kutamka sauti, silabi na maneno yenye sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia teknolojia kujifunzia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa. ● kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti, silabi na maneno ipasavyo. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka sauti lengwa. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujifunza matamshi ya sauti lengwa, silabi na maneno. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake ya sauti mbalimbali. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa. ● Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa kwa utulivu. Masuala mtambuko: Uzuiaji wa magonjwa – mwanafunzi anaposoma maneno yanayohusu suala lengwa atapata fursa ya kujifunza uzuiaji wa magonjwa kwa kula chakula kifaacho. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities and Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya matamshi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi, b) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika, d) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo, e) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/j/, /r/, /p/, /f/, /v/, /sh/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 25 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, nk akishirikiana na wenzake, akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kwa sauti inayosikika, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Matamshi bora na sauti inayosikika yana umuhimu gani katika kusoma? kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. ● kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kwa sauti inayosikika. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua silabi, maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kutambua silabi, maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi kutambua, kusikiliza na kusoma silabi, maneno na sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa kitabuni au kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kifungu cha hadithi ifaavyo. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapowajibikia majukumu aliyopewa katika kikundi. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufankisha mawasilano. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposoma na wenzake kifungu kwa utulivu. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowaheshimu wenzake wakisoma kwenye kikundi. Masuala mtambuko: ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu vyakula k.v. vyakula vinavyotumiwa nyumbani. ● Upataji wa pesa - mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu vyakula k.v. uuzaji wa vyakula. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia dhana za silabi, sauti na maneno.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 8.3.1 Tahajia (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua tahajia sahihi katika sentensi, b) kuandika sentensi tatu kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia tahajia sahihi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya tahajia sahihi katika uandishi wa sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sentensi zinazohusu suala lengwa zenye tahajia sahihi kwa kutumia nyenzo kama vile:kadi za majina,mti maneno,kapu maneno,chati,kifungu au kifaa cha kidigitali, ● kusoma sentensi zenye tahajia sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa, ● kunakili sentensi zenye tahajia sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye daftari, ● kutunga sentensi tatu sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuandika sentensi alizotunga kwa kuzingatia tahajia sahihi, ● kusoma sentensi alizoandika pamoja na wenzake katika kikundi kisha wenzake wazitolee maoni, ● kusahihisha sentensi alizoandika kwa kuzingatia tahajia, ● Kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi sentensi sahihi alizoandika ili apate maoni yake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kwa nini ni muhimu kuyaandika maneno na sentensi kwa usahihi? Umilisi wa Kimsingi Unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapochangia kikamilifu katika kikundi kutambua na kutunga sentensi kwa kuzingatia tahajia sahihi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kuandika sentensi na kumtumia mwalimu mtandaoni. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika sentensi akizingatia tahajia sahihi. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kutunga sententensi sahihi. Maadili: ● Heshima na umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kuandika sentensi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi alizotunga kwa kuzingatia tahajia sahihi. Masuala Mtambuko: ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anaposoma sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa k.v. vyakula vinavyotumiwa nyumbani. ● Upataji wa pesa - mwanafunzi anaposoma sentensi zenye tahajia sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa k.v. uuzaji wa vyakula. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia tahajia.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.sub_strand: 8.4.1 Matumizi ya hiki na hivi Vipindi 3
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 8.4.1 Matumizi ya hiki na hivi Vipindi 3. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno hiki na hivi katika vifungu, b) kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha maneno hiki na hivi ili kuonyeshea ifaavyo, c) kutumia maneno hiki na hivi kuonyeshea vitu katika mazingira yake, d) kuchangamkia matumizi ya hiki na hivi katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua hiki na hivi kwa kutumia nyenzo halisi, kadi za majina, kapu maneno au chati, ● kusikiliza kifungu kinachohusu matumizi ya hiki na hivi katika kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha hiki na hivi kisha abainishe matumizi ya hiki na hivi, ● kuonyesha vitu mbalimbali kama vile vyakula na kuvitungia sentensi katika kikundi k.m. chakula hiki – vyakula hivi, ● kumtungia mwenzake sentensi katika kikundi kwa kutumia hiki na hivi, ● kutoa maoni kuhusu sentensi zilizotungwa na wenzake, ● kukamilisha vifungu vyenye mapengo kwa kutumia hiki na hivi wakiwa wawiliwawili k.m. chakula (hiki, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unajua majina yapi ya vitu vinavyoweza kuashiriwa kwa kutumia maneno hiki na hivi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapochangia kikamilifu katika kikundi kwa kutunga sentensi akitumia hiki na hivi. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposhirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua vitu nyumbani na katika jamii vinavyoweza kuashiriwa kwa kutumia hiki na hivi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kujifunzia matumizi ya hiki na hivi. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia hiki na hivi kwa kurejelea vitu katika mazingira yake. ● Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia hiki na hivi ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi kufanya zoezi kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali na kukitunza ipasavyo. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga sentensi. ● Amani - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu kutunga sentensi. Masuala mtambuko: ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu vyakula k.v. vyakula vinavyotumiwa nyumbani. ● Elimu ya pesa - mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu vyakula k.v. uuzaji wa vyakula. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language activities – masomo haya pia yanafunza kuhusu vionyeshi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 9.1.1 Mazungumzo. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua suala lengwa ili azungumze kulihusu, b) kuzungumza kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora na ishara zifaazo, c) kujieleza kwa ujasiri, kasi ifaayo na sauti inayosikika, d) kuchangamkia mazungumzo na matamshi bora katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusikiliza mazungumzo mafupi kuhusu suala lengwa kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kutazama video kuhusu mazungumzo yanayohusisha watoto, ● kuwasilisha mazungumzo yake kwa wenzake katika kikundi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora na ishara zifaazo, ● kujieleza kwa ujasiri, kasi ifaayo na sauti inayosikika, ● kusikiliza mazungumzo ya wenzake na kutoa maoni. ● kushiriki katika mazungumzo kwa kuzingatia maagizo atakayopewa na mwalimu, ● kujieleza kwa ujasiri ili kufanikisha mawasiliano akiwa na mzazi au mlezi jikoni. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unapenda kuzungumza kuhusu mambo gani ukiwa na wenzako? 2. Unazingatia mambo gani unapozungumz a mbele ya wenzako? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuwasilisha mazungumzo mbele yao. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kuzungumza mbele ya wenzake kwa ujasiri kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kujifunza mazungumzo. ● Uraia – mwanafunzi anapoingiliana na wenzake kwa kikundi. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kuzungumzia mada mbalimbali nyumbani na katika jamii kwa kuzingatia vigezo husika. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowapatia wenzake nafasi kushiriki katika mazungumzo. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika mazungumzo. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kitazama video. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake katika mazungumzo na kuwapa nafasi. Masuala mtambuko: ● Mshikamano wa kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Elimu ya pesa – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa akielezwa na mwalimu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya yananashughulikia mazungumzo

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, b) kutabiri yatakayotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu kwa kuzingatia picha, c) kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, d) kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu, e) kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 23-30 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v. kisu, kikombe, meko, sahani ) akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano, ● kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma, ● kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, tunaweza kujifunza mambo yapi kutokana na hadithi mbalimbali? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutambua ujumbe katika kifungu. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. ● Uraia - mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapofanya mazoezi ya ziada ya kusoma ufahamu akiwa nyumbani. ● Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapotabiri matukio ya hadithi kwa kutazama picha. Maadili ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadiliana. ● Heshima – anapowaheshimu wenzake wanaposhirikiana kusoma kifungu darasani. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusoma. ● Amani - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kusoma. Masuala mtambuko: ● Elimu ya pesa – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu shughuli za jikoni k.v. ununuzi wa vitu vya jikoni na bei yake kutokana na suala lengwa. ● Mshikamano ya kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo kuhusu suala lengwa k.v. vifaa vya jikoni. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous languages Activities – masomo haya pia hushughulikia mada ya kusoma.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 9.3.1 Kifungu kutokana na Picha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutazama picha na kutambua yaliyomo, b) kuandika kifungu kuhusu yaliyomo katika picha, c) kufurahia kuandika kifungu kutokana na yaliyomo katika picha. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutazama picha na kutambua wahusika, walipo wahusika na matendo yao akiwa peke, ● kuandika daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali kifungu cha sentensi mbili kutokana na picha aliyoitazama, ● kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi kifungu alichokiandika ili ampe maoni yake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni ujumbe upi unaoweza kuutoa kutokana na picha baada ya kuitazama? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua yaliyomo katika picha. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika kifungu akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kusoma picha na kuandika kinachoendelea katika picha hiyo. Maadili: ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika ujifunzaji. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali na anapoandika ifaavyo. Masuala mtambuko: ● Jinsi ya kupata pesa – mwanafunzi anapotazama picha kuhusu suala lengwa. ● Matumizi yafaayo ya vitu nyumbani – mwanafunzi anapotazama picha na kutambua vifaa vya jikoni. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia stadi ya kuandika. Kuwahamasisha wenzake nyumbani kufasiri picha na kuandika kifungu

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 9.4.1 Matumizi ya maneno yanayoashiria vitendo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada, mwanafunzi aweze; a) kutambua maneno yanayoashiria vitendo katika kifungu na mawasiliano mbalimbali, b) kusoma maneno yanayoashiria vitendo ili kujenga usomaji bora,, c) kutumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo katika sentensi ipasavyo d) kufurahia kutumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua maneno yanayoashiria vitendo katika kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali, ● kutaja mambo aliyofanya siku hiyo kama vile, kula, kuvaa, kupika, kuwasha, kuosha, pakua , ● kuigiza vitendo k.m. kula, kunywa, keti, simama, nawa, choma , ● kusoma maneno yanayoashiria vitendo ili kujenga usomaji bora, ● kukamilisha sentensi akitumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo, ● kutunga sentensi zenye matumizi ya maneno yanayoashiria vitendo, ● kumtungia mwenzake katika kikundi sentesi kwa kutumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo, ● kufanya zoezi la kujaza mapengo katika madaftari yao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni mambo yapi uliyofanya tangu jana? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika utunzi wa sentensi na wenzake katika kikundi. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotungia mwenzake sentensi kwa kutumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapofanya zoezi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo. Maadili: ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi kwa kutumia maneno yanayoashiria vitendo. ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi za kutungiana sentensi. ● Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoigiza vitendo akiwa na mwenzake huku akizingatia maslahi ya mwenzake k.v. ikiwa mwenzake ana mahitaji maalumu. Masuala Mtambuko: ● Kujithamini – mwanafunzi anapomtungia mwenzake sentensi, ukakamavu wake unajengeka. ● Uraia – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi ● Matumizi ya pesa – mwanafunzi anapojifunza vitendo k.v. nunua. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya vitenzi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 10.1.1 Mata mshi Bora (Vipin di 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kadi maneno, b) kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo ili kuimarisha mazungumzo, c) kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa ipasavyo, d) kutamka ipasavyo maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa, e) kuchangamkia SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushiriki katika kutambua sauti lengwa (/ny/, /dh/, /th/, /ch/, /gh/, /ng/, /ng’/) katika kadi maneno, ● kutumia teknolojia (k.v. papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa, ● kusikiliza mwalimu au mgeni mwalikwa akitamka sauti lengwa, ● kutamka sauti pamoja na mwalimu, ● kutamka sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutambua majina ya herufi zinazowakilisha sauti lengwa kwa kutumia kadi za herufi, ● kutamka herufi za sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni majina yapi ya sauti /ny/,/dh/,/th/,/ ch/, /gh/,/ng/, /ng’/unayojua kutamka? nafasi ya matamshi bora katika mawasiliano. kidijitali k.v. kinasasauti na rununu, ● kutamka silabi alizozisikiliza ipasavyo akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutamka maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa ipasavyo. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutamka sauti na maneno yenye sauti lengwa. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia teknolojia kujifunzia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotamka sauti na silabi ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujifunza matamshi ya sauti lengwa, silabi na maneno. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake ya sauti mbalimbali. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa. ● Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa kwa utulivu. Masuala mtambuko: ● Mshikamano wa kijamii- mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanya kazi ya kikundi. ● Masuala ya afya – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno yanayohusu sula lengwa. ● Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anapojifunza kutokana na suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia dhana ya matamshi bora.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi, b) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika, d) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi Ifaayo, e) kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutambua sauti lengwa (/ny/, /dh/, /th/, /ch/, /gh/, /ng/, /ng’/ ) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akiwa peke yake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti akiwa peke yake, ● kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 30 kwa dakika na kwa kizingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, tunafaa kufanya nini tunapowasomea wengine kitabu kwa sauti? zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. ● kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, n.k akishirikiana na wenzake akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, ● kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposoma silabi, maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa pamoja na wenzake katika kikundi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia teknolojia kujifunzia. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa ipasavyo. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujifunza matamshi ya sauti lengwa, silabi na maneno. ● Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake ya sauti mbalimbali. ● Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa. ● Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali. ● Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutamka na kurekebishana matamshi ya sauti lengwa kwa utulivu. Masuala mtambuko: Elimu ya pesa – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu siku za wiki k.v. siku ya michezo, kutokana na suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Actitivies – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia mada kuhusu kusoma.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 10.3.1 Kifungu kutokana na picha (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutazama picha na kutambua yaliyomo, b) kuandika kifungu kuhusu yaliyomo katika picha, c) kufurahia kuandika kifungu kutokana na yaliyomo katika picha. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kutazama picha kuhusu suala lengwa na kutambua wahusika na matendo yao akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kueleza wenzake katika kikundi wahusika ni nani na wanafanya nini, ● kuandika kifungu cha sentensi mbili kutokana na picha aliyoitazama, ● kuwasomea wenzake sentensi alizoandika kuhusu picha, ● kunakili sentensi alizoandika kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali, ● kuandika kifungu kwa kurejelea baadhi ya picha zinazopatikana nyumbani. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unapenda picha zinazohusu vitu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu katika kueleza yaliyomo katika picha. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika kifungu akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. Masuala mtambuko: Kujithamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika kifungu kutokana na picha. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yana mada kuhusu kuandika.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitendo (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vinyume vya vitendo katika kifungu chepesi mbalimbali, b) kutumia majina ya vinyume vya vitendo katika katika mawasiliano, c) kuchangamkia kutumia vitendo na vinyume vyake katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kusoma maneno ya vitendo na vinyume vyake akishirikiana na wenzake, ● kutambua vinyume vya vitendo (kama vile, lala-amka; keti- simama; cheka-lia; enda-rudi; panda – shuka) katika kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati, kapu la maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali ● kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza matumizi ya vinyume vya vitendo k.v. katika kifungu kinachosomwa, ● kuigiza vinyume vya vitendo akiwa katika kikundi, ● kushirikishwa kutaja majina ya vinyume vya vitendo, ● kuandika vinyume vya vitendo. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je,vinyume gani vya vitendo unavyofanya kila siku? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa: ● Mawisiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kushiriki kikamilifu katika kuigiza vinyume vya vitendo. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya teknolojia kusikiliza matumizi ya vinyume vya vitendo. ● Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya vinyume vya vitendo mbalimbali. Maadili: ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. ● Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anapowajibikia majukumu aliyopewa katika shughuli za kikundi. Masuala mtambuko: Kujitambua – mwanafunzi anapoigiza vinyume vya vitendo mbele ya wenzake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yana mada kuhusu vinyume. maneno kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho wa insha. inayofaa baina ya maneno. baina ya maneno.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.1 Pre-Number Activities (20 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) sort objects according to similar attributes in different situations, b) match objects with similar attributes in the environment, c) order objects according to given criteria in different situations, d) create patterns of different sizes and shapes using real objects, e) appreciate the use of sorting and grouping items in day-to-day activities. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, collect different types of safe objects from the immediate environment, ● group objects according to attributes such as size, colour, use, shape and texture, ● pair objects with similar attributes such as size, colour, use, shape and texture, ● arrange objects according to size from smallest to biggest and from biggest to smallest, ● make patterns of different shapes and sizes using real objects, ● in pairs/groups, assist in arranging items like fruits, cereals, for example beans, maize and rice according to size, colour, shape and storage at home. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can we group objects? 2. How can we arrange objects? Core Competencies to be developed: ● Critical thinking and problem solving: learners complete tasks by following instructions as they sort objects according to size, colour, use, shape and texture and make patterns of different shapes and sizes using real objects. ● Self-efficacy: learners make use of opportunities to assist in arranging items according to size, colour, shape and storage at home. Values: ● Unity: learners collaborate with others as they pair and match objects according to size, colour and shape. ● Responsibility: learners engage in assigned roles as they assist in arranging items according to size, colour, shape and storage at home. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Learners observe safety as they collect different objects from the immediate environment to enhance safety issues. Link to other learning areas: Learners utilise creative skills acquired from Creative Activities to create patterns of different sizes and shapes using real objects.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Whole Numbers (25 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) count numbers forward up to 50, b) count numbers backwards from 30, c) represent numbers 1 to 30 using concrete objects, d) read and write numbers 1 to 50 in symbols, e) read and write numbers 1 to 10 in words, f) identify missing numbers SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, collect concrete objects from the immediate environment to use in counting activities, ● in pairs/groups, count by 1’s and 2’s up to 20 starting from any point using concrete objects such as number cards, as well as body parts, ● take turns in counting numbers forward up to 50, ● in pairs/groups, count numbers backwards from 30, ● in pairs/groups, play games that involve KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: In what ways can we count from 1 to 20? in number patterns up to 20, g) appreciate number patterns by creating and extending patterns during play activities. representing numbers 1 to 30 using concrete objects, ● in pairs/groups, read and write numbers 1 to 50 in symbols, ● practice writing numbers 1 to 10 in words, ● fill in missing numbers in number patterns up to 20, ● in pairs/groups, create patterns with numbers up to 20 and share with other groups, ● play games involving whole numbers using digital devices or other resources. Core Competencies to be developed: ● Digital literacy: learners use digital devices to play games involving numbers 1 to 50. ● Creativity and imagination: learners generate new ideas to create patterns with numbers up to 20. Values: ● Respect: learners understand and appreciate peers as they take turns in counting numbers forward up to 50. ● Unity: learners take turns in activities as they take turns in counting numbers forward up to 50. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners count by 1’s and 2’s up to 20 starting from any point using concrete objects such as number cards, in groups to enhance social cohesion. ● Learners observe safety when collecting concrete objects from the immediate environment to enhance environmental safety. Link to other learning areas:  Learners apply environmental safety rules learned from Environmental Activities to safely collect concrete objects from the immediate environment to use in counting activities.  Learners apply creative skills acquired from Creative Activities to create patterns with numbers up to 20.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.3 Addition (25 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) model addition as putting objects together, b) use ' +' and ' =' signs in writing addition statements, c) add 2 single digit numbers in different situations, d) add 3 single digit numbers in different contexts, e) add a 2 digit number to a 1 digit number without regrouping with sum not exceeding 50, f) work out missing numbers in patterns involving addition of whole numbers up to 50, g) play games involving addition using digital devices or other resources. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, safely put two groups of objects together and count to get the total, ● use ' + ' and ' = ' signs in writing addition statements, ● add 2 single digit numbers by counting on, ● add 3 single digit numbers using concrete objects, ● add 3 single digit numbers by counting on, ● add a 2 digit number to a 1 digit number without regrouping horizontally and vertically with sum not exceeding 50, ● in pairs/groups, make number patterns involving addition with numbers up to 50, ● play games involving addition using digital devices and other resources. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you add a 2 digit number to a 1 digit number? Core competencies to be developed: ● Creativity and imagination: learners generate different ideas to make number patterns involving addition. Values: Responsibility: learners engage in assigned roles and duties as they in pairs/groups, make number patterns involving addition with numbers up to 50. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners safely put two groups of objects together and count to get the total to enhance safety in the learning environment. ● Learners creatively make number patterns involving addition with numbers up to 50 to enhance creative thinking. Link to other learning areas: Learners apply speaking and listening skills from Language Activities to effectively communicate to peers as they play games involving addition.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.4 Subtraction (20 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) model subtraction as 'taking away' using concrete objects, b) use the ' - ' and '='signs in writing subtraction sentences, c) subtract single digit numbers, d) subtract a 1 digit number from a 2 digit number without regrouping, e) work out missing numbers in patterns involving subtraction of whole numbers up to 50, f) play games involving subtraction using digital devices and other resources. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, model subtraction using concrete objects, ● use ' - ' and '=' signs in writing subtraction sentences, ● in pairs/groups, subtract by counting backwards, ● in pairs/groups, subtract using concrete objects, ● create subtraction sentences related to basic addition facts, ● use number cards or charts safely to workout subtraction of a 1 digit number from a 2 digit number, ● in pairs /groups, create patterns involving subtraction. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you subtract a one digit number from a two digit number? Core Competencies to be developed: ● Learning to learn: learners learn different ways of doing subtraction as they subtract numbers by counting backwards and use number cards or charts to work out subtraction. ● Creativity and imagination: learners imagine and create patterns involving subtraction. Values: ● Responsibility: learners take care of concrete objects used in subtraction. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners work harmoniously in groups to create patterns involving subtraction to enhance social cohesion. ● Learners work out subtraction by counting backwards to enhance critical thinking. Link to other learning areas: ● Learners utilise creative skills acquired in Creative Activities to create patterns involving subtraction. ● Learners apply speaking and listening skills from Language Activities to communicate to peers as they model subtraction using concrete objects.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Length (10 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) collect objects of different lengths from the immediate environment, b) compare length of objects using longer than, shorter than and same as, c) measure length using arbitrary units, d) appreciate measuring length using arbitrary units. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/ groups, collect objects of different lengths from the immediate environment, ● in pairs/ groups, compare objects directly to identify objects which are longer than, shorter than or same as other objects, ● in pairs/ groups, measure lengths using arbitrary units such as hand spans or walking steps and discuss the measurements from the various groups, ● in pairs/ groups, use arbitrary units to measure lengths of different objects in their immediate environment. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you compare the length of two objects? 2. What can be used to measure the length of the teacher’s table? Core competencies to be developed:  Self-efficacy: learners portray self-confidence as they use arbitrary units to measure lengths of different objects in their immediate environment.  Communication and collaboration: learners speak clearly, listen keenly and support peers as they measure and discuss lengths using arbitrary units. Values: ● Responsibility: learners take care of objects collected from the environment for use in measuring length. ● Peace: learners display tolerance as they measure lengths using arbitrary units such as hand spans or walking steps in groups. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners display tolerance as they measure lengths using arbitrary units such as hand spans or walking steps in groups to enhance positive discipline. ● Learners work harmoniously in groups as they measure lengths using arbitrary units to enhance social cohesion. Link to other learning areas: Learners utilise speaking and listening skills acquired from Language Activities to effectively communicate to peers as they discuss lengths using arbitrary units.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurements. SUB-STRAND: 2.2 Mass (10 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) collect objects with different mass from the immediate environment, b) compare mass of two objects using heavier than, lighter than or same as, c) measure mass using arbitrary units, d) appreciate measuring mass using arbitrary units in the environment. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● collect safe objects of different mass from their immediate environment, ● in groups, discuss and use safe objects to identify those heavier than, lighter than or same as, ● in groups, use an identified empty container of known mass to measure the mass of other objects such as mass of beans, maize or flour as accurately as possible, ● play games involving mass using digital devices. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can you compare the mass of two or more objects? 2. How can you show that an object is heavier than, lighter than or same as your mathematics textbook? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: learners listen and contribute in discussing how to identify objects that are heavier, lighter or have the same mass.  Digital literacy: learners use digital devices to play games involving mass. Values:  Unity: learners appreciate the effort of others as they work in groups to measure the mass of different items.  Respect: learner is open minded as they discuss and use safe objects to identify those heavier than, lighter than or same as. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs):  Learners observe safety as they collect objects of different mass from their immediate environment to enhance safety in the environment.  Learners listen and contribute in discussing how to identify objects that are heavier, lighter or have the same mass to enhance effective communication. Links to other learning areas:  Learners apply environmental safety skills from Environmental Activities to safely collect objects from their immediate environment.  Learners apply listening and speaking skills from Language Activities to discuss how to identify objects that are heavier, lighter or have the same mass.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.3 Capacity (12 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) collect containers of different capacities from the immediate environment, b) compare capacity of two containers using more than, less than and same as, c) measure capacity using arbitrary units, d) re-use empty containers of different capacities to keep items. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, collect safe containers of different sizes from the environment, ● in pairs/groups, empty and fill water in different containers to establish which holds more, which holds less and which holds the same, ● in pairs/groups, fill basins with water using different small containers. The learners to count the number of small containers they use to fill the basin, ● in pairs/groups, discuss and re-use containers of different capacity at home and school to keep items. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can we find out which of two containers hold more, less or same as? Core Competencies to be developed: ● Learning to learn: learners discover ways of determining capacity of containers as they fill basins with water using different small containers. ● Critical thinking and problem solving: learners explore solutions as they reuse containers of different capacities at home and at school. Values: Responsibility: learners take care of containers they use to measure capacity and re-use containers to keep items at home and school. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners reuse containers of different capacity at home and school to keep items to enhance environmental safety. Link to other learning areas: Learners relate environmental safety in Environmental Activities to reuse of containers of different capacity at home and school.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.4 Time (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify days of the week, b) relate days of the week to various activities, c) identify months of the year, d) appreciate activities that are done on different days of the week. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● sing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week, ● tell and write days of the week the way they follow each other, ● in pairs/groups, identify activities that take place during the days of the week such as raising flag on Monday and Friday, ● in groups, sing songs/rhymes related to the months of the year, ● discuss and tell their birth month. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Which day of the week do you raise the school flag? 2. Which day of the week do you worship? Core competencies to be developed: ● Self-efficacy: learners persist and show interest in singing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week. ● Communication and collaboration: learners speak clearly, listens and understand peers as they discuss and tell their birth month Values: ● Peace: learners harmoniously sing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week together. ● Patriotism: learners are aware of their own culture as they identify activities that take place during the days of the week. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners identify activities that take place during the days of the week such as raising flags on Monday and Friday to enhance citizenship. ● Learners harmoniously sing songs/ rhymes related to days of the week together to enhance social cohesion. Link to other learning areas: Learners relate singing songs/rhymes related to days of the week and months of the year to performance in Creative Activities.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.5 Money (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify Kenyan currency coins, b) identify Kenyan currency note up to sh.50, c) count Kenyan currency coins one at a time, d) use money in buying up to 2 items without balance, e) appreciate the use of money in buying items from shops. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● in pairs/groups, recognise and sort out different Kenyan currency coins sh.1, sh.5, sh.10, sh.20 and sh.40 according to their value, ● in pairs/groups, recognise a sh.50 note and tell its value, ● in pairs/groups, tell how many coins of sh.1, sh.5, sh.10, sh.20, sh. 40 by counting, ● discuss the price of items in the model classroom shop up to sh.50, ● in groups to role play buying up to 2 items from the model classroom shop without balance. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you identify Kenyan currency coins and notes? Core competencies to be developed: ● Citizenship: learners recognize and sort out different Kenyan currency coins and notes according to their value. ● Self-efficacy: learners look for opportunities to learn as they role play buying up to 2 items from the model classroom shop. Values: ● Integrity: learners display honesty as they role play buying up to 2 items from the model classroom shop and pay the correct money. ● Patriotism: learners aware of own culture as they recognise different Kenyan currency coins and notes. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Learners recognize and sort out different Kenyan currency coins sh.1, sh.5, sh.10, sh.20 and sh.40 according to their value to enhance financial literacy. Link to other learning areas: ● Learners relate the value of honesty as they role play buying up to 2 items from the model classroom shop and pay the correct money to the virtues taught in Religious Activities. ● Learners apply speaking and listening skills acquired in Language Activities to discuss the price of items in the model classroom.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Geometry. SUB-STRAND: 3.1 Lines (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify straight lines in different situations, b) draw straight lines on different surfaces, c) identify curved lines in different situations, d) draw curved lines on different surfaces, e) recognise straight and curved lines from real objects in the environment. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● stand behind one another facing the same side and identify what they have formed as a straight line, ● in pairs/groups, mark two points on the ground and use a stick to join the two points to make a straight line, ● practise drawing straight lines on the ground and in their books, ● in groups, form a semicircle, draw a line around it and identify the line drawn as a curved line, ● practise drawing curved lines on the ground and in their books, ● in groups, observe and identify lines from different objects in the environment. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you make a line? Values: ● Unity: learners appreciate the effort of peers as they in groups, observe and identify lines from different objects in the environment. ● Peace: learners follow instructions as they stand behind one another facing the same side to form a straight line. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Learners work harmoniously in groups as they mark two points on the ground and use a stick to join the two points to make a straight line to enhance social cohesion. Link to other learning areas: Learners apply drawing skills from Creative Activities to draw straight and curved lines.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Geometry. SUB-STRAND: 3.2 Shapes (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify rectangles, triangles and circles in objects from the environment, b) make patterns involving rectangles, triangles, and circles, c) appreciate the beauty of patterns in different fabrics. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: The learners are guided to: Values: ● Peace: learners display tolerance as they work in groups to make and colour patterns. ● Integrity: learners are committed to duty as they work individually to make patterns of their choice using the three shapes. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): ● Learners observe safety as they use objects from the environment to recognize different shapes such as rectangles, triangles and circles to enhance safety. ● Learners work harmoniously in groups to make and colour patterns to enhance social cohesion. Link to other learning areas: ● Learners apply drawing and colouring skills from Creative Activities to draw and colour patterns ● Learners apply environmental safety rules from Environmental Activities to safely use objects from the environment to recognize different shapes such as rectangles, triangles and circles.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.1 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary ( 2 Lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) distinguish words with the target letter -sound combinations in conversations, b) use vocabulary related to the theme to communicate in various contexts, c) respond to specific simple two- directional instructions using new words in oral communication, d) realize the importance of listening attentively and pronouncing words correctly for effective communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to audio-visual recordings of songs, story/teacher read aloud stories, among others, with the target letter –sound combination,  pick words with the target letter – sound combination: o bl as in blue, o sp as in spoon, o sc as in school, o sk as in sky, o ck –as in kick,  practice using the target letter-sound combinations to form word,  construct simple sentences using new words,  develop a talking tree collaboratively with peers using the new words,  respond to two-directional instructions without interrupting as modeled by the teacher or peers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why should we listen attentively when other people are talking? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and actively is enhanced as they listen to conversations and distinguish words with the target-letter sound combinations. Values: Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates diverse opinions from peers during discussions. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life-skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is enhanced as they name the things found in the school environment. Link to other Learning Areas: The learner applies attentive listening skills to the learning of concepts in other learning areas.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.2 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 1.2.1 Fluency (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand the learner should be able to: a) recognize words with the target letter-sound combinations for ease of reading, b) read a grade-appropriate text with the target letter-sound combinations at the right speed, expressively and accurately, c) realise the importance of reading fluently in a variety of genres. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  watch a video clip/listen to an audio recording/teacher model of the target sounds,  pick out words featuring the target letter- sound combinations: bl, sp, sc, sk, ck,  practise sitting in the appropriate posture, hold a book in the right position and turn the pages carefully while reading,  read short texts observing stress and intonation,  engage in timed reading (65 words per minute) displaying the right expressions. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why should we read at the right speed? 2. Why should we read a text accurately? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise reading texts at the right speed, expressively and accurately on their own. Values: Responsibility is enhanced as the learner takes cares of books by holding them in the right position and turning the pages carefully while reading. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they acquire reading fluency skills. Link to other Learning Areas: The learner applies reading fluency skills acquired when reading texts in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.2 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 1.2.2 Comprehension (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) make predictions and anticipate possible outcomes in a story for comprehension, b) use contextual clues to infer meaning of vocabulary words related to the theme, c) answer direct and indirect questions for comprehension, d) realize the importance of reading for lifelong learning. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss pictures and the title of a text with peers and make predictions,  read a text and locate phrases and sentences to get the meaning of new words,  locate sentences containing answers to direct questions,  interact with the text and answer indirect questions using contextual clues. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do pictures help us to know what the story is about? 2. How do we get the meaning of words from a text? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication: The learner’s ability to speak engagingly is enhanced as they argue out their points clearly during group discussions. Collaboration: Teamwork is enhanced as the learner actively takes part in activities with peers observing the rules of engagement. Values: Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates diverse opinions from peers during discussions. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is enhanced as they become aware of the appropriate reading posture. Link to other Learning Areas: The learner uses comprehension strategies learnt when reading texts in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.3 Language Use. SUB-STRAND: 1.3.1 The verb ‘to be’ (is, are) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recognize the correct use of the verbs to be is and are in sentences, b) use the present tense forms of the verb ‘to be’ correctly, to construct simple sentences, c) adopt the use of the present tense forms of the verb ‘to be’ in their day-to-day conversation. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a story, poem or conversation from audio recording/ teacher model containing is and are,  identify sentences showing present tense forms of the verb ‘to be’ from the text,  describe own and other learners’ demonstrated actions using is and are,  ask and answer questions using is and are, collaboratively with peers observing turn taking,  practise the use of is and are during role play, language games or songs. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we talk about what is happening at the present? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is enhanced as they use the present form of the verb ‘to be’ in communication. Collaboration: Teamwork is enhanced as the learner collaborates with others in role play activities and language games observing the rules of engagement. Values: Respect: Patience is achieved as the learner waits patiently to take turns during the question and answer activities. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Life skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they communicate effectively using the verb ‘to be’. Link to other Learning areas: The learner applies the knowledge of the present form of the verb ‘to be’ to learning of similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Writing. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.1 Handwriting (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recognise descenders in long words in a text, b) form all descenders correctly in long words, legibly and neatly for correct word formation, c) realise the importance of writing long words correctly, legibly and neatly for different purposes. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  watch videos on how to write long words with descenders from a digital device, or as modelled by the teacher or peers and identify descenders in long words in a text,  copy long words forming all the descenders correctly, legibly and neatly,  write words with descenders from a dictation correctly, legibly and neatly,  write long words related to the theme in response to a picture prompts. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why should we write clearly? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise forming all the descenders correctly on their own. Values: Responsibility: Self- drive is achieved as the learner ensures their writing is neat and legible through practice. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Learner Support Programmes (Peer Education and Mentorship): The learner’s interpersonal skills are enhanced as they demonstrate how to write correctly to peers. Link to other learning areas: The learner uses the skills of good handwriting to write clearly and legibly in other learning areas.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.1 Listening And Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 2.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary (2 lessons).
