Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners discuss items used in the purification of najasa in pairs or small groups and present in class  Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of explanation is enhanced as learners discuss items used in the purification of najasa in pairs or small groups and present in class  Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge as learners demonstrate how to purify different najasaat individually/in pairs/in groups Values:  Responsibility: enhanced as learners demonstrate how to purify different najasaat individually/in pairs/in groups PCIs: Health Issues: Personal hygiene through maintenance of ritual cleanliness. Links to other Subjects: Agriculture and Nutrition as learners observe and maintain cleanliness.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 DEVOTIONAL ACTS. SUB-STRAND: 4.1.2 Wudhu (Ablution) (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the nullifiers of wudhu (Ablution) so as to maintain a state of ritual purity. b) assess the significance of wudhu in the life of a Muslim, c) value the need to be in a state of purity as a condition for ibadah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  search for nullifiers of wudhu (Ablution) using digital devices/from resource books and write in their notebook,  discuss times recommended to be in a state of wudhu and present in class,  discuss the importance of maintaining wudhu in pairs or groups and be guided to write the points in their notebook. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What nullifies wudhu? 2. Why is it important to be in a state of wudhu? 3. When is it recommended to be in a state of wudhu? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing is enhanced as learners search for nullifiers of wudhu (Ablution) using digital devices/from resource books and write in their notebook  Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication skills is enhanced as learners discuss times recommended to be in a state of wudhu and present in class  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology as learners search for nullifiers of wudhu (Ablution) using digital devices Values:  Unity cooperation enhanced as learners discuss the importance of maintaining wudhu in pairs or groups  Responsibility Hard work enhanced as learners search for nullifiers of wudhu (Ablution) using digital devices/from resource books and write in their notebook PCIs: Personal hygiene as learners perform wudhu

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 DEVOTIONAL ACTS. SUB-STRAND: 4.2 Conditions for Swalah (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the conditions for Swalah as a requirement for its validity, b) demonstrate the observable conditions for swalah in day-to-day life, c) acknowledge the need for observing the condition for swalah for its validity. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  mention the nine conditions for swalah and be guide to write them in their 1. notebook,  discuss the conditions for Swalah in pairs or groups and present in class,,demonstrate some of the conditions for swalah such as wudhu, appropriate dress code individually,  demonstrate appropriate use of digital devices/direction of the sun in identifying direction of Qibla individually/in pair/groups,  discuss how to determine times for swalah in pairs /groups and present in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How would you identify time for swalah and direction of Qibla Core Competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as demonstrate appropriate use of digital devices in identifying direction of Qibla  Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced as learners demonstrate appropriate use of digital devices/direction of the sun in identifying direction of Qibla individually/in pair/groups Values:  Responsibility accountability enhanced as learners demonstrate some of the conditions for swalah such as wudhu, appropriate dress code individually  Unity cooperation is enhanced as learners work together discuss the conditions for swalah in pairs or groups and present in class  Respect patience enhanced as learners respect each other opinion as the discuss how to determine times for swalah in pairs /groups and present in class PCIs: Health issues: Personal hygiene as a requirement for swalah; Life skill: Self-esteem through the performance of swalah appropriately. Links to Other Subjects: Social Studies as learners learn on finding directions on the compass

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 DEVOTIONAL ACTS. SUB-STRAND: 4.3 Pillars of Swalah (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) explain the pillars of swalah as a requirement for its validity, b) apply the pillars of swalah correctly in daily prayers, c) appreciate the need for observing the pillars of swalah by emulating the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss the pillars of swalah in pairs/groups and write them in their notebook,  role play the pillars of swalah individually/in pairs/in groups,  watch a video clip of pillars of swalah on digital device,  demonstrate the pillars of swalah individually/in pairs/in groups. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What do you recite when praying? 2. Which postures are performed in prayers? Core Competencies to be developed:  Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners discuss the pillars of swalah in pairs/groups and be guided to write them in their notebook  Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing and speaking is enhanced as learners discuss the pillars of swalah in pairs/groups and be guided to write them in their notebook  Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners role play the pillars of swalah individually/in pairs/in groups Values:  Responsibility accountability enhanced as learners role play the pillars of swalah individually/in pairs/in groups  Unity cooperation enhanced as learners demonstrates the pillars of swalah in pairs/groups Links to Other Subjects: Creative Arts as learners observe the pillars of swalah which is part of exercise

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 AKHLAQ (MORAL VALUES). SUB-STRAND: 5.1 Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) assess the significance of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures in the environment, b) demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah, c) appreciate Allah’s creatures by showing kindness to them. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  mention creatures of Allah (S.W.T.) in their environment,  discuss the significance of being kind to Allah’s creatures in pairs/groups and write the points in their note book,  watch on digital devices/charts/photos appropriate ways of caring for Allah’s creatures (animals/insects/plants/fish),  dramatise ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are some of Allah’s creatures in your environment? 2. Why should you be kind to Allah’s creatures? 3. How can you show kindness to Allah’s creatures? Core Competencies to be developed:  Learning to Learn: the skill of working collaboratively is enhanced as learners discuss the significance of being kind to Allah’s creatures in pairs/groups  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners watch digital devices on appropriate ways of caring to Allah’s creatures  Communication and collaboration: the skill of speaking and writing is enhanced as learners discuss the significance of being kind to Allah’s creatures in pairs/groups and guided to write the points in their note book  Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners dramatize ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures. Values:  Social justice: responsibility enhanced as learners dramatize ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures  Responsibility: accountability enhanced as learners watch on digital devices/charts/photos appropriate ways of caring for Allah’s creatures  Respect: patience enhanced as learners respect each other view when discussing the significance of being kind to Allah’s creatures in pairs/groups Links to Other Subjects: Agriculture and Nutrition as learners care for animals

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 AKHLAQ (MORAL VALUES). SUB-STRAND: 5.2 Islamic Manners of Dressing (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam, b) assess the significance of Islamic code of dressing to enhance character formation, c) observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah, d) appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The Learner is guided to:  identify features of the Islamic code of dressing,  watch video clip on a digital device/observe charts/photos of different Islamic attires,  discuss the significance of the Islamic code of dress in pairs or in groups and presents in class,  model an ideal Islamic dress in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How should a Muslim dress? 2. What is the importance of the Islamic code of dress? 3. What are some of the dressing trends that should be avoided by a Muslim? Core Competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners watches video clip on a digital device on different Islamic attires  Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking is enhanced as learners discuss the significance of the Islamic code of dress in pairs or in groups and presents in class  Creativity and imagination: the skill of making observations is enhanced as learners model Islamic dress in class. Values:  Respect is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinions during group discussion PCIs: Life skills: Assertiveness by dressing as per the Islamic code Links to Other Subjects:

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 AKHLAQ (MORAL VALUES). SUB-STRAND: 5.3 Positive Usage of Media (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify types of media in the environment so as to reinforce learning, b) explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation, c) observe Islamic ethics while using media in day- to-day life, d) appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  identify different types of media in their environment print media, Internet media (laptops/desktops, videogames, PlayStation), broadcast (TV, Radio and movies) media, mobile phones  watch video clips on positive use of media,  listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media,  discuss the positive and negative uses of media in pairs/ groups and present in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What types of media do you use at home? 2. How can you use media positively? 3. How can you use media while observing Islamic teachings? Core Competencies to be developed  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology enhances as learners watch video clips on positive use of media  Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening is enhanced as learners listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media Values:  Responsibility is enhanced as learners discuss the positive and negative uses of media in pairs/ groups and present in class  Integrity is enhanced as learners listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media PCIs: Assertiveness in the proper use of the media. Links to Other Subjects: Science and technology as learners search, download and store information from the internet

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 5.4 Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Begging
chunks.text: STRAND: AKHLAQ (MORAL VALUES). SUB-STRAND: 5.4 Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Begging (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify categories of people who deserve, assistance in the society. b) describe the evils of begging as a mean of fostering a work ethic, c) appreciate work as an act of ibadah and a means of eradicating poverty. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The Learner is guided to:  identify categories of people deserving support (i.e. debtors, those who loose property through disaster and destitute),  discuss evils of begging according to the teachings of Islam in pair/groups and present in class,  discuss ways of earning income/ generating income in pairs/groups present in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why do people beg? 2. Why is begging discouraged? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking as learners discuss evils of begging according to the teachings of Islam in pair/groups and present in class Values:  Responsibility enhanced as learners discuss evils of begging according to the teachings of Islam in pair/groups and present in class.  Integrity is enhanced as learners discuss ways of earning income/ generating income in pairs/groups present in class PCIs: Life skills: Self-awareness to avoid begging without justification; Links to Other Subjects: Social Studies as learners are encouraged to work and contribute to nation building.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 5.3 Dua (Supplication) for Leaving and Entering the House
chunks.text: STRAND: AKHLAQ (MORAL VALUES). SUB-STRAND: 5.3 Dua (Supplication) for Leaving and Entering the House (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recite the dua for leaving and entering the house to seek Allah’s protection, b) use the dua in his/her day- to-day life, c) acknowledge the importance of using dua to get protection from Allah (S.W.T.). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The Learner is guided to:  recite from a digital device/chart/reference material the dua: dua for leaving the house “in the name of Allah I have placed my trust in Allah; there is no might and no power except by Allah” dua for entering the house “In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What do you recite when you leave home for school? 2. What do you recite when entering home from school? 3. Why do you recite the dua when leaving and entering the house? we leave, and upon our lord we depend”.  practice reciting the dua in pairs/groups,  role play/dramatise reading the dua on leaving and entering the house. Core Competencies to be developed  Communication and collaboration: the skill of speaking and team work as learners practice reciting the dua in pairs/groups  Creativity and imagination: the skill of making observations as learners role play the dua on leaving and entering the house. Values: Responsibility enhanced as learners role play the dua on leaving and entering the house. PCIs: Self-esteem as learners recite the dua. Links to Other Subjects: Language activities – Arabic, English as learners acquire new vocabularies in making supplication

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 MUAMALAAT. SUB-STRAND: 6.1 Obligations of Parents to children (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the obligations of parents to their children, b) assess the importance of parents fulfilling their obligations towards their children, c) demonstrate ways in which parents can fulfil their obligations to their children, d) cherish love and care given to them by their parents. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  brainstorm parents’ obligations towards their children in pairs/ small groups and write the points in their notebook,  discuss the importance of parents fulfilling their obligations towards their children in pairs/ groups and present in class,  role play the obligations of parents to their children,  watch/listen anashid from digital devices on the roles of parents to their children. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are some of the thing’s parents do for their children? 2. why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligation towards their children? Core Competencies to be developed  Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing and team work as learners discuss parents’ obligations towards their children in pairs/ small groups and write the points in their notebook  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with technology as learners watch/listen anashid from digital devices on the roles of parents to their children watch role of parents to their children;  Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as learners discuss the importance of parents fulfilling their obligations towards their children in pairs/ groups and present in class  Self-efficacy: the skill of personal skill is enhanced as learners role play obligations of parents towards their children. Values:  Social justice enhanced as learners discuss the importance of parents fulfilling their obligations towards their children in pairs/ groups and present in class  Responsibility enhanced as learners role play the obligations of parents to their children PCIs:  Citizenship: Child’s right to get education, shelter, and medical care;  Socio-economic issues: Care and protection from parents to enhance safety and security of the children. Links to Other Subjects: Social studies as learners discuss on the rights and responsibilities of citizens

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 MUAMALAAT. SUB-STRAND: 6.2 Obligations of Children to Parents (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) outline obligations of children to their parents, b) assess the importance of obeying and respecting parents as a religious obligation, c) demonstrate ways on how to obey and respect parents, d) appreciate their parents by respecting and obeying them. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss the duties of children to their parents in pair/groups and present in class,  discuss the importance of obeying and respecting their parents (Q 17:23-24) and write the points in their notebook,  dramatise children’s obligations to their parents,  listen to qasidas/anashid (e.g. Ummy) on importance of respecting and obeying parents from a digital device. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do you show obedience and respect to your parents? 2. Why should children be dutiful towards their parent? Core Competencies to be developed:  Learning to learn: the skill of working collaboratively is enhanced as learners describe the duties of children to their parents in pair/groups and present in class  Citizenship: the skill of social cultural sensitivity is enhanced and awareness as learners dramatise children’s obligations to their parents  Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners dramatise children’s obligations to their parents Values: PCIs: Responsibility by relating well with parents and other members of the society. Links to Other Subjects: Social studies as learners fulfil their duties and responsibility towards parents and others members in the society.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 6.3 Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 MUAMALAAT. SUB-STRAND: 6.3 Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) outline obligations of children to other family members as an act of ibadah (worship), b) assess the significance of fulfilling obligations to other family members, c) appreciate maintaining bond with other family members. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  prepare chart with names of extended family members and hang strategically,  discuss children’s obligations to other family members (e.g. Respect, visiting, attending ceremonies, helping and caring for them etc.) in pairs/groups and write the point in their notebook,  brainstorm the significance of fulfilling obligations to other family members in pairs/groups,  dramatise their obligations to other family members. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Who are the other family members? 2. How do you develop good relationship with other family members? 3. What is the significance of strengthening your relationship with other family members? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening, speaking and writing enhanced as learners discuss children’s obligations to other family members (e.g. Respect, visiting, attending ceremonies, helping and caring for them etc.) in pairs/groups and write the point in their notebook Values:  Respect acceptance enhanced as learners respect each other opinions while discussing in groups  Responsibility accountability prepare chart with names of extended family members and hang strategically  Love enhanced as learners share responsibilities while dramatising their obligations to other family members PCIs: Social cohesion as learners relates well with family and other members of the society; Links to Other Subjects: Social studies as learners fulfil their duties towards family and other members of the society.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 7.1 Earliest converts in Islam. Khadija (R.A.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 HISTORY OF ISLAM. SUB-STRAND: 7.1 Earliest converts in Islam. Khadija (R.A.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub- strand, the learner should be able to: a) Identify the earliest converts to Islam, b) explain the role played by the earliest converts to Islam, c) appreciate the role played by earliest converts to the development of Islam. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  mention the earliest converts in Islam (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) in pair/groups and write them in their note book,  read from reference material/course books on the story of (Khadija (R.a.) Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) and write the role they played in the Prophet’s mission,  listen to a resource person discussing the role played by earliest converts. (E.g. First person to accept Islam, moral and material support, and lives etc.),  listen to a story on Khadija (R.A), Ali (R.A.) and Abubakar (R.A.) from a resource person/digital device. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What role did earliest converts play in the Prophet’s mission? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening, speaking and writing as learners identify the qualities that led Khadija (R.A) to propose to marry the Prophet (e.g. trustworthy, honesty, hardworking) in pair/groups and write the points in their note book  Learning to learn the skill of sharing learnt knowledge as learners: listen to a resource person discussing the role of Khadija in the life of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W). (E.g. First person to accept Islam, moral support, all his children were born by Khadija apart from Ibrahim, her wealth support etc.).  Values: Respect etiquette enhanced as learners listen attentively to a resource person discussing the role of Khadija in the life of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W). PCIs: Citizenship: Nationalism by volunteering in Islamic activities in the community Links to Other Subjects: Social Studies as learners learn on personalities and their role in the country or different community development

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 HISTORY OF ISLAM. SUB-STRAND: 7.2 Call to Prophethood (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) describe the prophet’s incidence at cave Hira with Angel Jibril (A.S.), b) assess the significance of the first five verses revealed to Prophet (S.A.W) in relation to seeking knowledge, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  watch audio-visual clip/listen to a story from a digital device/resource person on prophet’s experience at cave Hira,  read from reference material story on call to prophethood and narrates to others in class, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What are the teachings of the first five verses revealed to Prophet (S.A.W)? c) acknowledge the role of Prophet (S.A.W) as a messenger of Allah (W.W.T) by emulating his practices.  recite the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq individually/in groups,  discuss the significance from the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq in pairs/groups and write the points in their note book. Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing and teamwork is enhanced as learners discuss the teachings from the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq in pairs/groups and write the points in their note book  Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners read from reference material story on call to prophethood and narrates to others in class  Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners watch audio-visual clip/listen to a story from a digital device/resource person on prophet’s experience at cave Hira. Values:  Respect open mindedness enhanced as learners respect each other opinions while discuss the teachings from the first five verses of Suratul- Alaq in pairs/groups  Responsibility accountability enhanced as learners recite the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq individually/in groups PCIs: Empathy as learners learn how the Prophet (S.A.W) received divine guidance Links to Other Subjects Social Studies as learners discuss the spread of Islam in East Africa

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7. HISTORY OF ISLAM. SUB-STRAND: 7.3 Prophet (S.A.W.)’s journey to Taif (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand, the learner should be able to: a) narrate the story of the Prophet (s.a.w)’s journey to Taif, b) demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif, c) appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen/watch a story on the Prophet (s.a.w)’s journey to Taif from a digital device/ resource person and retell individually in class,  identify the virtues learnt from the Prophet (s.a.w)’s journey to Taif and display them on a chart,  brainstorm on the situations that require exhibition of the following virtues: (patience, tolerance and perseverance) pairs/groups and present in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What lessons can Muslims learn from the Prophet (s.a.w)’s journey toTaif? 2. How did the Prophet (s.a.w) treat the people of Taif? Core competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration: as they brainstorm on the situations that require exhibition of the following virtues (patience, tolerance and perseverance) Values: Responsibility: hard work brainstorm on the situations that require exhibition of the following virtues: (patience, tolerance and perseverance) PCIs: Life skills:tolerance learners will be able understand as they brainstorm on the hardship encounter by the during the Taif journey Links to other subjects: English as learners retell on the Prophet’s journey to Taif in class Suggested Resources  Participate in ballgames and athletics competition  Organise Inter House/Inter Class activities to sporting activities

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua silabi zinazotokana na sauti p/b, t/d, k/g, ch/j katika maneno, b) kutamka silabi zinazotokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi, c) kutamka vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi, d) kuunda vitanzandimi kutokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa (p/b, t/d, k/g, ch/j) kutokana na maneno kwenye vitabu, ubaoni au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,  kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. kinasasauti na rununu,  kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa na vitanzandimi akiwa na wenzake,  kusikiliza vitanzandimi vilivyoundwa kutokana na maneno yenye sauti lengwa vikikaririwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika vifaa vya kidijitali (k.m. baba alivua papa katika bahari pana, kila Chacha akila hali chakula kikichacha),  kuunda vitanzandimi vyepesi vinavyotokana na vitate husika akiwa na wenzake,  kuunda vitanzandimi kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Matamshi bora yana umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano? e) kuchangamkia kukariri vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi katika kuboresha matamshi yake. kushirikiana na wenzake mitamboni kuvirekebisha,  kushiriki majadiliano kuhusu sababu za kukariri vitanzandimi maishani mwake. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala kuhusu matamshi bora.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusikiliza sauti.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoendelea kukariri vitanzandimi pia anapotoa muhtasari wa kifungu ili kupata kuelewa zaidi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kuunda vitanzandimi. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili maana na matumizi ya msamiati lengwa.  Uwajibikaji – anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuunda vitanzandimi pamoja na wenzake.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzu anapotangamana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali katika kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa na vitanzandimi. Masuala mtambuko Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoa maeneo tofauti tofauti kuunda vitanzandimi kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuvirekebisha. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English, Indigenous Languages na Arabic – masomo haya yanafunza sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati wa mada lengwa uliotumika katika kifungu cha hadithi ili kuimarisha ufahamu, b) kutumia msamiati lengwa kwa usahihi katika sentensi, c) kutoa muhtasari wa ujumbe wa kifungu cha hadithi, d) kujenga mazoea ya usomaji bora katika maisha ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua msamiati wa nyumbani (k.v. meza, sebule, balbu/globu, kizingiti, fremu, neti, tendegu, mtoto wa meza, mvungu, figa, kinu, tumbuu, kochi, kupiga deki) uliotumiwa katika kifungu cha hadithi,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili maana na matumizi ya msamiati lengwa katika sentensi,  kuimba nyimbo zinazolenga msamiati lengwa,  kusoma kifungu kinachohusiana na suala lengwa kwenye kitabu au kwenye tarakilishi akiwa na wenzake,  kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu alichosoma,  kutoa muhtasari wa ujumbe wa kifungu alichokisoma,  kumweleza mzazi au mlezi wake ujumbe wa kifungu alichokisoma. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini ili kupata ujumbe katika kifungu cha hadithi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotoa muhtasari wa kifungu na kujibu maswali ipasavyo. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili maana na matumizi ya msamiati lengwa katika sentensi.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kusaidiana. Masuala Mtambuko Usalama mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi au projekta kuchora vifaaa vya nyumbani kwa uangalifu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English, Indigenous Languages na Arabic – masomo haya yana stadi ya kusoma kwa ufahamu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 1.3.1 Kuandika Insha ya Wasifu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia muundo, b) kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, mtindo na muundo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya wasifu ili kujenga ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadili na wenzake maana ya insha ya wasifu,  kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kujadili na wenzake mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya wasifu akiwa,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha inayoeleza sifa za mtu kama vile mzazi au mlezi, rafiki, mwalimu au kiongozi yeyote kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati nadhifu, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa ubunifu,  kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia mambo gani unapoandika insha nzuri ya wasifu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya wasifu.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika na kusambaza insha ya wasifu mtandaoni.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati nadhifu, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka. Maadili  Heshima- mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya wasifu.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha na kukitunza. Masuala mtambuko  Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli za kikundi pamoja na wenzake kwa amani.  Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anaposoma masuala kuhusu mambo ya nyumbani katika insha au kifungu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia stadi ya kuandika insha ya wasifu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.1 Nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya nomino ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno, b) kutambua nomino katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia nomino kwa njia sahihi katika sentensi, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya nomino katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya nomino,  kutambua nomino katika matini mbalimbali,  kushirikiana na wenzake kutoa mifano ya nomino,  kuchagua nomino kwenye tarakilishi, kuziburura na kuzitia kapuni akiwa na wenzake,  kutumia nomino kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,  kutumia nomino kutunga sentensi kwenye daftari na mtandaoni ili wenzake wazisome na kuzisahihisha. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vitu gani unavyoweza kupata katika mazingira yako? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua nomino na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia nomino.  Kujiamini -mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua nomino na kuzitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anaposahihisha sentensi zilizoandikwa na mwenzake kwa uaminifu.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kueleza maana ya nomino bila ubaguzi.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali katika kutekeleza shughuli za kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu masuala ya nyumbani. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hushughulikia dhana ya nomino.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.2 Vitenzi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya vitenzi ili kuvitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno, b) kutambua vitenzi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia vitenzi ipasavyo katika mawasiliano, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vitenzi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kwa amani kueleza maana ya vitenzi,  kushirikiana na wenzake kutoa mifano ya vitenzi (k.v. soma, andika, keti, simama, cheka) katika kadi za maneno, kapu maneno, ubao, vifaa vya kidijitali n.k.,  kutambua vitendo vinavyofanyika katika picha au michoro,  kuigiza vitenzi mbalimbali akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutumia vitenzi kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi na kifungu kifupi,  kutumia vitenzi mbalimbali kutunga sentensi daftarini au mtandaoni kwa kuzingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kuwashirikisha wenzake katika kuzisahihisha sentensi zake na kumpa maoni kwa heshima. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni shughuli gani unazofanya kila siku? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua vitenzi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi. Maadili  Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya vitenzi.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake wanaposhiriki katika kutoa mifano ya vitenzi na kuigiza vitenzi mbalimbali.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapochukua nafasi mbalimbali katika maigizo ya vitenzi mbalimbali. Masuala Mtambuko Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kutunga sentensi kuhusu nyumbani na na masuala ya watoto. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia dhana ya vitenzi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.3 Vivumishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kivumishi ili kukitofautisha na aina nyingine za maneno, b) kutambua vivumishi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia vivumishi ipasavyo katika sentensi na kifungu, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vivumishi katika sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya kivumishi,  kutambua vivumishi katika kundi la maneno aliyopewa (k.m. -zuri, -baya, - refu, -fupi, -eusi, -eupe, n.k),  kuchagua vivumishi kwenye tarakilishi, kuviburura na kuvitia kapuni akiwa na wenzake,  kutumia vivumishi kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,  kutumia vivumishi kutunga sentensi daftarini na mtandaoni akizingatia masuala mtambuko mbalimbali yakiwemo masuala ya usalama wa mtandaoni, usawa wa kijinsia, usalama wa nyumbani, mahusiano ya kijamii, n.k,  kuandika aya fupi akitumia vivumishi mbalimbali,  kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake kazi yake ili kuitolea maoni kwa heshima na upendo. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni sifa zipi unazoweza kutambua katika nomino mbalimbali? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua vivumishi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu -mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vivumishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za vukundi.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowatolea wenzake maoni kuhusu kazi zao.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua vivumishi katika kundi la maneno. Masuala Mtambuko Utunzi na usalama wa watoto – mwanafunzi anapoingiliana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya yanashughulikia mada ya sarufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua aina mbalimbali za maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano, b) kueleza maamkuzi na maagano yanayotumika katika miktadha mbalimbali, c) kutumia aina mbalimbali za maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano, d) kuchangamkia maamkuzi na maagano katika mahusiano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua maamkuzi (k.v. U mzima? U hali gani? Alamsiki, Lala unono, Siku njema) kutoka kwenye chati, ubao au vifaa vya kidijitali, michoro na picha,  kushiriki mjadala na mwenzake kuhusu maamkuzi na maagano yanayolengwa na matumizi yake,  kushirikiana na wenzake kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano lengwa,  kutazama watu wakiamkuana na kuagana katika vifaa vya kidijitali,  kuambatanisha maamkuzi na maagano na majibu sahihi daftarini au kwenye tarakilishi,  kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu maamkuzi na maagano yanayotumiwa katika jamii yao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, watu husalimiana na kuagana vipi katika jamii yako? 2. Kuamkua na kuaga watu kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunza maagano na maaamkuzi.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapotumia maamkuzi na maagano ipasavyo. Maadili  Heshima – inaimarishwa wanapoigiza maamkuzi na maagano.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala na wenzake kwa kutumia maamkuzi na maagano yafaayo.  Umoja –unaimarisha uhusiano mwema baina yao wanapofanya shughuli za kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko  Elimu ya amani – inakuzwa mwanafunzi anapoamkuana na kuagana na wenzake.  Umoja wa kijamii - mwanafunzi anapomuamkua na kumuaga mwenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yana mada kuhusu maamkuzi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 2.2.1 Matumizi ya Kamusi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kamusi ili kuitofautisha na vitabu vingine, b) kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno asiyoyajua ili kukuza msamiati wake, c) kuchangamkia umuhimu wa kamusi katika kukuza msamiati wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu maana na matumizi ya kamusi,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mpangilio wa maneno katika kamusi,  kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno mbalimbali akiwa na wenzake,  kutumia mtandao kusikiliza na kusoma maelezo kuhusu msamiati anaotafutia maana. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini unapotafuta maneno katika kamusi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutafuta maana za maneno.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutafuta maana za maneno.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoanza kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno. Maadili Uzalendo –mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kutoka sehemu mbalimbali katika kutekeleza shughuli za kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Usalama mtandaoni –mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kusikiliza na kusoma maelezo kuhusu msamiati asioujua. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya husisitiza matumizi mbalimbali ya kamusi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 2.3.1 Insha ya Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia muundo, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi inayozingatia mada, ujumbe, mtindo na muundo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya masimulizi ili kukuza ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha inayosimulia kisa kinachohusu nidhamu mezani kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Insha ya masimulizi inahusu nini? 2. Je, unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya masimulizi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji -mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maSwali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili Heshima – inakuzwa mwanafunzi anapothamini mchango wa wenzake katika kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanfunzi anapokuza uraia wema kwa kufanya shughuli ya kikundi na wenzake na kuthamini mchango wao. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yana mada kuhusu insha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 2.4.1 Viwakilishi (Vipindi 2 ). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kiwakilishi ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua viwakilishi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia viwakilishi ipasavyo katika sentensi, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya viwakilishi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya viwakilishi,  kutambua viwakilishi katika kundi la maneno aliyopewa,  kuchagua viwakilishi kwenye tarakilishi, kuviburura na kuvitia kapuni akiwa na wenzake,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viwakilishi mwafaka,  kutumia viwakilishi kutunga sentensi daftarini au mtandaoni kwa kuzingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake sentensi zake ili kuzitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni maneno gani yanayoweza kutumika badala ya nomino? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua viwakilishi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia viwakilishi.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua viwakilishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Amani –mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapothamini mchango wa wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu kwa maendeleo endelevu – anapotumia viwakilishi ipasavyo katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanafunza viwakilishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 2.4.2 Vielezi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kielezi ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua vielezi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia vielezi ipasavyo katika mawasiliano, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vielezi katika sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya vielezi (k.v. polepole, haraka, sana, vizuri, kisheria, jana, shuleni, uwanjani),  kutambua vielezi katika kundi la maneno aliyopewa katika kadi za maneno, chati, mti maneno, ubao, vifaa vya kidijitali n.k.,  kuchagua vielezi kutoka kwenye kundi la maneno kwa kutumia tarakilishi kwa kuviburura na kuvitia kapuni akiwa na wenzake,  kuigiza vielezi mbalimbali panapofaa akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutumia vielezi mwafaka kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,  kutumia vielezi kutunga sentensi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi zake ili kuzitolea maoni. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unafanyaje shughuli zako za kila siku? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua vielezi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu –mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vielezi na kuviigiza.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vielezi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Heshima –anaposikiliza vielezi vinavyotolewa na wenzake kwa makini.  Upendo – anapoigiza akishirikiana na wenzake kwa zamu. Masuala Mtambuko Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia vielezi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yana mada kuhusu vielezi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.1 Kusikiliza na kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 3.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vitendawili kwenye matini mbalimbali , b) kutega na kutegua vitendawili ili kujenga matamshi bora, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitendawili katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutafiti maana ya kitendawili kwenye kamusi, vitabuni au mtandaoni akiwa na wenzake,  kutambua vitendawili katika chati, ubao au katika vifaa vya kidijitali (k.m. Nifungue nikufunike (Mwavuli); Pitia huku nami nipitie kule, tupatane pale (mshipi); Ukinitembelea nyayo zi salama (viatu),  kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali.  kushiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili akiwa na wenzake,  kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu vitendawili vinavyotegwa katika jamii yao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia nini unapotega na kutegua vitendawili? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili kwenye vikundi.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo –mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu majibu ya vitendawili.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia vyombo vya kidijitali kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotega na kutegua vitendawili ipasavyo. Maadili  Heshima - mwanafunzi anachangamkia maoni ya wenzake darasani.  Umoja - wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi ya kutega na kutegua vitendawili pamoja na wenzake kwa vikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii - mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi ya kutega na kutegua vitendawili pamoja na wenzake katika kikundi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English and Indegineous Languages - masomo haya yanashughulikia vitendawili.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha, b) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, d) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo, e) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe: ● kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,  kusikiliza na kutazama mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa, mwanafunzi mwenzake au video za watu wanaosoma makala kwa ufasaha (k.v. hotuba na habari),  kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha vilivyozingatiwa katika usomaji alioutazama,  kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akiwa na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo), ● kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno yasiyopungua 70 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kusoma kifungu cha hadithi ipasavyo? viakifishi) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni, ● kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa anaposoma (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono), ● kusoma hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali kutoka kwenye vitabu, vifaa vya kidijtali, nk akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusoma kifungu cha hadithi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma vifungu cha hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotafuta hadithi mbalimbali na kuzisoma kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Maadili ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusoma kifungu cha hadithi. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowashirikisha wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali. Masuala Mtambuko ● Stadi za maisha – mwanafunzi anapomudu kuzitumia sauti lengwa ipasavyo, ukakamavu wake unajengeka. ● Uraia – mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake wanaposhirikiana kutamka sauti lengwa katika kikundi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa kutumia tarakilishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua sehemu mbalimbali za tarakilishi zinazotumika kupigia chapa, b) kufungua na kufunga tarakilishi ili kuandika kazi na kuihifadhi, c) kuandika mada lengwa kwa kutumia tarakilishi, d) kuhariri kazi yake kwa kuzingatia uakifishaji ufaao, e) kuhifadhi kazi aliyoiandika kwenye tarakilishi, f) kujenga mazoea ya kuandika kwa kutumia tarakilishi na kuhifadhi kazi yake ya maandishi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua sehemu za kimsingi za tarakilishi za kupigia chapa akiwa na wenzake (k.v. kiibodi, kipanya, kiwambo, kitufe na faili),  kuzingatia hatua za kufungua na kufunga tarakilishi,  kuandika mada lengwa kwa kutumia tarakilishi akizingatia chapa koza, italiki na kupigia mistari panapofaa,  kuandika aya kuhusu mavazi katika tarakilishi na kuihariri,  kutumia mtandao kusambaza kazi aliyoandika ili wenzake na mwalimu waitathmini,  kuhifadhi kazi yake kwenye faili ya tarakilishi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia nini unapoandika kwa kutumia tarakilishi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kuandika na kuhifadhi kazi yake kwenye faili.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotagusana na vyombo vya kidijitali kama vile kutumia tarakilishi, kipakatalishi n.k. Maadili  Ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapotambua sehemu za kimsingi za tarakilishi za kupiga chapa akiwa na wenzake.  Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anaweza kutumia na kuhifadhi vifaa vya kidijitali ifaavyo. Masuala Mtambuko Usalama wa mtandaoni - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali anazingatia kuingia mitaoni iliyo salama.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 3.4.1 Viunganishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kiunganishi ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua viunganishi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia viunganishi kwa njia sahihi katika mawasiliano, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya viunganishi katika sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya viunganishi,  kutambua viunganishi katika kundi la maneno aliyopewa (k.v. na, pia, kwa sababu, lakini),  kutafiti vitabuni au mtandaoni ili kutoa mifano mbalimbali ya viunganishi,  kutumia viunganishi kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,  kutumia viunganishi kutunga sentensi daftarini au mtandaoni kwa kuzingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kumsomea mzazi au mlezi wake sentensi alizozitunga. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, kwa nini ni muhimu kutumia viunganishi katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua viunganishi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua viunganishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya viunganishi na kuvitungia sentensi.  Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuchagua viunganishi kutoka kwenye kundi la maneno na kuvitia kapuni. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kikundi pamoja na wenzake wa jamii tofauti. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia dhana ya viunganishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 3.4.2 Vihusishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kihusishi ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua vihusishi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia vihusishi ipasavyo katika sentensi, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vihusishi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya vihusishi na kuvitolea mifano (k.m. karibu na, mbali na, juu ya, chini ya, nje ya na ndani ya),  kutambua vihusishi katika kundi la maneno aliyopewa,  kuchagua vihusishi kwenye kundi la maneno katika tarakilishi, kuviburura na kuvitia kapuni akiwa peke yake au kwenye vikundi,  kutumia vihusishi kutunga sentensi daftarini au mtandaoni kwa kuzingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizotunga ili kuzitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Vihusishi vina umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua vihusishi na kutunga sentensi mtandaoni.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vihusishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapothamini mchango wa wenzake katika kikundi.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutambua vihusishi na kuvitungia sentensi mtandaoni. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kikundi pamoja na wenzake wa jamii tofauti. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia dhana ya vihusishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 3.4.3 Vihisishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kihisishi ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua vihisishi katika kundi la maneno na sentensi, c) kutumia vihisishi ipasavyo katika sentensi, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vihisishi katika miktadha mbalimbali. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe,  kueleza maana ya vihisishi na kuvitolea mifano (k.m. Lo!, Ala!, Salalee!, Mama ee!, Oyee! na Aha!) akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutambua vihisishi katika kundi la maneno,  kutambua alama ya hisi (!) inayoambatanishwa na vihisishi,  kutumia vihisishi kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,  kutumia vihisishi kutunga sentensi kwenye daftari akizingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,  kutumia vihisishi kutunga kifungu kifupi daftarini au mtandaoni ili wenzake wakisome na kukitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kutumia vihisishi katika mawasiliano kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi unapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vihisishi na kutunga sentensi.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vihisishi.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vihisishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapochagua vihisishi kwenye kundi la maneno katika tarakilishi na kuvitia kapuni.  Umoja – anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya vihisishi na kuvitolea mifano. Masuala Mtambuko  Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kikundi pamoja na wenzake wa jamii tofauti.  Uwazaji wa kina – anapotumia vihisishi kutunga sentensi mtandaoni ili wenzake wazitathmini. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yana mada kuhusu vihisishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 4.1.1 Maneno ya Upole (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno ya upole yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano, b) kutumia maneno ya upole katika mawasiliano, c) kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya upole katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua na kueleza maana ya maneno ya upole (k.m. kwenda msalani, kwenda haja kubwa, kwenda haja ndogo, kuendesha na kujifungua) katika chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno, ubao, vyombo vya kidijitali,  kushiriki katika kujadili maneno ya upole akiwa na wenzake,  kutazama maigizo kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya upole katika video na mitandaoni,  kushiriki katika maigizo yanayohusu matumizi ya maneno ya upole,  kutumia maneno ya upole katika sentensi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kutumia maneno ya upole kuna umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –wanafunzi wanapojadiliana na kuigiza katika vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia vyombo vya kidijitali katika ujifunzaji.  Kujiamini - mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua maneno ya upole na kuyatumia katika kutunga sentensi. Maadili  Heshima - mwanafunzi anapotambua naakutumia maneno ya upole katika chati maneno.  Upendo - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kwa amani.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapo Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na kushirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi kwa upolw na amani. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English, Indigenous Languages na Religious Studies – lugha ya upole hufunzwa katika masomo haya.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma, b) kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali, c) kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa, d) kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali kwa urahisi kupata SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama (k.m. kutowasiliana na watu asiowajua, kuwajibika anaposakura tovuti mbalimbali) kutoka kwenye chati au kwenye tarakilishi na mitandao,  kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,  kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,  kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,  kutafuta maana za maneno kuhusu mada lengwa (k.m. kaskazini, kusini, magharibi, mashariki, kaskazini mashariki, kaskazini magharibi, kusini KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni hatua zipi za kiusalama unazofaa kuzingatia unapotumia mtandao? matini yanayolengwa, e) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake. mashariki na kusini magharibi) kwenye kamusi au mtandaoni,  asikilize matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,  kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji –mwanafunzi anapotafuta matini ya kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – katika utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.  Uadilifu – mwanafun za anapotoa habari kwa mwalimu au mlezi apatapo ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandoni. Masuala Mtambuko Usalama mtandaoni– mwanafunzi anapotambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine Masomo yote yanatakiwa kuzingatia ujuzi wa kidijitali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 4.3.1 Kuandika Barua ya Kirafiki (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia muundo wake, b) kujadili umuhimu wa barua ya kirafiki katika mawasiliano, c) kuandika barua ya kirafiki inayozingatia mada kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, d) kuchangamkia utunzi wa barua ya kirafiki katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano,  kujadili na wenzake mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake/ yale yanayofaa kujumuishwa,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa rafiki, ndugu, mzazi, n.k kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kuwasomea wenzake na mwalimu KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika barua nzuri ya kirafiki? 2. Barua za kirafiki inashughulikia masuala gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.  Ubunifu –mwanafunzi anapoandika barua za kirafiki.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kuandika kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu. Maadili  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapoitathmini kazi ya wenzake.  Heshima - mwanafunzi anapojadili umuhimu wa kuandika barua za kirafiki. Masuala Mtambuko Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa jamii tofauti tofauti kujadili umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hushughulikia uandishi wa barua.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 4.4.1 Ngeli ya A-WA (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya A-WA, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya A-WA ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine, c) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya ngeli za nomino akiwa na wenzake,  kutaja mifano ya nomino akiwa na wenzake,  kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi,  kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya A-WA kwenye sentensi alizosoma,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya A- WA kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,  kutambua nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi katika matini,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni nini kinakuwezesha kutambua nomino za ngeli ya A-WA? ngeli ya A-WA,  kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A- WA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,  kuwasomea au kuwazambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika na kuandika nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi. Pia anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya A- WA kutoka kikapuni.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo- mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu mifano ya nomino.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino. Maadili  Uwajibikaji mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kidijitali anachotumia.  Heshima – anapothamini mchango wa wenzake katika kuandika maneno ya ngeli ya A-WA.  Amani –anapowasiliana na wenzake kutoka sehemu mbalimbali kwa kuonyesha upendo akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA. Masuala Mtambuko  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kuandika umoja na wingi wa nomino pamoja na wenzake.  Elimu endelevu – mwanafunzi anatoa mifano ya sentensi zinazohusu nomino zinazohusu masuala mtambuko k.v. mwanamazingira. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hufundisha mada ya sarufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 5.1.1 Methali (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua methali zinazohusu malezi katika matini tofautitofauti, b) kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi, c) kutumia methali zinazohusu malezi katika mawasiliano, d) kuchangamkia matumizi ya methali katika miktadha mbalimbali. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua methali kuhusu malezi (k.v. mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo, mtoto wa nyoka ni nyoka na mtoto hutazama kisogo cha nina) kutoka kwa orodha ya methali, chati au mtandaoni,  kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi akiwa na wenzake,  kukamilisha methali kuhusu malezi,  kutumia methali kuhusu malezi katika kifungu kifupi na masimulizi akiwa na wenzake  kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua methali kuhusu malezi katika jamii yao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni methali gani zinazohusu malezi? 2. Methali hutumiwa kufanya nini? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapohusishwa katika kazi ya vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutambua methali.  Kujiamini –mwanafunzi anapotumia methali kujieleza. Maadili  Heshima– mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutaja na kueleza maana za methali na kuthamini mchango wao.  Uwajibikaji – anapowasiliana na mzazi au mlezi akitumia methali zinazohusu malezi katika miktatha mbalimbali.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapotambua methali kuhusu malezi katika jamii yake na za wenzake. Masuala Mtambuko  Ushauri nasaha –mwanafunzi anaposoma methali zinazohusu malezi mema.  Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa sehemu mbalimbali kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi kwa amani. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yana mada kuhusu methali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya shairi, ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha, b) kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, c) kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi, d) kutambua shairi kutokana na umbo lake, e) kufurahia kutumia lugha ya ushairi anapozungumzia ushairi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua shairi, beti na mishororo katika matini mbalimbali kama vile vitabu, chati na vilevile kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za shairi, ubeti na mishororo,  kusoma akizingatia msamiati wa mada lengwa,  kusikiliza mashairi yanayokaririwa kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,  kusoma au kukariri shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali akizingatia ujumbe,  kushiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye shairi,  kusoma mashairi kwenye mitandao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unaufahamu msamiati gani wa ushairi? 2. Mashairi yanaweza kuwasilisha ujumbe gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - wanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kufanikisha somo.  Kujiamini –mwanafunzi anapoimba au kukariri shairi. Maadili Umoja – anaposhirikikiana na wenzake katika majadiliano yanayohusu shairi bila ubaguzi. Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kufanikisha somo kwa uangalifu. Masuala Mtambuko Masuala ya kijinsia: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake kusoma na kukariri mashairi kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English, Music, Indigenous languages na Religious Education – masomo haya yanashughulikia nyimbo na ushairi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 5.3.1 Kuandika Insha ya Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vifungu vya maelezo katika matini, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya maelezo ili kujenga ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu mada lengwa (ushauri-nasaha) akitumia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,  kuandika insha ya maelezo daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu ili kuitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Insha ya maelezo inahusu nini? 2. Unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya maelezo? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusambaza insha mtandaoni.  Ubunifu –mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo. Maadili  Uadilifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaacha kidijitali kuandika na kusambaza kazi yake mtan daoni kwa uangalifu.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoiandika ili kuitathmini.  Amani – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika majadiliano ya mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo kwa utulivu. Masuala Mtambuko Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo pamoja na wenzake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hufundisha uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi nne za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 5.4.1 Ngeli ya U-I (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-I, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U-I ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine, c) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi,  kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-I kwenye sentensi alizosoma,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya U-I kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U-I kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya U-I,  kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,  kuwasomea au kuwazambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Nomino zinazorejelea mimea na vitu vya kimaumbile ni zipi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kuandika nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo - mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu nomino zilizo katika ngeli ya U-I.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutunga sentensi na kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza tarakilishi na vifaa vingine anavyotumia.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kuorodhesha nomino kuhusu suala lengwa.  Heshima - mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko  Usalama mtandaomi – mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-I kwenye tarakilishi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hufundisha mada ya sarufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 6.1.1 Kujieleza kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa kuzingatia matamshi na mahadhi mbalimbali, b) kueleza maana ya msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi, c) kutumia msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi ili kuboresha mawasiliano, d) kueleza ujumbe wa shairi ili kudhihirisha ufahamu wake, e) kuchangamkia ushairi kama njia ya kujieleza kwa ufasaha.
