SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kukariri shairi kuhusu mada lengwa (bendera ya taifa) kwa kuzingatia matamshi na mahadhi mbalimbali,  kusikilize shairi kuhusu suala lengwa likikaririwa au kuimbwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa (mghani) au kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali,  kushirikiana na wenzake kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,  kutambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu maadili (k.v. uhuru, bendera, rangi za bendera, kupandisha na kushukisha bendera) na kuueleza akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili ujumbe katika shairi,  kujibu maswali yanayotokana na shairi alilosikiliza, aliloimba au kukariri. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ushairi unaweza kuboresha vipi mazungumzo yako? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi kukariri na kuimba shairi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anaposikiliza shairi lililorekodiwa likikaririwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali.  Kujiamini –mwanafunzi anapojenga umilisi huu anapokariri shairi. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili ujumbe na matukio katika shairi ka kuheshimu mchango wao.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki majukumu tofauti tofauti katika vikundi na kufuata mafunzo katika shairi. Masuala Mtambuko Mshikamano wa kitaifa – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kukariki shairi kuhusu bendera ya taifa kwa mahadhi na kutambua msamiati uliotumika. Uhusiano na masomo mengine  English – somo hili linashughulikia ushairi.  Music – Somo hili hushughulikia nyimbo za mahadhi mbalimbali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kusoma makala kwa kuzingatia vipengele mbalimbali vinavyoyajenga, b) kusoma na kutambua umuhimu wa ujumbe wa makala husika, c) kufurahia kusoma makala mbalimbali ili kukuza ufahamu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma makala ya aina mbalimbali (k.m. hadithi fupi, michezo mifupi, mashairi mafupi) akizingatia vipengele kama vile tahajia, sarufi, wahusika na ujumbe kutoka kwa kitabu, gazeti au blogi,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake,  kutumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati uliotumika katika makala. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kusoma hadithi kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake katika vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anaposoma makala katika blogi.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anajenga umilisi huu anaposimulia na kujadili na wengine alichokisoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati mpya uliotumika katika Makala. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake.  Uzalendo –mwanafuzi anaposoma makala kuhusu jamii mbalimbali na kuheshimu mafunzo yanayojitokeza. Masuala Mtambuko  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake.  Usalama mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama anaposoma makala ya blogi mtandaoni. Uhusiano na masomo mengine Social Studies na English – uraia mwema na uzalendo unafundishwa katika masomo haya.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 6.3.1 Kuandika Insha ya Wasifu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia muundo, b) kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo akizingatia vivumishi na vielezi kujenga picha dhahiri ya anachokielezea, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa kuandika insha ya wasifu ili kukuza ubunifu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha inayoeleza sifa za mtu kama vile mzazi au mlezi, rafiki, mwalimu au kiongozi yeyote (kwa kutumia vivumishi na vielezi ili kujenga picha dhahiri ya anachokiandikia) daftarini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya wasifu,  kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Insha ya wasifu inahusu nini? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapovitumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya wasifu.  Ubunifu –mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari Swali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanfunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kufanikisha shughuli za kikundi kwa kuthamini maoni yao.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuisambaza insha yake mtandaoni ili mwalimu au wenzake waithamini.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni. Masuala Mtambuko Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha yake mtandaoni na kujitolea kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini. Uhusiano na masomo mengine  English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hushughulikia uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.  Social Studies – somo hili hushughulikia uraia na uzalendo.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 6.4.1 Ngeli ya LI- YA (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-YA, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI - YA ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine, c) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika umoja na wingi,  kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-YA kwenye sentensi alizosoma,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI-YA kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya LI-YA,  kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,  kuwasomea au kuwazambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya LI- YA? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Ubunifu –mwanafunzi anapotunga mafungu ya maneno.  Kufikiri kwa kina - mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu atakachoandika.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua nomino na katika kusikiliza mafungu kwenye tepurekoda. Maadili  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi.  Uwajibikaji – mwnafunzi anapotunza vipakatalishi anachotumia.  Uzalendo – mwanfunzi anapofanya kazi na wengine kwenye vikundi bikla ubaguzi wa kijamii.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali ili kutekeleza kazi ya kikundi. Masuala Mtambuko  Umoja na wenzake - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kuandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA.  Usalama mtanndaoni – mwanafunzi anapozin gatia hatua za kiusalama anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya wasifu. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hufundisha sarufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 7.1.1 Nahau (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia katika matini mbalimbali, b) kutambua maana za nahau mbalimbali za maadili na uraia katika mazungumzo, c) kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia katika mawasiliano, d) kuthamini matumizi ya nahau za maadili na uraia katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia (k.v. fanya haki, omba kibali, omba ruhusa, piga hodi na taka idhini) katika chati, michoro, picha, kapu maneno, mti maneno, chati na katika vyombo vya kidijitali,  kushiriki katika kujadili na wenzake maana za nahau za maadili na uraia,  kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia kutunga sentensi akiwa pekee au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,  kutazama vibonzo vikijibizana kuhusu nahau na maana zake,  kushirikiana na wenzake kuteua nahau za maadili na uraia kutoka kwenye kundi la nahau. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, nahau huchangia vipi katika kukuza maadili na uraia? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapojadili maana za nahau za maadili na uraia akiwa na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji –mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za nahau na kuzitumia kwa ufasaha katika mawasiliano.  Uraia – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kujadili masuala ya uraia na yanayolenga suala lengwa. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuteua nahau za maadili na uraia kwa kuonyesha upendo.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika kutambua nahau za maadili na za uraia.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanikisha kazi ya kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii –mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kwa vikundi wanapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – nahau hufundishwa katika masomo haya.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia, b) kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa, c) kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua matini (k.v. vitabu, majarida, magazeti) yanayomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,  kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,  kuwasimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,  kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambayo wamesoma. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kusoma matini mbalimbali kunachangia vipi ukuzaji wa lugha? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyoisoma ili kupasha ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi na mtandao kupata matini ya kusoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji –mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kuyasoma.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo - mwanafunzi anaposimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma na kupasha ujumbe uliotumiwa. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza tarakilishi anayoitumia katika kutambua matini.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu alichokisoma na kusikiliza maoni ya kila mmoja wao. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga - mwanafunzi anapotambua na kusoma matini yanayomvutia maktabani akizingatia suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – Masomo haya yanajumuisha mada ya kusoma kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 7.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya maelezo katika matini, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya maelezo ili kukuza ubunifu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia mada lengwa (k.v. upanzi wa miti na mimea, utunzaji wa mimea, shamba la matunda n.k.) hasa akizingatia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea,  kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,  kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vitu gani vinavyoweza kuandikiwa insha ya maelezo? wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala ya kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo.  Uwajibikaji –mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha na kuwasambazia wenzake waitathmini. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia mada lengwa matunda na mimea. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hushughulikia uandishi wa insha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KI-VI (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine, c) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, a) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi,  kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI kwenye sentensi alizosoma,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya KI- VI kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KI- VI (k.m. kitabu, kikombe, kisu, chakula, choo) kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI,  kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,  kuwasomea au kuwazambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya KI- VI? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapotaja nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutunga sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya KI- VI katika umoja na wingi. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia na kutunza tarakilishi anaposoma sentensi zilizotungwa kutokana na nomino za KI- VI.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapotaja nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake kwa vikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - Masomo haya hushughulikia sarufi .

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.2 Ngeli ya LI-LI (Kipindi 1). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-LI, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine, c) kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya LI- LI katika umoja na wingi,  kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-LI kwenye sentensi alizosoma,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI- LI (k.m. jua- jua, giza-giza) kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,  kuandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi,  kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI,  kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI? kisarufi,  kuwasomea au kuwazambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga mafungu ya maneno kutokana na ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi.  Kufikiri kwa kina - mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu atakachoandika.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na katika kusikiliza mafungu ya maneno yakisomwa. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vipakatalishi anachokitumia.  Uzalendo -mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wengine kwenye vikundi. Masuala Mtambuko Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi na wenzake bila ubaguzi. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English na Indigenous Languages- nomino hufundishwa katika masomo haya.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 8.1.1 Visawe (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kisawe ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua maneno mawili yenye maana sawa katika matini, c) kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano, d) kuthamini matumizi ya visawe katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya neno kisawe akiwa na wenzake,  kutambua maneno mawili ya kiwango chake yenye maana sawa (k.v. tembo, ndovu; kinyonga, lumbwi; adui, hasimu; siri, faragha; barua, waraka; ami- amu; televisheni, runinga) kwa kurejelea kapu maneno, kadi za maneno na mti maneno,  kuambatanisha visawe kutoka kapu maneno, mti maneno, orodha ya maneno, chati, vyombo vya kidijitali au kadi za maneno,  kutumia kisawe kimoja kuchukua nafasi ya kingine katika sentensi,  kutumia kisawe kimoja kuchukua nafasi ya kingine katika kifungu kifupi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Maneno yenye maana sawa yanasaidia vipi katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine kueleza maana na neno kisawe kwa kujadiliana.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu visawe mwafaka na uhusiano wa visawe na vifaa halisi  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kama nyenzo za kufaulisha mada. Maadili  Umoja– mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake kujadili visawe mbalimbali katika vikundi.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotekeleza majukumu yao katika vikundi a vilevile kutunza vifaa anavyotumia katika somo. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili visawe mbalimbali darasani. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English - Somo hili hushirikisha mada ya visawe.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza, mhusika na maelekezo, b) kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza katika matini, c) kutambua wahusika na maelekezo katika mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza, d) kusoma mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, e) kuigiza mchezo mfupi kwa kuzingatia maelekezo, f) kufurahia kusoma michezo na kuiigiza. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za mchezo wa kuigiza, mhusika na maelekezo akiwa na wenzake,  kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza, wahusika na maelekezo katika matini mbalimbali kama vile vitabu, chati na vilevile kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  atazame mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza ukiigizwa darasani au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,  asome mchezo wa kuigiza akizingatia maelekezo na ujumbe,  ashiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza,  asome mchezo wa kuigiza kwenye mtandao,  ajibu maswali yanayotokana na mchezo KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, wahusika huchangia nini katika mchezo wa kuigiza? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za mchezo wa kuigiza na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotazama mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali.  Uwazaji wa kina – mwanafunzi anapong’amua ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kusoma na kushiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza. Maadili Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza akiwa na wenzake na kuthamini mchango wao. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu utunzaji wa wanyama wa porini na elimu ya mazingira. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous languages – masomo haya hushughulikia michezo ya kuigiza.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 8.3.1 Kuandika Insha ya Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia muundo, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya masimulizi ili kujenga ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  aandike insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  ashiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,  aandike insha ya masimulizi mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Insha ya masimulizi inahusu nini? 2. Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi? waisome na kuitathmini,  awasomee wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapojadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapobuni na kuandika insha ya masimulizi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maSwali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Upendo –mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuisambaza insha aliyoiandika mtandaoni kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na waitathmini.  Uwajibikaji –mwanafunzi anapoandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama porini kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao. Masuala Mtambuko  Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini.  Elimu ya fedha – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akizingatia umuhimu wa wanyama pori. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya mnyambuliko wa vitenzi ili kuubainisha, b) kueleza maana ya kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa ili kuzitofautisha, c) kutambua vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa katika matini, d) kutumia vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa ipasavyo anapowasiliana, e) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa kwenye mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana za mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, kauli ya kutenda, kauli ya kutendea na kauli ya kutendwa,  kutambua vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa katika chati, jedwali, kapu maneno, mti maneno, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,  anyambue vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa peke yake, wakiwa wawili wawili au katika vikundi,  atumie vitenzi katika kauli lengwa kwenye sentensi,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujaza nafasi katika jedwali la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, vitenzi vinaweza kubadilika vipi mwishoni ili kuleta maana mbalimbali? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya mnyambuliko wa vitenzi.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo - mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali.  Kujiamini-mwanafunzi anapotoa majibu na kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali. Maadili  Ushirikiano – unajitokeza mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujaza nafasi katika jedwali la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi kwenye daftari,  Umoja –unajithihirisha mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa na wenzake. Masuala Mtambuko  Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa na wenzake.  Elimu ya utunzaji wanyama – mwanafunzi anyambue vitenzi vya kauli lengwa kwa sentensi akizingatia mada lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya yanashughulikia vitenzi kama mada muhimu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 9.1.1 Mazungumzo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua miktadha ya mawasiliano isiyo rasmi, b) kutumia lugha ipasavyo katika miktadha isiyo rasmi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha isiyo rasmi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kutaja miktadha ya mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi (k.v. wanapocheza, wanapozungumza na marafiki, wakiwa nyumbani, n.k),  kutambua mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo ya mazungumzo lengwa kwenye video na tarakilishi,  kutambua umuhimu wa nidhamu ya lugha katika mazingira yasiyo rasmi (k.m. kutumia lugha ya upole, heshima na kumpa mwenzake nafasi ya kuzungumza na kusikiliza kwa makini anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo),  kuigiza mazungumzo katika miktadha isiyo rasmi (k.m. akicheza na wenzake, akizungumza na wazazi, ndugu, nyanya au babu nyumbani) akiwa na wenzake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni lini tunatumia lugha isiyo rasmi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutaja miktadha ya mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza mazungumzo yaliyorekodiwa kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali ili kukuza msamiati wa lugha.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza mazungumzo katika miktadha mbalimbali  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusikiliza na kutazama mazungumzo. Maadili Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa jamii mbalimbali na kuheshimu mchango wao katika mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi. Masuala Mtambuko Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza mazungumzo yanayolenga maswala makuu ya lishe bora na mazingira. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia mazungumzo katika miktadha mbalimbali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matini ya kusoma ya aina mbalimbali na kuchagua zinazomvutia, b) kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa, c) kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua matini (k.v. vitabu, majarida, magazeti) yanayovutia maktabani na mtandaoni,  asome matini aliyochagua (yakijumuisha yale yenye mada ya afya bora) ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,  awasimulie wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,  ajadiliane na wenzake matini ambayo wamesoma. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kusoma matini mbalimbali kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposimulia na kujadiliana na wenzake matini aliyoisoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kupata matini ya kusoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji –mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kusoma kwa mapana. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza matini anayosoma pamoja na nyenzo zingine.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kujifurahisha na kupanua mawazo yake. Masuala Mtambuko Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anaposoma matini yanayojumuisha mada ya afya bora ili kufaidi ujumbe uliotumiwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia mada ya kusoma kwa mapana.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 9.3.1 Insha ya Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya maelezo katika matini, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi wa insha ya maelezo ili kujenga ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia lugha ifaayo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokieleza,  kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,  kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha (ihusiane na mada ya afya bora) na muundo wa insha ya maelezo, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1) Je, ni vitu gani vinavyoweza kutungiwa insha ya maelezo? 2) Ni mambo gani unayostahili kuzingatia unapoandika insha ya maelezo?  kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anapowasambazia wenzake insha ya maelezo aliyoiandika ili waisome na kuithamini.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo matandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuithamini.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maSwali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada ya insha inayohusu afya bora na muundo wake katika kikundi.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kufanikisha kazi yake na kusambazia wenzake mtandaoni. Masuala Mtambuko Umoja wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka maeneo mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanafunza uandishi wa insha ya maelezo.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 9.4.1 Vinyume vya Nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya kinyume cha nomino ili kukibainisha, b) kutambua vinyume vya nomino katika matini, c) kuunda sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino ipasavyo, d) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vinyume vya nomino katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vinyume vya nomino (k.v. rafiki – adui, mgeni – mwenyeji, furaha – huzuni, uhuru-utumwa, mfalme- malkia, usiku – mchana, tajiri – maskini, n.k) katika chati, kadi za maneno, kapu maneno, mti maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,  kushirikiana na wenzake kutafuta vinyume vya nomino kwa kurejelea orodha ya nomino alizopewa,  kutalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya nomino za vitu halisi anavyoweza kutambua,  kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Matumizi ya vinyume vya nomino huchangia vipi katika ukuzaji wa lugha? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake darasani kutafuta vinyume vya nomino.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino ipasavyo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa vya kidijitali kutambua vinyume vya nomino.  Uwazaji wa kina na utatuzzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapotafuta vinyume vya nomino akirejelea orodha aliyopea ipasavyo. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kifijitali na nyenzo zingine anazotumia katika kufanikisha kazi yake.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi na kuthamini maoni yao. Masuala Mtambuko Elimu ya mazingira – mwanafunzi anapotalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume anavyoweza kutambua. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English na Indigenous Languages - hushughulikia vinyume vya nomino.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.1 Kusikiliza na kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 10.1.1 Tashbihi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya tashbihi ili kuibainisha, b) kutambua tashbihi za kimo na umbo katika matini, c) kutumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo kwa usahihi katika sentensi, d) kufurahia matumizi ya tashbihi za kimo na umbo katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kuelezea maana ya tashbihi,  kutambua tashbihi za kimo na umbo (k.v. mrefu kama twiga, mfupi kama nyundo, mwembamba kama sindano, konda kama ng’onda) katika vitabu, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kurejelea picha au michoro kwenye chati au tarakilishi ili kutumia tashbihi zifaazo kutolea maelezo,  kutunga sentensi akitumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo akiwa peke yake au katika vikundi,  kukamilisha sentensi zinazolinganisha vitu viwili kwa kutumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Matumizi ya tashbihi yana umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi ya vikundi kueleza maana ya tashbihi za kimo na umbo.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukamilisha kazi ya ziada anayopewa kuhusu tashbihi za kimo na umbo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kujifunza tashbihi za kimo na umbo. Maadili  Heshima–mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake na kuelezea maana za tashbihi mbalimbali.  Uwajibikaji –mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutunga sentensi akirejelea picha na michoro kwenye tarakilishi. Masuala Mtambuko  Elimu ya mazingira - mwanafunzi anarejelea mifano ya vitu na viumbe katika mazingira yake.  Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka maeneo mbalimbali kuelezea maana ya tashbihi za umbo na kimo. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya hushughulikia mada ya tashbihi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 10.2 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali, b) kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi, c) kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa, d) kusoma matini lengwa ili kupata ujumbe, e) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama kutoka kwenye chati au kwenye tarakilishi na mitandao,  kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kuifungua na kuifunga,  kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini yanayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,  kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,  kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni,  kusoma matini kwenye tovuti salama,  kusikiliza matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,  kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari na kujibu KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unazingatia nini unaposoma matini ya kidijitali? 2. Kusoma matini ya kidijitali kuna umuhimu gani? kuimarisha maarifa yake. maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma matini.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapopata hamu ya kutafuta matini ya kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoutunza kifaa cha kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kutoa habari kwa muhtasari kuhusu matini aliyoisoma ili waiboreshe. Masuala Mtambuko  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama anaposakura matini kwenye tovuti.  Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii tofuati tofauti kufanya shughuli ya kikundi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine Masomo yote yanatakiwa kuzingatia ujuzi wa kidijitali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 10.3.1 Kuandika Insha ya Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, mtindo na muundo, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya masumulizi ili kujenga ubunifu wake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,  kuandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na uhalifu wa kawaida daftarini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kuandika insha ya masimulizi mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake insha KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi ya kikundi kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni kwa kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maSwali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadilli mada na muundo wa insha ya masimuliza na kuthamini mchango wao.  Amani – mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika kwa upendo. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya huishughulikia mada ya kuandika.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya nyakati kwenye vitenzi, b) kutambua vitenzi katika nyakati tofauti hali ya kuendelea kwenye matini, c) kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea, d) kufurahia zoezi la kutunga sentensi akiwa na wenzake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vinavyobainisha nyakati mbalimbali (uliopita, uliopo na ujao) kwenye sentensi zilizoonyeshwa kwenye chati, ubao au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. tarakilishi na projekta,  kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea katika mazungumzo, kuandika daftarini au kupiga chapa kwenye tarakilishi/ kipakatalishi,  kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kutaja sentensi katika wakati fulani na kuzibadilisha katika wakati tofauti hali ya kuendelea,  kutunga sentensi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea kwenye blogi ili wenzake waweze kuzisoma na kuzitathmini,  aandike upya sentensi katika wakati mmoja hali ya kuendelea ziwe katika nyakati tofauti hali ya kuendelea daftarini,  ajaze nafasi kwenye sentensi kwa kutumia vitenzi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni viambishi vipi hutumika kuwakilisha nyakati mbalimbali katika vitenzi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za vikundi darasani na mtandaoni.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia nyakati mbalimbali.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji –mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutunga sentensi sahihi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia kipakatalishi au tarakilishi kutunga sentensi na vilevile kuzisambaza mtandaoni. Maadili  Heshima –mwanafunzi anapojifunza kuthamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali na nyenzo zingine kufanikisha kufanikisha kazi yake. Masuala Mtambuko  Usalama mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kubainisha nyakati mbalimbali.  Kupambana na ufundishaji wa misimamo mikali – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages – masomo haya yanashughulikia mada za nyakati na hali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.1 Kusikiliza na kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 11.1.1 Kujieleza kwa ufasaha Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kusimulia tungo kwa kuzingatia mada, ubunifu na usanifu wa lugha mbele ya wenzake, b) kutumia ishara zifaazo ili kuimarisha masimulizi yake, c) kuchangamkia masimulizi katika mazingira mbalimbali. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusikilize masimulizi yanayohusiana na mada lengwa yakitolewa na mgeni mwalikwa, mwalimu, mwanafunzi mwenzake au kutokana na vifaa vya kidijitali,  kubuni simulizi linalohusiana na mada husika kwa kutazama picha, michoro au kujadiliana na wenzake,  kutoa maelezo kuhusu mada lengwa (k.v. jinsi ya kujipatia riziki, Jinsi ya kutumia mapato yake, n.k.),  kutumia ishara za mwili zifaazo k.v ishara za uso, za mikono, mabega kuimarisha masimulizi yake,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi aliyosikiliza. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nini unachozingatia unapotoa simulizi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi.  Ubunifu - mwanafunzi anapotunga simulizi linalohusiana na mada husika kwa kutazama picha au michoro.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anaposimulia kisa mbele ya wenzake. Maadili Heshima – mwanafunzi anpoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika mjadala kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi. Masuala Mtambuko  Elimu ya fedha – mwanafunzi anaposimulia kisa kuhusu ujuzi wa matumizi ya fedha na mapato.  Umasikini – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kusungumzia kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English – somo hili linashughulikia kusikiliza na kuzungumza.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 11.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha, b) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, d) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo, e) kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,  kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akiwa na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),  kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno yasiyopungua 75 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,  kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa anaposoma (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono),  kusoma hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali kutoka kwenye vitabu, vifaa vya kidijtali, nk akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kusoma kwa ufasaha kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa ● Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusoma kifungu cha hadithi. ● Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma vifungu cha hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali. ● Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotafuta hadithi mbalimbali na kuzisoma kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. ● Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti. Maadili ● Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusoma kifungu cha hadithi. ● Upendo – mwanafunzi anapowashirikisha wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani. ● Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali. Masuala Mtambuko ● Stadi za maisha – mwanafunzi anapomudu kuzitumia sauti lengwa ipasavyo, ukakamavu wake unajengeka. ● Uraia – mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake wanaposhirikiana kutamka sauti lengwa katika kikundi. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities – masomo haya pia yanashughulikia kusoma kwa ufasaha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 11.3.1 Kuandika Barua ya Kirafiki (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia muundo, b) kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, mtindo na muundo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia umuhimu wa barua katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  aandae vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,  kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake,  kuandika barua ya kirafiki daftarini yenye kuzingatia mada ya mapato kwa rafiki, ndugu, mzazi n.k. kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,  kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya barua kuhusu kupigana na umasikini, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika barua nzuri ya kirafiki? 2. Barua za kirafiki zina umuhimu gani?  kuandika barua ya kirafiki mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,  kuwasomea wenzake barua ya kirafiki aliyoandika ili waitathmini,,  kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kujadili kuhusu umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano - mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi ya kikundi kujadili mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandaa vidokezo na kuandika barua za kirafiki kwa ubunifu.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maSwali Dadisi Lililopendekezwana anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala na wenzake na kuthamini maoni yao.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika barua kuhusu kupigana na umasikini. Masuala Mtambuko  Ujuzi wa matumizi ya fedha – mwanafunzi anapoandika barua ya kirafiki kuhusu mapato yanayotokana na shughuli mbalimbali.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi an aposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali kujadili mada ya barua ya Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.1 Ukanushaji (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuubainisha, b) kutambua maneno yaliyokanushwa katika kundi la maneno, c) kutambua viambishi vya nafsi na wakati katika maneno, d) kukanusha maneno na sentensi kwa kuzingatia nafsi na wakati katika mawasiliano, e) kuchangamkia ukanushaji wa maneno katika SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya ukanushaji,  kutambua maneno yaliyokanushwa kwenye chati, ubao, kapu maneno, mti maneno na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kutambua viambishi vya nafsi na wakati katika maneno akishirikiana na wenzake,  kukanusha maneno na sentensi akizingatia nafsi na nyakati kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kuwasilisha sentensi zake darasani ili wenzake wazitathmini. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini unapokanusha maneno na sentensi kwa kuzingatia nafsi na wakati? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano- mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada kwenye vikundi.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukanusha maneno na sentensi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali –mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kukanusha maneno na sentensi za nafsi na nyakati. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za kikundi na kuthamini mchango wa wenzake.  Uadilifu - mwanafunzi anaposikiliza au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji katika vyombo vya kidijitali. Masuala Mtambuko  Utunzi na usalama wa watoto –mwanafunzi anapokuza uwezo wa kukubali au kukataa mambo mbalimbali kupitia kipindi cha ukanushaji wa nafsi.  Umasikini - mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia ukanushaji.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.2 Ukubwa wa Nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya ukubwa wa nomino ili kuubainisha, b) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi moja, c) kutambua nomino katika hali ya ukubwa, d) kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa, e) kutumia nomino katika hali ya ukubwa kwenye sentensi, f) kufurahia kutumia nomino katika hali ya ukubwa kwa usahihi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi moja (k.m mti, mto, mji) kwenye chati, ubao, mti maneno, kapu maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,  kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi; kikundi kimoja kitaje wastani wa nomino na kingine kitaje ukubwa wa nomino hiyo,  kuburura na kuambatanisha orodha ya nomino katika hali ya ukubwa na orodha nyingine ya nomino katika hali ya wastani kwenye tarakilishi,  kutunga sentensi zinazorejelea nomino lengwa katika ukubwa akiwa peke yake au kwenye vikundi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kutaja nomino katika ukubwa wake kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu ukubwa wa nomino.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya ukubwa ipasavyo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani na ukubwa. Maadili  Ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.  Haki za kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali katika kutunga sentensi zinazohusu nomino lengwa. Masuala Mtambuko  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapokuza uraia wema kwa kutangamana na wenzake kutoka maeneo tofauti tofauti.  Usalama mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua ukubwa wa nomino. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia mada ya sarufi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.3 Udogo wa nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya udogo wa nomino ili kuubainisha, b) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi moja, c) kutambua nomino katika hali ya udogo, d) kubadilisha nomino katika hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya udogo, e) kutumia nomino katika hali ya udogo kwenye sentensi, f) kufurahia kutumia nomino katika hali ya udogo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi moja (k.m mti, mto, mji) kwenye chati, ubao, mti maneno, kapu maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,  kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya udogo,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi; kikundi kimoja kitaje wastani wa nomino na kingine kitaje udogo wa nomino husika,  kuburura na kuambatanisha orodha ya nomino katika hali ya udogo na orodha nyingine ya nomino katika hali ya wastani kwenye tarakilishi,  kutunga sentensi zinazorejelea nomino lengwa katika udogo akiwa peke yake au kwenye vikundi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kutaja nomino katika udogo wake kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi ya udogo.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi zinazorejelea nomino lengwa katika hali ya wastani na udogo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani na udogo. Maadili  Ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanya kazi katika kikundi.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi kwa heshima. Masuala Mtambuko Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutunga sentensi zinzorejelea nomino lengwa katika ukubwa na udogo. Uhusiano na masomo mengine English na Indigenous Languages - masomo haya hushughulikia sarufi.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.1 Phonological Awareness (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify initials and finals in Chinese, b) differentiate the four tones in Mandarin syllables, c) appreciate the uniqueness of the Chinese language. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to : ● listen to a simple song on Mandarin initials and finals, ● sing a song on initials and finals using a familiar tune, ● listen to a recording with the four Chinese tones and repeat after it (ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ) , ● take turns saying syllables that have different Chinese tones (b, p, m, f, d, t ,n ,l ,g ,k ,h; j ,q ,x; a ,o ,e ,i ,u ,ü ao, iao), ● practice saying hello and their names with the correct tones (nǐ/nín hǎo, wǒ jiào …….. nǐ ne?.......) , ● share how saying “hello + their name” in Chinese compares with various languages with peers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is it important to articulate tones correctly in Chinese? Core Competencies to be developed: Self-efficacy: the learner exhibits self-awareness skills as they share their names with others in class. Values: Unity is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers greeting each other and saying their names in Chinese while at the same time comparing how they do the same in their own languages. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): The learner develops effective communication skills as they pronounce syllables correctly and respond to greetings appropriately. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili languages on the correct articulation of syllables.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Phonological Awareness (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recognize nouns in listening contexts, b) differentiate between the initial and final components in the Chinese language, c) appreciate the importance of articulating initials and finals in communication. d) display enthusiasm in articulating their thoughts more clearly. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to and repeat a song on nuclear family members, ● listen to short sentences on family members and match them with the pictures provided, ● repeat a tongue twister to distinguish the 4 tones (妈妈骑马。马慢，妈妈骂马), ● listen to an audio and select the correct pinyin for names of members of the family （mā, mǎ, mà, má bā bǎ bà bá), ● answer questions (那是谁) according to the pictures provided, ● take turns to introduce members of their own families to their peers, ● compare and contrast the duplication of syllable in Chinese and Kiswahili (bàba, māma， jiějie, dìdi vs. baba, mama, dada, kaka), ● discuss what they value about their family with peers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What strategies can you use to speak Chinese clearly? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and Collaboration: The learner develops communication skills as they speak clearly and effectively and take turns to introduce their nuclear family members to their peers. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Social cohesion is enhanced when a learner introduces their nuclear family members to their peers and defines the ties they have with their family members. Values: Respect is enhanced as the learner remains open-minded to the diverse opinions of their peers as they introduce their nuclear family members. Link to other subjects: The learners link their learning to Kiswahili as they compare and contrast the duplication of syllables in names of family members.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.3 Phonological Awareness (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) combine syllables to form disyllabic words in Chinese, b) construct simple sentences on various themes, c) acknowledge the importance of pronouncing words correctly when speaking. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● look at pictures of household items and combine the syllables given to form words and say them aloud, ● listen to an audio recording related to house items and rooms and repeat the vocabulary (e.g. 厨房；客厅；卧室； 桌子；厕所；椅子；床；电视；冰 箱), ● say the location of household items （椅子；桌子；床；电视；冰箱） in relation to house rooms using（在， 在...上、下), ● take turns to ask and respond to questions on location of household items (e.g 电视在哪儿？ 电视在桌子 上。), ● sing a song on household items and rooms using the correct pronunciation, ● discuss how placing household items in their appropriate places brings order in the house. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is correct pronunciation of words important? Core Competencies to be developed: Self-efficacy is exhibited as the learner identifies household items and rooms with the appropriate vocabulary. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Safety: There is awareness on home safety when the learner discusses the importance of placing household items in their appropriate places. Values: Responsibility: Responsibility is nurtured as the learner observes safety precautions when placing household items in their appropriate locations. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to Indigenous, English and Kiswahili Languages on the importance of correct pronunciation of sounds and words in communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.4 Imitative Speaking (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) repeat words precisely in listening exercises, b) respond to questions from passages , c) appreciate the importance of imitation in language acquisition. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to an audio text on sequencing of days of the week and time (星期一 至星期日, 昨天,今天,明天)and repeat, ● listen and repeat rhymes on days of the week, ● sing a song on numbers 1- 10, ● listen to audio texts on simple activities for different days of the week (e.g. 星期一到星期五： 上 学； 星期六和星期日：在家休息) and answer questions, ● research online or offline how days of the week are named in Kiswahili and Chinese (Jumamosi vs. 星期 一）and share collaboratively, ● discuss how they manage their time while undertaking activities during the week. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How does pronunciation affect communication? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and Collaboration: The learner listens keenly and actively to audio texts on days of the week and answers simple questions.  Digital Literacy: The learner connects to and uses the internet to explore the similarities and differences in how the days of the week are named in Kiswahili and Chinese. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Time management skills will be developed when the learner outlines how they manage their time during the week. Values: Unity: The learner displays team spirit when they compare and contrast how days of the week are named in Chinese and Kiswahili. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili Language on the role of imitation in enhancing language proficiency.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.5 Listening for Gist (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) mark off intended words and phrases from spoken materials, b) extract general information from given texts, c) appreciate the importance of active listening in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen to a recording and list items (蜡 烛、刀、盘子、杯子) used during their birthday, ● listen to and sing ‘the happy birthday song’ and say the words and phrases(祝、生日、快乐) related to birthday parties, ● share the various activities they like doing during birthday parties with peers e.g. (切蛋糕、送礼物、和朋友 一起玩， etc.), ● take turns in sharing when their birthday is with their peers (你生日是 几月几号？), ● answer questions related to birthday’s collaboratively e.g. 过生日的时候会 做什么？), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can one get general information from texts? ● dramatize a birthday party while bringing out the items and activities undertaken with peers. Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination: the learner exhibits artistic expression of ideas as they dramatize a birthday party as a group task. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Mental health: the learner gains an awareness that birthdays can be celebrated in various ways and still be meaningful as they share what they like doing during their birthday parties. Values: Love: the learner exhibits generosity as they gift their peers with imaginary gifts in the dramatized birthday party. Link to other subjects The learner links their learning to Creative Arts and Sports as they express themselves artistically in various ways during the birthday dramatization.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.6 Imitative Speaking (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) enumerate words cited within an auditory content. b) pronounce words, phrases, and sentences in diverse contexts with correct pace and intonation, c) appreciate the role of correct pronunciation in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● repeat the names of food items after an audio recording, (芒果；香蕉； 葡萄； 菠菜；橄榄菜； 牛肉；鸡 肉, 茶；咖啡, 米饭；饼）, ● look at pictures/drawings of food items (芒果，香蕉, 菠菜；橄榄 菜；牛肉；鸡肉, 茶；咖啡, 米饭； 饼）， and talk about when the foods are eaten (早、午，晚饭) with peers, ● respond to simple instruction in Chinese (这是什么？), ● listen to a simple text related to food items then repeat in the correct pace and intonation, ● read a tongue twister on food items (吃 葡萄 不吐 葡萄皮，不 吃 葡萄 倒 吐 葡萄皮, ● discuss the importance of different food items to one's health collaboratively. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is accurate pronunciation crucial in communication? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration: the learner listens keenly and actively to the audio recording and later repeats saying the names of different food items. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Healthy Eating: The learner appreciates the essence of having healthy-eating habits as they discuss and gain awareness of the importance of different food and drink items to one's health. Values: Responsibility: The learner demonstrates a sense of hard work by engaging and accomplishing tasks with peers. Link to other subjects: Learner link their learning to Kiswahili and English languages on the role of proper intonation and pace in facilitating effective communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.7 Listening for Gist (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) single out crucial vocabulary from auditory materials, b) respond to simple instructions in Chinese, c) appreciate the importance of listening for general information. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen and sing along to a song on parts of the body（头，肩膀，膝 盖，脚...眼睛，耳朵，嘴巴，鼻 子), ● listen to an audio and point to the respective body part mentioned, ● listen and repeat words read out by their peers related to parts of the body from a chart, ● listen to and give answers to riddles on parts of the body in Chinese (i am in the middle of the face and i help you breathe) ● mention a word related to a part of the body (吃） and have peers guess which part of the body is related to the word, ● play broken telephone game on parts of the body to develop attentive listening skills. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can one capture key points while listening to texts? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: The learner develops teamwork skills as they guess the parts of the body mentioned by their peers.  Self-efficacy: the learner identifies who they are when they point out the different parts of their body. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Self-awareness: the learner develops self-awareness skills as they learn about different parts of their bodies. Values: Respect: patience is nurtured as the learner waits for their turn to participate in the broken telephone game. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Swahili languages on the role of listening to acquire general information.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.8 Imitative Speaking (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recall targeted vocabulary from pictures in listening contexts, b) repeat words, phrases and sentences for fluency, c) appreciate the importance of imitation for mastery of pronunciation. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● look at pictures/images/cards of weather features and say what they see (太阳；云；风；雨；雪）， ● listen to an audio text on weather features and touch each weather feature image while reciting the corresponding vocabulary(e.g. 太阳；云；风；雨； 雪), ● repeat sentences on weather features in class （e.g. 这是太阳; 太阳很大；这 是云; ), ● take turns asking each other the names of the weather features (这是什么？这 是太阳。）, ● evaluate their peers’ pronunciation of words and sentences related to weather features, ● research online on extreme weather events caused by weather features. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can one communicate clearly and effectively? Core Competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: The learner speaks clearly and effectively about the weather features as they take turns to ask each other questions about weather features.  Digital literacy: Learner uses digital tools to do research on extreme weather features. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Environmental issues awareness: Learner develops awareness of environmental issues when they undertake research on extreme weather events caused by weather features. Values: Respect: The learner understands and appreciates peers’ strengths and weaknesses as they evaluate each other’s pronunciation of the weather features vocabulary. Link to other subjects: Learning is linked to Arabic, German and French languages on the importance of repetition by learners to acquire fluency and accents in the respective languages.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Listening and Speaking. SUB-STRAND: 1.9 Listening for Gist (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) point out overall information in listening material, b) provide clear instructions to others in interactions, c) exhibit interest in listening attentively in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● listen and write down vocabulary of different items found at home, ( 花 园，沙发 , 浴室 , 窗户 , 门 ), ● listen to an audio text and point to prepositions from flash cards (在，上 面，下面，旁边 ，右边 ，左边 ), ● listen to sentences and place household items in the correct places according description (e.g. 沙发在门 旁边）, ● describe the locations of different areas/ items at home as their peers visualise and draw what they hear collaboratively, ● ask their peers on the locations of different areas of their house using the acquired vocabulary, ● discuss with peers the importance of placing different items in the house in their appropriate locations for order. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you get information from oral texts? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration- the learner listens keenly and actively to peers’ descriptions of locations of different areas/ items at home and draws what they hear. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs) Effective Communication: The learner practices effective communication by listening keenly to sentences and placing household items in the correct places according to descriptions. Values: Responsibility- The learner shows respect to property as they discuss why they put different items in different locations in the house. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili languages on the vital role of attentive listening in communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Reading Aloud (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) highlight initials and finals in a text, b) articulate Chinese syllables in simple texts, c) acknowledge the importance of correct pronunciation in communication. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● read out the syllables and words combined correctly then outline various finals and initials in them, ● combine jumbled up initials, finals and tones to form correct Chinese syllables and words, ● read short passages on basic greetings and self-introduction aloud (nǐ/nín hǎo, wǒ jiào …….. nǐ ne?.......), ● take turns reading short introduction passages aloud with peers, ● practice reading out rhymes on similar words with different tones in class. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you pronounce words clearly when reading out loud? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration: the learner exhibits teamwork skills as they take turns in reading the short passages and rhymes. Values: Respect is enhanced as the learner displays patience when waiting for their turn to perform a reading task. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): The learner becomes aware of cultural differences in greetings that exist between Chinese and their own languages when they read short passages on introduction. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Swahili Language on the importance of correct pronunciation of sounds and words in communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.2 Guided Reading (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) read words and phrases with correct tones, b) determine correct vocabulary from materials, c) articulate the value of family in society. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● read out names of members of the nuclear family from a family tree,(爸 爸，妈妈，姐姐，哥哥，弟弟，妹 妹，女儿，儿子）, ● read out names of nuclear family members from flashcards with the correct tones, ● find names of members of a nuclear family from a crossword puzzle and read them out, ● indicate whether the pictures provided correspond to the words accompanying them (判断对错）, ● in groups or pairs read out rhymes on nuclear family members, ● express the importance of individual family members in the nuclear family. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do you read tones correctly to enhance communication? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration-The learners develop communication skills as they read correctly and clearly the importance of members in the nuclear family. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Social cohesion is strengthened as the learners express the importance of individual family members in the nuclear family. Values: Responsibility is enhanced as the learners diligently dedicate their time to finish the tasks assigned. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Swahili on the importance of recognition of words before reading them out.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.3 Reading Aloud (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) outline words and phrases from a reading text, b) articulate words and phrases in simple dialogues, c) appreciate the importance of correct articulation when communicating. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● look at pictures of items and rooms found in the house in groups or pairs and read out their names (e.g. 厨房； 客厅；卧室；桌子；厕所；椅子； 床；电视；冰箱), ● read through a written paragraph and underline words and phrases of items and rooms found in the house collaboratively, ● take turns to read out dialogues on the location of household items from a chart using in, on, at, above, and below (e.g. 电视在哪儿？ 电视在客厅。), ● evaluate peers’ pronunciation during reading out dialogues on the location of items in the house, ● chant a poem on the importance of placing household items in their appropriate rooms with the correct pronunciation. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why is correct articulation important when reading? ● practice reading words and sentences as the peers check on their pronunciation. Core Competencies to be developed: Problem Solving is enhanced as the learner listens to their peers' pronunciation and has to make an evaluation. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs): Effective Communication: The learner articulates words, phrases, and sentences on household rooms and items confidently with the correct pronunciation. Values: Responsibility: The learner displays patience and humility when assessing and receiving feedback on ways to improve pronunciation from peers after reading dialogues on locations of items in the house. Link to other subjects: The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili Languages on the relevance of correct pronunciation in communication.

chunks.subject: Foreign Languages
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Reading. SUB-STRAND: 2.4 Reading Aloud (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify target vocabulary and phrases in written text, b) articulate words and phrases audibly, c) acknowledge the importance of correct pronunciation in reading fluency. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to: ● read out characters on numbers from flashcards in class (e.g. 一、 二、三.......十), ● look at flashcards/ word cards on seven days of the week and read them out loud (星期一；星期二； 星期三；星期四；星期五；星期 六；星期天), ● arrange jumbled up word cards/ flash cards of days of the week in the correct sequence collaboratively and read them out loud, ● match days of the week with activities that happen on corresponding days (e.g. 星期一： 去学校；星期五：去清真寺；周 日：去教堂) and read them out in class, ● assess peers’ pronunciation while reading out loud days of the week jointly. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: What practical ways can be employed to enhance reading fluency? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration: The learner develops reading skills by clearly and correctly reading out days of the week in different contexts.
