SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  search for information on the qualities of Prophets from digital devices/books/resource persons and display in class  narrate a story of any Prophet that shows these qualities  role play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the Prophets e.g. (honesty, obedience, patience) discuss how the qualities of the Prophets learnt can be applied in school situation. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can qualities of the Prophets be applied in daily life? Why are Prophets regarded as role models? Core competences to be developed: Creativity and imagination: originality enhanced as learner role play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the Prophets Values: Integrity: accountability attained as leaners emulate and role play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the Prophets PCIs: Life Skills: responsibility enhanced as learners emulate and role play situations that demonstrate values learnt from the qualities of the Prophets Link to other subjects: CRE: Has content on prophets

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 3.2 Stories of Prophets:  Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)  Prophet Yusuf (A.S.)
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Pillars of Iman. SUB-STRAND: 3.2 Stories of Prophets:  Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.)  Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) narrate the stories of the selected prophets to build their faith, b) explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development, c) emulate the character of the prophets in day-to-day life, d) appreciate the selected prophets as role models. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen/watch the stories of the selected prophets (Ibrahim (A.S.) breaking idols, saved by Allah (S.W.T.) from fire and attempt to sacrifice Ismail, Prophet Yusuf (A.S.)-Allah (S.W.T.) saved him from the well, temptation/imprisonment, famine and leadership) using digital devices,  brainstorm on how the selected prophets demonstrated their faith in Allah (S.W.T.),  deduce lessons from the stories of the selected prophets and make short notes,  discuss the relevance of the stories of the selected prophets in the society and present on a chart. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How did the selected prophets demonstrate Iman in Allah (S.W.T.)? 2. What virtues are derived from prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) and Musa (A.S.)’s stories? Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills as enhanced as learners discuss the relevance of the stories of the selected prophets in the society and present on a chart.  Critical thinking and problem solving: Interpretation and inference skills attained as learners analyse the lessons derived from the stories of the prophets (A.S.) Values:  Integrity: Accountability achieved as learners deduce lessons from the stories of prophets A.S.)  Responsibility: Accountability attained as learners discuss and make presentations on chart PCIs: Life skills: responsibility as leaners discuss the relevance of the stories of the selected prophets in the society and present on a chart Links to other subjects: CRE- Stories of the prophets is taught (Abraham and Joseph)

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Pillars of Iman. SUB-STRAND: 3.3 Taqwa (God Consciousness) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read verses (Q. 2: 2-5, 3:133- 135) from the Qur’an/digital devices /mus’haf and list down the qualities of mutaqiin KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What actions lead to piety? 2. Why is taqwa important in the life of a Muslim? b) explain the significance of taqwa in the life of a Muslim c) demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief d) appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter.  match and sort the qualities of a pious person using flash cards  search online/from a mus’haf/resource person verses (Q.2:43: 76, 7:96, 9:119, 19:72,) on taqwaa and draw their significance  keep a weekly log/diary on activities that demonstrate taqwa Values:  Responsibility: accountability as learners demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.)  Integrity: accountability as learners maintain their fidelity to Allah by doing what is right PCIs: Life Skills: responsibility as learners find information on the significance of taqwa Links to other subjects Religious Education Subjects: they cover content on God consciousness

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Pillars of Iman. SUB-STRAND: 3.4 Tawakkul (Reliance on Allah) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building, b) discuss the significance of tawakul in the life of a Muslim, c) practise tawakul in day-to-day life, d) appreciate the virtue of tawakkul as a condition for success in this life and the Hereafter. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  brainstorm and identify the qualities of a Mutawakkil and display them on the notice board((Q.3:160, Q5:23, Q65:3) ,  sort the qualities of a Mutawakkil using a digital device/pocket board/flash cards,  discuss the significance of Tawakul in the life of a Muslim and make summary notes,  discuss ways in which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah? 2. Why is tawakkul important to Muslim? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology enhanced as learners sort and match qualities of a Mutawakkil  Learning to Learn: learners develop relationships as they as they sort and search information on qualities of a Mutawakkil Values: Responsibility: Accountability achieved as learners are engaged to practice tawakkul PCIs: Links to other subjects: Religious Education Subjects: they contain content on reliance on God

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.1 Twahara (Purity) 4.1.1 Hadath 4.1.2 Optional Ghusl (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) outline the types of Hadath for ritual purity (Twahara), b) differentiate between Hadath Asghar and Hadath SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  Identify the types of Hadath,  discuss the difference between Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar and present in tabular form,  identify items to be used in the purification of Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar and present on a chart, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why should Muslims maintain ritual purity? 2. When can a Muslims take bath? Akbar to promote personal hygiene, c) explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre-condition for Swalah, d) identify situations for performance of sunnah ghusl, e) demonstrate ways of purification of Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar to maintain ritual purity, f) Appreciate maintenance of ritual purity as a condition for Ibadah.  sort and match the types of hadath and methods of purification (wudhu, tayyamum, ghusl) using digital devices/flashcards/pocket boards/charts ,  discuss situations when tayyamum is performed,  brainstorm on situations when optional ghusl is performed and make summary notes,  demonstrate the steps of performing tayammum,  research on the situations of performance of sunnah ghusl and make notes. Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology skill realized as learners sort and match the types of hadath and methods of purification (wudhu, tayyamum, ghusl) using digital devices  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained as learners discuss the difference between Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar and present in a tabular form. Values: Responsibility: there is accountability as learners research on the situations of performance of sunnah ghusl and make notes PCIs: Health issues: Personal hygiene as learners maintain high levels of purity as required by Islam Links to other subjects: Agriculture and Nutrition: personal hygiene is covered in the learning area

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.2 Zakat: (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify the items liable for zakat payment for spiritual growth, b) describe the eight recipients of zakat as mentioned in the Qur’an, c) differentiate between zakat and sadaqa to inculcate the spirit of giving, c) appreciate the need to pay zakat and sadaqa to develop empathy. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Individually/in pairs/in groups, learners are guided to:  collect pictures of items/commodities liable for zakat and display/mount on charts,  use digital devices/ Qur’an to search for the recipients of Zakat and make notes (Q9:60),  use flashcards/pocket boards/charts to show the difference between zakat and sadaqa. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why should a Muslim pay zakat? Core competencies to be developed:  Creativity and imagination: originality enhanced as learners collect pictures of items/commodities liable for zakat and display/mount on charts  Critical thinking and problem solving: research skill enhanced as learners search for the recipients of Zakat and make notes Values:  Love: compassion as caring for the poor members of the society is inculcated  Responsibility: accountability attained when searching for recipients of zakat  Unity: cooperation attained through use flashcards/pocket boards/charts to show the difference between zakat and sadaqa in pairs or groups PCIs: Socio Economic issues: Financial literacy as they discuss zakat and sadaqa Link to other subjects: Mathematics: payment of zakat involves some calculations based on the nisab and rate.

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.3 Saum (Fasting) (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the categories of people who are exempted from obligatory fast, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Individually/in pairs/in groups, learners are guided to:  identify the categories of people exempted from fasting as mentioned in the Qur’an and list them in their note books (Q2:184- 185), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why are some people exempted from fasting? b) explain the reasons for fidya (compensation) by people exempted from fasting during the month of Ramadhan, c) describe the different ways of compensating for missed fasts, d) outline the wisdom behind the exemption of some people from fasting, e) appreciate Allah (S.W.T.)’s mercy to Muslims for exemption of fasting with valid reasons.  use digital devices/flash cards to search and match the categories of people exempted from fasting with the corresponding ways of compensation,  discuss different ways of compensating for missed fasts and make notes,  discuss the reasons why Allah (S.W.T.) exempted some people from fasting and make presentations. Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills enhanced as learners discuss the reasons why Allah (S.W.T.) exempted some people from fasting and make class presentations  Creativity and Imagination: Communication and self-expression attained as learners discuss the reasons why Allah (S.W.T.) exempted some people from fasting and make presentations Values: Responsibility: there is accountability as learners identify the categories of people exempted from fasting as mentioned in the Qur’an and list them in their note books PCIs: Life skills: effective communication attained as learners discuss the reasons why Allah (S.W.T.) exempted some people from fasting and make presentations Links to other subjects:

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.0 Devotional Acts. SUB-STRAND: 4.4Hajj (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) outline the conditions of Hajj for validity of its performance, b) describe different types of Hajj to fulfil the requirements for each, c) explain the procedure of performing each type of Hajj for it is validity, d) appreciate Hajj as a pillar of Islam. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  search for conditions of Hajj and make notes,  discuss the different types of Hajj and present on chart,  search and watch video clips on the performance of Hajj, discuss the different types of Hajj and make class presentations,  search for verses on Hajj from Qur’an and Hadith and display on charts,  create a model Kaaba and simulate the performance of Hajj. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are the prerequisites for the performance of Hajj? 2. What is the significance of Hajj? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology is attained as learners search and watch the performance of Hajj from a digital device  Creativity and Imagination: originality is enhanced as learners model the Kaaba Values: Unity: there is cooperation as the learners create a model Kaaba and simulate the performance of Hajj PCIs: Life skills: Cooperation and unity as learners create a model Kaaba and simulate the performance of Hajj

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 5.1 Virtues: 5.1.1 Work as a form Ibadah
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Values). SUB-STRAND: 5.1 Virtues: 5.1.1 Work as a form Ibadah (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam, b) explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah, c) describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings, d) differentiate between halal and haram work, e) appreciate the importance of work as a form Ibadah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss why work is considered Ibadah in Islam,  brainstorm on the benefits of work and present in class,  collect pictures of different occupations and display them in class,  search and watch video clips on different types of work and differentiate between permissible and non- permissible,  identify ethics that should guide work in Islam,  Research on Islamic teachings on work from sunnah/Hadith and present in class,  dramatize different types of works as means of earning a living. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why should a Muslim work? 2. Why is work considered an act of Ibadah? 3. What kind of work is prohibited in Islam? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital literacy heightened as leaners search watch video clips on different types of work  Learning to learn: relationships developed as learners search and watch video clips on different types of work and differentiate between permissible and non-permissible  Creativity and imagination: originality attained as learners they dramatise different types of work and collect pictures of different occupation Values: Responsibility: there is accountability as learners collect pictures of different occupations and display them in class PCIs: Socio-economic issues: Financial literacy through discussion on benefits of work. Link to other subjects: Mathematics: learners are taught on calculations on earnings Social Studies: learners are taught different types of work

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Values). SUB-STRAND: 5.1.2Adalah (Justice) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) explain the importance of adalah as a means of promoting fairness in the society. b) describe different instances where justice must be practiced to ensure fairness in the society c) practice justice and fairness in day-to-day life. d) appreciate the virtue of adalah as a way of earning rewards from Allah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner isguided to:  discuss the importance of exercising justice and make class presentation  search for verses in the Qur’an that advocate for fairness (Q. 4:135).  read a story on justice and draw lessons on fairness.  role play actions that depict justice  make and present short skits thematising adalah in society. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are the benefits of observing adalah in the society? 2. How can a pupil practice adalah in school? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology skill achieved through the search for the meaning of adalah and related verses on adalah Values: Social justice: there is equity as learners discuss the importance of exercising justice and make class presentation PCIs: Citizenship: Good governance enhanced as learners discuss the significance of upholding adalah. Link to other subjects: Social studies: covers aspects human rights and justice

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Values). SUB-STRAND: 5.2 Prohibitions in Islam (Vices) 5.2.1 Intoxicants (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify types of intoxicants rampant in the society, b) explain the effects of intoxicants on the society, c) describe ways of curbing the use of intoxicants, d) adhere to Islamic teachings on prohibition of intoxicants in day-to- day life, e) appreciate the prohibition of intoxicants for the wellbeing of the society. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss and list intoxicants rampant in the community,  research on the negative effects of intoxicants and make short notes,  search and watch age- appropriate videos on the effects of intoxicants,  Make posters on the effects of intoxicants,  story-tell/dramatize effects of intoxicants,  brainstorm on ways of curbing the use of intoxicant and make posters . KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why does Islam prohibit the use of intoxicants? 2. What are the effects of intoxicants to the society? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology is attained as learners search for videos on effects of intoxicants Values: Responsibility: there is accountability as learners restrict themselves from engaging in intoxicants PCIs: Health issues: Alcohol and substance abuse avoidance heightened as learners discuss effects of intoxicants and brainstorm on ways of curbing use. Link to other subjects: Science and technology: content on intoxicants(drug and substance abuse) is covered

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Values). SUB-STRAND: 5.2.2 Israf (extravagance) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify resources available in the community, b) explain ways of guarding against israf for effective resource management, c) explain the effects of israf in the society, d) use available resources effectively as a way of promoting economic growth, e) appreciate proper use of resources to get rewards from Allah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss resources that are often wasted e.g. food, water, moneyand presentation,  dramatize appropriate ways of using resources in accordance to Islamic teachings (e.g. serve food enough for self; not using excessive amounts of water while performing wudhu, turning off TV/, lights when not in use etc.),  make posters/signage discouraging israf and pin them at strategic places e.g (turn off taps when not in use), KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why is it important to avoid israf? 2.How can people promote good use resource?  brainstorm on the effects of israf and make presentations. Core competencies to be developed:  Critical thinking and problem solving: there is interpretation and inference as learners come up with ways to guard against wastage of resources  Creativity and Imagination: originality attained as learners make posters/signage discouraging wastage of resources Values: Responsibility: there is accountability as leaners make posters/signage discouraging israf and pin them at strategic places PCIs: Socio-economic issues: environmental education and climate change heightened as learners dramatize appropriate ways of using resources Link to other subjects: Agriculture and Nutrition: wastage of resources is covered

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 5.0 Akhlaq (Moral Values). SUB-STRAND: 5.3 Dua (Supplication when traveling) (2 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) recite the dua for travelling to seek Allah’s protection, b) recite the dua in day-to- day life while travelling, c) appreciate the importance of thedua in seeking protection from Allah. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  read the dua: “Glory to Him who has brought this (e.g. vehicle) under our control, though we were unable to control it (ourselves), and indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.” (Muslim).  note the dua in the books and memorise for usage,  role play traveling and recite the dua in class,  discuss the importance of reciting the dua when KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why is it important to recite a dua while travelling? 2. What safety precaution should one observe while travelling? travelling and make notes and class presentation,  write the dua on charts and post them on the school’s notice board. Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills developed as learners recite the dua and note it in their books  Creativity and Imagination: there is originality as learners write the dua on charts Values: Responsibility: accountability is achieved a as learners discuss the importance of reciting the dua when travelling and make notes and class presentation PCIs: Life skills: there is effective communication as learners make classroom presentations. Link to other subjects:

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 Muamalaat (Social Relations). SUB-STRAND: 6.1 Fair Treatment of Workers (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the rights of workers to promote conducive working environment, b) identify appropriate ways of treating workers for just working environment, c) cite the Hadith of Prophet (S.A.W) on fair treatment of workers, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss the rights of workers and make notes,  discuss appropriate ways of treating workers and present on charts,  role play on fair treatment of workers,  share personal experiences on how workers are treated in homes, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why should workers treated well? 2. How can we treat workers fairly? d) practice Islamic ethics while relating with workers, e) appreciate Islamic teachings on workers by treating them fairly.  brainstorm on ways of promoting fair treatment of workers,  research on the Hadith of the Prophet (S.A.W) on fair treatment of workers and make class presentations. The Prophet (S.A.W) said, “Your brothers are your responsibility. Allah has made them under your hands. So whosoever has a brother under his hand, let him give him food as he eats and dress as he dresses. Do not give them work that will overburden them and if you give them such tasks, then provide assistance. “(Bukhari). Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills developed through group discussion and presentation  Critical thinking and problem solving: researching skill attained through research on the Hadith of the Prophet (S.A.W) on fair treatment of workers and make class presentations Values:  Respect: Human dignity enhanced through respect for rights of workers  Love: caring enhanced as learners share experiences on how workers are treated at home. PCIs: Citizenship: sensitisation on rights and responsibilities done as learners learn on the rights of workers Link to other subjects: Social studies: Human rights are covered in the subject

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.sub_strand: 6.2 Relations with people of other faiths
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 Muamalaat (Social Relations). SUB-STRAND: 6.2 Relations with people of other faiths (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify the rights of non- Muslims for harmonious living, b) explain ways of promoting good relations with people of other faiths for peaceful co- existence, c) demonstrate ways of living harmoniously with people of other faiths in day-to-day life, d) appreciate living with people of other faith harmoniously. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  research on the rights of non- Muslims and make class presentation,  discuss ways of living peacefully with non-Muslims and display on a chart (Q., 2:256, 8:61, 60:8, 109:6),  role play ways of living harmoniously with people of other faiths. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How should Muslims relate with people of other faith? 2. What are the rights of people of other faith? Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills heightened through group discussion and presentation  Creativity and imagination: networking attained as they role play on ways of living peacefully with non-Muslims. Values:  Respect: there is open mindedness as learners make presentations on rights of non-Muslims  Peace: compassion developed in learners as they discuss ways of living peacefully with non-Muslims PCIs: Citizenship: Social cohesion and human rights enhanced as learners learn to co-exist with people of diverse faith Link to other subjects: Social Studies and Religious Education: teach concepts on harmonious living

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.0 Muamalaat (Social Relations). SUB-STRAND: 6.3 Corruption (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify forms of corruption to create awareness in the society, b) explain the effects of corruption to inculcate the value of integrity, c) describe ways of curbing corruption for fairness and accountability, d) promote a corruption free society by observing Islamic ethics and taqwa, e) appreciate the teachings of Islam against corruption by upholding Islamic morals. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss forms of corruption in their environment (e.g. exam cheating, inflating bus fare, withholding shopping balance, election, deceiving parents on school levies among others.) and make brief presentation,  search for Hadiths /Qur’anic verses on corruption and write the teachings. (Q. 2:11-12, 27, 30, 188),  brainstorm on the effects of corruption and display on charts,  design posters on ways of curbing corruption,  role-play acts depicting forms of corruption and ways of eradicating them. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why is corruption bad? 2. What can you do to stop corruption? 3.What are effects of corruption in our society? Core competencies to be developed:  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained through group discussion and presentation  Critical thinking and problem: researching skill developed as learners search for Hadiths /Qur’anic verses on corruption and write the teachings Citizenship as learners discuss upholding integrity  Creativity and imagination: there is networking as learners role play on forms of corruption and designing of posters Values: Integrity : Transparency and accountability as learners embrace discuss effects of corruption and ways of curbing it PCIs: Citizenship: Good governance enhanced as learners search for Hadiths /Qur’anic verses on corruption and write the teachings. Links to other subjects: Social Studies: Content on corruption is covered

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 History of Islam. SUB-STRAND: 7.1 Battles of Badr and Uhud (4 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) identify the reasons that led to the Battles of Badr and Uhud to appreciate Islamic heritage, b) narrate the events of the battles of Badr and Uhud for spiritual nourishment, c) explain the lessons learnt from the battles of Badr and Uhud to strengthen their Iman, d) apply the lessons learnt from the battles of Badr and Uhud in day to day life, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  search for reasons that led to the Battles of Badr and Uhud and make notes,  watch video clips/listen to narrations on the Battles of Badr and Uhud and draw lessons (e.g. Praying to Allah for help in times of difficulties, True victory comes from Allah (Q. 3:123-128), value of knowledge through freeing of captives, fair treatment of captives),  brainstorm on the lessons learnt from the battles of KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How relevant are lessons from the battles of Badr and Uhud in today’s society? e) appreciate reliance on Allah in overcoming challenges in day-to-day life. Badr and Uhud and do class presentations. Values:  Unity : Cooperation as the learners work in groups during brainstorming sessions  Social justice: Equity as they discuss lessons learnt from Badr and Uhud. PCIs: Citizenship: Human Rights and responsibility through lessons learnt on fair treatment of captives Links to other subjects:

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.0 History of Islam. SUB-STRAND: 7.2 Treaty of Hudaibiya (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the terms of the treaty of Hudaibiya as part of Islamic History, b) describe the lessons learnt from the Treaty of Hudaibiya as a way of nurturing peaceful conflict resolution mechanisms, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Individually/in pairs/in groups, learners are guided to:  search watch videos on treaty of Hudaibiya and write down the terms of the treaty,  brainstorm on the lessons learnt from the treaty of Hudaibiya and present in class, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why is it important to resolve conflict through peaceful means? 2. How can Muslims c) adopt peaceful conflict resolution methods in day-to- day life. c) appreciate the Treaty of Hudaibiya as a guide topeaceful coexistence.  dramatize acts depicting peaceful ways of resolving conflicts, drawing lessons from what they have learnt from the Treaty of Hudaibiya,  make posters on the terms of the treaty of Hudaibiya. apply the lessons learnt from the treaty of Hudaibiya? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology achieved as learners search and watch videos on the treaty of Hudaibiya  Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Researching skill developed as learners draw lessons from the treaty of Hudaibiya for application in life  Learner to Learn: learners develop relationships as they dramatize acts depicting peaceful ways of resolving conflicts Values: Peace: care and compassion as learners dramatize acts depicting peaceful ways of resolving conflicts PCIs: Citizenship: Social Cohesion the treaty led to peaceful co-existence Link to other subjects: Social Studies: conflict resolution mechanisms is covered

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7. History of Islam. SUB-STRAND: 7.3 Conquest of Makkah (Fath-ul Makkah) (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) describe the events that led to the conquest of Makkah for spiritual nourishment, b) explain the lessons learnt from the conquest of Makkah for peaceful co- existence, c) apply the lessons learnt from the conquest of Makkah in day-to-day life, d) Appreciate clemency as part of the Sunnah of the prophet (S.A.W.). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  listen to a story /watch a video/film/on fath-ul Makkah and make a presentation on the events,  discuss lessons learnt from the events of fath-ul Makkah and display on charts (e.g. forgiveness, purity of places of worship, love of one’s enemies as an effective daawa, Islam stands for peace),  dramatize acts depicting peaceful ways of resolving conflicts from the events of fath-ul Makkah. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What lessons do Muslims learn from the events of fath-ul Makkah? 2. Why should one forgive people who have wronged you? Core competencies to be developed:  Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology enhanced as learners search/watch videos on victory over Makkah  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills achieved through group discussion, presentation listening to narration on fath-ul Makkah  Critical thinking and problem solving: explanation skills enhanced as learners discuss lessons learnt from the conquest of Makkah and their relevance in today’s life Values:  Peace: compassion and care as learners discuss lessons learnt from the events of fath-ul Makkah  Respect: acceptance as learners discuss lessons learnt from the events of fath-ul Makkah PCIs: Citizenship : Social Cohesion attained as learners discuss lessons learnt from the events of fath-ul Makkah Link to other subjects: Social Studies: conflict resolutions mechanisms are covered in the subject

chunks.subject: Religious Education (IRE)
chunks.text: STRAND: 7. History of Islam. SUB-STRAND: 7.4Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijatul Wid’a)  Farewell Sermon (3 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub strand, the learner should be able to: a) state the teachings contained in Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)’s farewell sermon for spiritual nourishment, b) Outline key themes from the Prophet’s farewell speech as a guide to the Muslim Ummah, c) discuss the lessons Muslims learn from Prophet Muhammad’s farewell sermon as a basis for character formation, d) apply the lessons learnt from the prophet’s farewell sermon in day- to-day life, e) appreciate the Prophet’s farewell speech as a guide to Mankind. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner guided to:  read the farewell sermon, deduce the teachings and make presentations in class,  identify key themes from the speech and make notes,  brainstorm on the lessons learnt from Prophet Muhammad’s farewell sermon and make notes (e.g. sanctity of life and property, equality of human beings, Muslim brotherhood, not hurting one another, observing the pillars of Islam).  role play acts depicting the teachings of the Prophet’s farewell sermon. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. What are the main themes in Hijatul Wid’a? 2. How can Muslims apply the lessons from the farewell sermon in today’s world? Core competencies to be developed:  Citizenship: Social and civic skills heightened as learners identify key themes from the speech and make notes  Communication and collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills enhanced as learners brainstorm on the lessons learnt from Prophet Muhammad’s farewell sermon and make notes  Critical thinking and problem solving: active listening and communication skills attained as learners brainstorm on the lessons learnt from Prophet Muhammad’s farewell sermon and make notes  Creativity and Imagination: there is originality as learners role play acts depicting the lessons from the farewell sermon Values: Respect: acceptance as learners identify key themes from the speech and make notes PCIs: Citizenship: Good governance and human rights the learners identify key themes from the farewell sermon Link to other subjects: Social Studie: Human Rights is covered in the subjects Suggested Resources

KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: - Recite the surah and discuss the meaning of the selected surah during free time, PPI and clubs

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua silabi zinazotokana na sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng katika maneno, b) kutamka silabi zinazotokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi, c) kutamka vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi bora, d) kuchangamkia kukariri vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kwa silabi za sauti zinazokaribiana SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua silabi za sauti, d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng (k.v. doa/ndoa, choka/shoka, jaa/njaa, goma/ngoma) kutokana na maneno kwenye vitabu, ubaoni au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidigitali,  kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidigitali (k.v. kinasasauti),  kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusikiliza vitanzandimi vinavyoundwa kutokana na maneno yenye sauti lengwa vikikaririwa (k.v. Mkunjo ulikunjwa na waja wenye njaa kukicha),  kuunda vitanzandimi vinavyotokana na vitate husika akishirikiana na wenzake,  kuwasilisha vitanzandimi alivyounda darasani ili wenzake wamtolee maoni, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, unajua maneno gani yenye silabi za sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng? 2. Je, Unajua vitanzandimi gani vyenye silabi za sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng? kimatamshi ili kuimarisha matamshi.  kutoa maoni kuhusu vitanzandimi vya wenzake kwa upendo na heshima,  kuunda vitanzandimi kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali kwa kushirikiana na wenzake mitamboni na kuvirekebisha. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala kuhusu vitanzandimi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza sauti na kuunda vitanzandimi.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapounda vitanzandimi vyenye maana kutokana na sauti zinazokaribiana kimatamshi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kuunda vitanzandimi vyenye maana. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapounda vitanzandimi kutokama na suala lengwa. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English – somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya silabi na vitanzandimi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumika katika kifungu ili kuimarisha ufahamu, b) kueleza maana ya msamiati lengwa ili kuubainisha, c) kuonyesha ufahamu wa kifungu kwa kujibu maswali na kutoa muhtasari, d) kuchangamkia usomaji ili kuimarisha ufahamu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viungo vya mwili vya ndani (k.v. moyo, mapafu, ini, kibofu, wengu, figo, ubongo, mifupa na mishipa) kutokana na picha, chati au kwenye tarakilishi,  kueleza maana za msamiati alioutambua,  kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye kitabu au kwenye tarakilishi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kujibu maswali kutokana na kifungu husika,  kutoa muhtasari wa kifungu alichosoma,  kutunga sentensi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika kifungu, akishirikiana na wenzake,  kusoma vifungu mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa akisaidiwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unazingatia nini unaposoma kifungu cha hadithi? 2. Kusoma kuhusu viungo vya mwili vya ndani kuna umuhimu gani? na mzazi au mlezi wake, kuwasilisha kwa wenzake ujumbe alioupata katika vifungu alivyovisoma. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kutambua viungo vya mwili vya ndani. Vilevile, anapotunga sentensi akishirikiana na wenzake.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika kifungu.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni. Maadili  Heshima – anaposikiliza wenzake wakisoma kifungu na kuheshimu maoni yao katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni na kuwasilisha ujumbe uliomo kwa wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.  Usalama wa mtandaoni - mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa akisaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake. Uhusiano na masomo mengine: English – somo hili pia hushughulikia kusoma kwa ufahamu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 1.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili maudhui ya insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia mada ili kukuza ubunifu, b) kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa ubunifu ili kujenga maelezo yenye kutoa picha dhahiri, c) kuchangamkia utunzi wa insha ya wasifu ili kujenga ubunifu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusoma vielelezo vya insha ya wasifu vilivyoandikwa katika matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi huku akitambua maudhui,  kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya wasifu,  kubainisha na kujadili vidokezo vifaavyo vya mada lengwa,  kujadili maudhui ya insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea mada,  kuandika insha ya wasifu isiyopungua maneno 200 inayohusu mada lengwa (k.m: Daktari nimpendaye) kwa kuzingatia, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi (k.v. uakifishaji mwafaka na tahajia) na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali, tashbihi na nahau alizojifunza awali,  kukuza umilisi wa ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, wasifu hueleza kuhusu nini? wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,  kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili wampe maoni yao. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya wasifu.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Maadili mbalimbali kutegemea sifa za wahusika katika insha Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika Shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaj Kujiendeleza kibinafsi – mwanafunzi anapokuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waitathmini.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English – Somo hili pia hushughulikia uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.1 Vivumishi vya Sifa (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya vivumishi vya sifa ili kuvitofautisha na aina zingine za maneno, b) kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika matini mbalimbali ili kuvibainisha, c) kutumia vivumishi vya sifa kutunga sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa usahihi, d) kufurahia kutumia vivumishi vya sifa katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya vivumishi lengwa kwa kurejelea vitu au watu katika mazingira yake (k.m.: Mwalimu mzuri, njia ndefu, kijiko kichafu),  kutambua vivumishi vya sifa (k.v. – zuri, -baya, -refu, -fupi, - ekundu, hodari) katika tarakilishi, kapu la maneno au mti wa maneno akishirikiana na wenzake,,  kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika sentensi,  kutambua vivumishi vya sifa katika kifungu,  kuandika sentensi kwa usahihi akitumia vivumishi lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,  kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia vivumishi lengwa kwenye daftari au kwenye tarakilishi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni maneno gani unayotumia kuelezea sifa za watu au kitu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vya sifa.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua vivumishi vya sifa. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza wenzake wakitoa mchango wao darasani.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapofuata maelekezo ya mwalimu na wenzake darasani. Pia anapotunga sentensi kama alivyoagizwa. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji darasani.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati wa suala lengwa kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vya sifa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya vivumishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.2 Vivumishi Viashiria (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maana ya vivumishi viashiria ipasavyo ili kuvibainisha, b) kutambua vivumishi viashiria katika matini mbalimbali, c) kutumia vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa usahihi, d) kufurahia kutumia vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya vivumishi lengwa kwa kurejelea vitu vilivyo karibu naye, mbali naye na mbali kabisa (k.m: Kitabu hiki/hicho/kile),  kutambua vivumishi viashiria (k.v. huyu, huyo, yule, hivi, hivyo, vile) katika tarakilishi, kapu la maneno au mti wa maneno ili kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji,  kutambua vivumishi viashiria katika sentensi  kutambua vivumishi katika kifungu,  kuandika sentensi akitumia vivumishi lengwa kwa usahihi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kujaza mapengo kwenye sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa kutumia vivumishi lengwa,  kutunga sentensi sahihi au vifungu vya maneno katika kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni maneno gani unayoweza kutumia kuonyesha umbali wa mtu au kitu? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotambua vivumishi viashiria katika matini mbalimbali.  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi viashiria. Ujuzi wa kidijitali – anapotunga sentensi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza wenzake wakitoa mchango wao darasani.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapofuata maelekezo ya mwalimu na wenzake darasani.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko: Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati wa suala lengwa kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vya sifa Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia mada ya vivumishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 1.4.3 Vivumishi Vimilikishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kuelezea maana ya vivumishi vimilikishi ili kuvitofautisha na aina zingine za vivumishi, b) kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi katika matini mbalimbali, c) kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi katika sentensi, d) kuonea fahari matumizi ya vivumishi vimilikishi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleze maana ya vivumishi vimilikishi ili kuibainisha,  kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi (k.v –angu, - ako, -ake, -etu, -ao n.k.) katika tarakilishi, kapu la maneno au mti wa maneno,  kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi katika sentensi,  kutambua vivumishi vimilikishi katika kifungu,  kujadili maana vivumishi vimilikishi huko akitoa mifano,  kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi katika sentensi kwa kuigiza umiliki wa vitu mbalimbali,  kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vimilikishi,  kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unajua maneno yapi yanayotumika Kuonyesha kitu ni cha nani? kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vimilikishi na na kuzituma mtandaoni ili wenzake wazisome na kuzisahihisha,  kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi ili kukamilisha sentensi kwenye  daftari au katika tarakilishi kwa kuburura viwakilishi vimilikishi mwafaka Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu matumizi ya vivumishi vimilikishi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji - mwanafunzi anapojibu swali dadisi lililopendekezwa.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua vivumishi lengwa.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia vivumishi vimilikishi kwa ufasaha katika sentensi. Maadili  Heshima – wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi kwa zamu. Pia mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Uwajibikaji - mwanafunzi anapokamilisha kazi yake kwa wakati ufaao. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii– mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapotumia msamiati wa suala lengwa kutunga sentensi akitumia vivumishi vya sifa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya vivumishi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili umuhimu maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano, b) kujadili maamkuzi na maagano yanayotumika katika miktadha mbalimbali, c) kutumia aina mbalimbali za maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano, d) kuchangamkia maamkuzi na maagano katika mahusiano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadili na wenzake umuhimu wa maamkuzi na maagano,  kutambua maamkuzi mbalimbali (k.v. Waambaje? Salam Aleikum? Unaendeleaje?) na maagano mbalimbali (k.v. mchana mwema, buriani, baki salama) kutoka kwenye chati, ubao, michoro, picha au vifaa vya kidijitali,  kujadili maamkuzi na maagano yanayolengwa na matumizi yake,  kutazama watu wakiamkuana na kuagana katika vifaa vya kidijitali,  kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano lengwa na kuheshimu nafasi ya kila mmoja katika maigizo haya. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Kwa nini watu huamkuana? 2. Kuagana kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika mchakato wa ujifunzaji.  Kujiamini – anapotumia na kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano ipasavyo. Maadili  Heshima – anapoheshimu nafasi za wenzake katika maigizo.  Upendo – maamkuzi na maagano huashiria upendo.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii –mwanafunzi anapojumuika katika shughulli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapochangamkia maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano yake ya kawaida.  Usalama wa mtandaoni - mwanafunzi anapotazama watu wakiamkuana na kuagana katika vifaa vya kidijitali. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili linashughulikia maamkuzi na lugha ya adabu.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maana, tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi, b) kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake, c) kuchangamkia umuhimu wa kamusi katika kukuza msamiati na sarufi ya Kiswahili. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kushiriki katika mjadala na wenzake kuhusu jinsi ya kutumia kamusi kutambua maana, tahajia, ngeli, aina za maneno na maana za maneno hayo,  kusikiliza msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v. kambumbu, gori, hoki, Jugwe) ukisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua tahajia yake kwa kutumia kamusi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kuchagua maneno kutoka kapu maneno, mti maneno, kadi maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali na kutambua ngeli, aina na maana za maneno hayo kwa kurejelea kamusi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno mbalimbali akishirikiana na wenzake,,  kutumia mtandao kutafuta maana za maneno,  kutumia mtandao kusikiliza na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unatafutaje maana ya maneno kwenye kamusi? 2. Kwa nini tunatumia kamusi? kusoma maelezo kuhusu msamiati anaotafutia maana. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutumia kamusi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutafuta maana za maneno.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoanza kutumia kamusi kutafuta maana za maneno. Maadili  Uzalendo – hamu ya kukuza msamiati ili kuweza kutumia lugha ya Kiswahili ipasavyo kama lugha ya taifa.  Upendo – anapotumia kamusi pamoja na wenzake.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko:  Mshikamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.  Haki za watoto – mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa katika kufahamu michezo tofauti inayomhusu.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutafuta maana ya maneno. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English – kamusi hutumika katika mafunzo ya lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 2.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kubainisha vidokezo vya kutumia katika kuandika insha ya masimulizi, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia mtindo na muundo wake, kuchangamkia utunzi wa insha ya masimulizi ili kujenga ubunifu. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kubainisha na kujadili vidokezo vifaavyo vya mada lengwa,  kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi na kukuza umilisi wa mawasiliano na ushirikiano,  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 200 inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na michezo kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu. Katika kufanya hivi, atakuza ubunifu, kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya masimulizi KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi? mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini, kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kidijitali vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Maadili mbalimbali kutegea tabia za wahusika wa insha. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli za ujifunzaji pamoja na wenzake.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya masimulizi na kuisambaza mtandaoni.  Afya ya mtu binafsi – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha kuhusu suala lengwa.  Haki ya watoto – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu michezo inayomhusu. chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.1 Kusikiliza na kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 3.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vitendawili kwenye matini mbalimbali, b) kutega na kutegua vitendawili ili kujenga matamshi bora, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitendawili katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vitendawili katika chati, ubao au katika vifaa vya kidijitali (k.m. Adui mpenzi (Moto); Wanangu watatu daima wako pamoja (mafiga); kuku wangu watagia mibani (Nanasi),  kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali.  kushiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili akiwa na wenzake,  kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu vitendawili vinavyotegwa katika jamii yao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, vitendawili vina umuhimu gani katika jamii? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu majibu ya vitendawili.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kutega na kutegua vitendawili. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia vitendawili.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 3.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha, b) kusoma soma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo, d) kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo, e) kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya usomaji. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,  kutazama vielelezo vya video vinavyoonyesha usomaji fasaha wa makala (k.v. hotuba, habari,) au na wenzake,  kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa la mahusiano kati ya watu katika jamii (k.v. sahibu /rafiki/ mwandani, mpenzi, mwana, ndugu, jirani, mwenza) katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,  kusoma kifungu cha habari kwa kasi isiyopungua maneno 90 kwa dakika moja kuhusu suala lengwa,  kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),  kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unaposoma kifungu ni mambo yapi unayozingatia ili kusoma ifaavyo? mikono zinazozingatia tamaduni),  kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora. Umilisi wa Kimsingi Unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.  Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.  Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kusoma. Maadili  Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzajiwanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.  Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji.  Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.  Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora. Masuala Mtambuko  Mshikamano wa kijamii na wa kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English: somo hili pia linashughulikia stadi ya kusoma.

chunks.text: STRAND: 3.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 3.4.4 Uakifishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi, b) kutumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika maaandishi, c) kufurahia matumizi ya alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi,  kuakifisha sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,  kuakifisha kifungu kifupi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,  kuandika sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika daftari lake,  kuandika sentensi zenye alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Kwa nini alama za kuakifisha hutumiwa katika maandishi? 2. Ni alama gani za uakifishi unazoweza kuzitumia kwa usahihi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu uakifishi.  Ubunifu – wanapotunga sentensi wakitumia viakifishi.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoweza kuakifisha sentensi au vifungu ifaavyo. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akirejelea suala lengwa.  Mawasiliano faafu – mwanafunzi anapotumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English - somo hili hushughulikia uakifishi

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumz a. SUB-STRAND: 4.1.1 Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano, b) kuonyesha uelewa wa maneno ya heshima kwa kuyatumia kwa usahihi katika mawasiliano. c) kuthamini kutumia maneno ya heshima katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua maneno ya heshima (k.v. shehe, kasisi, padre, mwadhini, mheshimiwa, rais, mtawa) kwenye ubao, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,  kueleza maana ya maneno lengwa kama yanavyotumiwa katika mahusiano ya kila siku kati ya watu,  kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia maneno lengwa kwa usahihi,  kutazama maigizo ya watu wakitumia maneno ya heshima kwenye tarakilishi na video,  kuigiza mazungumzo mafupi akiwa na wenzake huku akitumia msamiati wa heshima. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni maneno yapi ya heshima unayoyajua na unayoweza kutumia kurejelea watu tofauti? 2. Kutumia maneno ya heshima kuna umuhimu gani katika jamii? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi, video na projekta kutazama maigizo mafupi.  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo na mijadala.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapoigiza ipasavyo mazungumzo akitumia msamiati wa heshima. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu. Pia anapoheshimu nafasi za wenzake katika maigizo.  Upendo – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu kwa wenzake na kwa wakubwa wake.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya heshima kuwarejelea watu maalum. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo mafupi akiwa na wenzake.  Masuala ya kiuana na jinsia – mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno yanayorejelea uana na jinsia mahususi katika mawasiliano.  Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kuejelea suala lengwa.  Kujiendeleza kibinafsi –mwanafunzi anapotambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumika katika jamii yake kutoka kwa mzazi au mlezi. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia matumizi ya lugha ya heshima katika mawasiliano.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 4.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali anaposoma, b) kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa, c) kutumia vifaa ya kidijitali kwa urahisi ili kupata matini yanayolengwa, d) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadili na wenzake kuhusu hatua za kiusalama na maadili anayofaa kuzingatia anapotafuta na kusoma matini ya kidijitali,  kujadili na wenzake kuhusu utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika usomaji,  kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo),  kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga faili,  kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,  kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kusoma matini ya kidijitali kuna manufaa gani? asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,  kusoma matini yanayojumuisha msamiati wa misimu kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,  kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni,  kusikiliza matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,  kutoa habari kwa muhtasari kuhusu matini aliyosoma na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni. Masuala mtambuko:  Usalama wa mitandaoni – mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali.  Kujiendeleza kibinafsi – mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni.  Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu misimu.  Udhibiti wa uwezo wa kutokea maafa – mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu mazingira na tabia nchi na namna yanavyoweza kusababisha maafa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine Masomo yote huzingatia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 4.3.1 Barua Rasmi. SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua barua rasmi kwa kuzingatia muundo wake, b) kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ili kuvizingatia katika uandishi, c) kuandika barua rasmi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, d) kuchangamkia umuhimu wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua barua rasmi kwenye kielelezo cha barua rasmi iliyochapishwa au kwenye tarakilishi,  kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi (k.v. anwani ya mwandishi [jina, sanduku la posta, tarehe], anwani ya mpokeaji [cheo, sanduku la posta], mtajo, mada ya barua, mwili, hitimisho, sahihi na jina la mwandishi),  kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu akiomba kujiunga na klabu shuleni (k.v. vile skauti, mazingira,kilimo na muziki), akishirikiana na wenzake darasani, kwa hati za mkono au kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia muundo wa uandishi wa barua rasmi,  kuandika barua rasmi katika daftari akiwa peke yake,  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Barua rasmi ni barua ya aina gani 2. Unazingatia nini unapoandika barua rasmi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili barua rasmi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika barua rasmi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapoandika barua kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – anapowaza kuhusu kanuni za barua rasmi na kupanga aya. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.kama kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapozingatia maoni ya ya wenzake wakati wa mijadala.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kama anavyoagizwa. Masuala mtambuko:  Mawasiliano faafu – mwanafunzi anapotumia barua rasmi kuwasiliana.  Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya barua rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anapotekeleza shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – Somo hili pia hushughulikia uandishi wa barua rasmi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 4.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 4.4. Ngeli ya YA-YA (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya YA – YA katika sentensi, b) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi, c) kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA –YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya YA- YA katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana naupatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.m. maji, maziwa, mate, marashi na maskani),  kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unajua majina gani ya vitu visivyohesabika? Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake Masuala mtambuko:  Utangmano wa kijamii –mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.  Mawasiliano faafu – mwanafunzi anapowasiliana kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo.  Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo zinazohusu suala lengwa. chunks.text: STRAND: 5.1 Kusikiliza Na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 5.1.1 Methali (Vipindi 2). SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano (kama vile; umoja ni nguvu utengano ni udhaifu, jifya moja haliinjiki chungu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, kinga na kinga ndio moto huwaka n.k.) katika chati, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kutoa mifano ya methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika jamii,  kusikiliza methali za umoja na ushirikiano zikitumiwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali,  kujadili na wenzake maana na matumizi ya methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano,  kulinganisha methali na maana yake  kukamilisha methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mazungumzo akishirikiana na wenzake, kwenye daftari au kwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kujadili methali kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu matumizi ya methali.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotumia methali kujieleza.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua methali. Masuala mtambuko:  Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa – mwanafunzi anaposhiri ktika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.  Usalama mtandaoni - mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia katika matini mbalimbali akisaidiana na mzazi au mlezi.
