chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumz a. SUB-STRAND: 6.1.1 Matamshi Bora (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kukariri au kuimba shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia, matamshi ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa na mahadhi mbalimbali ili kukuza matamshi bora, b) kueleza maana ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa yaliyotumika katika shairi, c) kutumia kwa usahihi msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi kuboresha mawasiliano, d) kuonyesha ufahamu wa ujumbe katika shairi kwa kujibu maswali kuchangamkia mahadhi mbalimbali katika ushairi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kusikiliza shairi kuhusu suala lengwa na lenye maneno yenye sauti lengwa (d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng) likikaririwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,  kukariri akishirikiana na wenzake, shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa na mahadhi mbalimbali,  kutamka maneno yaliyoundwa kutokana na sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng katika shairi,  kutambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia (k.m. jinsia, ubaguzi, mtoto wa kiume, mtoto wa kike, usawa, heshima na uwajibikaji),  kutumia msamiati uliotumika katika shairi kutunga sentensi sahihi akishirikiana na wenzake, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Kwa nini  kusakura mtandaoni, akishirikiana na wenzake, ili kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,  kujadili ujumbe katika shairi waliloliimba,  kujibu maswali yanayotokana na shairi alilosikiliza, aliloimba au kukariri,  kusoma mashairi katika vitabu na mtandaoni ili kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anasikiliza shairi lililorekodiwa likikaririwa. Pia, anaposakura mtandaoni kupata mashairi zaidi na kuyakariri.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapokariri shairi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora na mahadhi mbalimbali.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoendelea kusoma mashairi katika vitabu na mtandaoni. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii –.mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usawa wa kijinsia – mwanafunzi anapotambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni, akishirikiana na wenzake, ili kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English – somo hili hushughulikia ushairi

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili mambo ya kuzingatia katika kuchagua makala ya kusoma katika maktaba, b) kutambua makala atakayosoma katika maktaba, c) kusoma makala mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe, d) kufurahia kusoma makala mbalimbali ili kujenga ufasaha wa lugha. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza umuhimu wa kusoma kwa mapana,  kujadili mambo ya kuzingatia anapochagua matini za kusoma katika maktaba (k.v. makala yanayoambatana na umri, ukubwa wa maandishi, ujumbe anaotaka kuupata),  kuchagua makala mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa katika maktaba (makala yaliyochapishwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali),  kusoma makala ya aina mbalimbali aliyoyachagua,  kujadiliana kwa heshima na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe alioupata katika makala aliyoyasoma kutumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati uliotumika katika makala. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, kwa nini ni muhimu kuwa na mazoea ya kusoma makala au hadithi? 2. Kusoma makala kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anaposoma makala katika vifaa vya kidijitali. Kujiamini – anaposoma makala mbalimbali na kuweza kueleza ujumbe uliomo. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe ulio katika makala.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji  Usawa wa kijinsia – mwanafunzi anapochagua makala mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa katika maktaba (makala yaliyochapishwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali).  Mahusiano ya kijamii –mwanafunzi anapojadiliana kwa heshima na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe alioupata katika makala aliyoyasoma. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English – somo hili pia hushughulikia kusoma kwa mapana.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha, b) kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake, c) kufurahia uandishi wa insha za wasifu kwa kueleza sifa za mtu, kitu, mnyama au SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji kwa kutazama nakala za insha ya wasifu kwenye chapa au kwenye tarakilishi,  kutambua vipengele muhimu vya kimuundo (k.v. kichwa, mwili, hitimisho) katika uandishi wa insha ya wasifu,  kukuza umilisi wa mawasiliano na ushirikiano kwa kujadili na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali zinazoweza kutungiwa insha za KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Insha ya wasifu ina sifa gani? mahali. wasifu,  kuandika kwenye kitabu chake au kwenye tarakilishi insha ya wasifu isiyopungua maneno 200 kwa kuzingatia msamiati na ujumbe unaohusu suala lengwa. Pia azingatie ujumbe, tahajia, anwani, muundo na mtindo,  kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoiandika ili wampe maoni yao. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anaposoma nakala mbalimbali za insha ya wasifu.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi katika utungaji wa insha ya wasifu.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya wasifu.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu hoja za insha atakayoandika. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha na kuikamilisha kwa wakati. Masuala mtambuko:  Usawa wa kijinsia – mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya wasifu kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 6.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 6.4.1 Ngeli ya I-I (Vipindi 4). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I - I katika sentensi ili kuzibainisha, b) kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya I - I katika sentensi c) kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I - I katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-I katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya I-I katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I-I kutokana naupatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.v. chumvi, miwani na sukari, chai, kahawa, mirathi, asali, sharubati),  kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya I-I katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-I kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nomino zipi hupatikana katika ngeli ya I-I? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vipakatalishi anavyotumia.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzi snapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana nawenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usawa wa kijinsia - mwanafunzi anapoandika mafungu ya maneno yenye nomino za ngeli ya I-I katika umoja na wingi kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia nomino.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 7.1.1 Nahau (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika b) matini mbalimbali, c) kujadili maana ya nahau mbalimbali za kazi na ushirikiano ili kuzitofautisha, d) kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano, e) kuthamini matumizi ya nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nahau za kazi na ushirikiano (k.v. chapa kazi, kunja jamvi, changa bia, sema kwa sauti moja, fanya itifaki) katika chati, michoro, picha, vikapu maneno, mti maneno, chati, kamusi na katika vyombo vya kidijitali,  kujadili na wenzake maana za nahau za kazi na ushirikiano kwa kutoa mifano,  kuambatanisha nahau na maana yake,  kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika sentensi akiwa pekee au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,  kusakura mtandaoni ili kupata nahau zaidi za kazi na ushirikiano KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nahau zipi zinazohimiza watu kufanya mambo mbalimbali? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za nahau na kuzitumia kwa ufasaha katika mawasiliano.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu maana za nahau na matumizi yake. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi pamoja na wenzake.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko:  Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa – mwanafunzi anapotambua na kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kupata nahau zaidi za kazi na ushirikiano na maana zake na kuziandika.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba, b) kuchagua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba, c) kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa, d) kufurahia usomaji wa matini za aina mbalimbali ili kujenga utamaduni wa kusoma. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini (k.v. vitabu, magazeti, na majarida) kwenye tarakilishi au kadi za katalogi,  kuchagua matini atakayoisoma,  kusoma matini kimyakimya ili kupata ujumbe uliopo na kufaidi matumizi ya lugha,  kusimulia ujumbe kutokana na matini alizosoma kwa wenzake,  kujadiliana na wenzake matini alizosoma ili kuchochea hamu ya usomaji wa mapana miongoni mwao. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unapenda kusoma matini ya aina gani? 2. Ni vipi unavyoweza kupata matini ya kusoma? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposoma na kusimulia ujumbe aliosoma kutokna na matini za aina mbalimbali. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuzingatia maoni katika mijadala.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoazima, kutunza na kurudisha vitabu maktabani Masuala mtambuko:  Majanga na jinsi ya kuzuia – mwanafunzi anapotambue aina mbalimbali za matini (k.v. vitabu, magazeti, na majarida) kwenye tarakilishi au kadi za katalogi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  Social Studies - somo hili linapofundisha jinsi ya kuyadhibiti majanga.  English – somo hili pia hushughulikia kusoma kwa mapana.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 7.3.1 Insha za Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili maudhui ya insha ya maelezo ili kukuza ubunifu, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada, mtiririko, sarufi, muundo na mtindo ufaao, c) kuchangamkia utungaji wa insha za maelezo ili kukuza hali ya kujiamini. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vifungu vya insha za maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi (k.v. maelezo kuhusu kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, mafuriko, mitetemeko ya ardhi, mkurupuko wa magonjwa kama vile kipindupindu),  kujadili mada na vidokezo vya insha insha atakayoiandika,  kuandika insha ya maelezo isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia kategoria za maneno kama vile aina mbalimbali za viwakilishi ifaavyo ili kuuwasilisha ujumbe lengwa, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha yakiubunifu unaojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,  kutunga insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya maelezo? mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini, kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.  Kujiamini – anapofanikiwa kutunga insha ya maelezo. Maadili  Heshima - mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Umoja – mwanafunzi anapotekeleza shughuli kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia – mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. maelezo kuhusu kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, mafuriko, mitetemeko ya ardhi, mkurupuko wa magonjwa kama vile kipindupindu).  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji  Usalama mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine:  Social Studies – somo hili pia hushughulikia jinsi ya kuyadhibiti majanga.  English – somo hili pia hushughulikia uandishi wa insha

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 7.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU (Kipindi 1). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU ili kuzibainisha, b) kuandika nomino za ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi, c) kuandika sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya PA- KU-MU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya PA- KU-MU katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU kwenye kadi, mti wa maneno, tarakilishi au kapu la maneno (k.v: huku, humu, hapa, hapo, huko, humo, pale, kule, mle),  kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,,  kubadilisha sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi,  kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino ya ngeli ya PA-KU-MU akiwa peke yake au kwa kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,  kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia viambishi vya ngeli ya PA-KU- MU kwa maandishi ya mkono au kwa tarakilishi KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Nonimo katika ngeli ya PA-KU- MU ni gani? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na ngeli ya PA-KU-MU Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi kutunza vipakatalishi anavyotumia.  Uzalendo – mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia – mwanafunzi anapoaandika nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hufunza dhana ya nomino.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 8.1 Visawe (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno, b) kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano, c) kuthamini matumizi ya maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa (k.v. mwizi- luja, mkupuzi, pwagu, pwaguzi, mkwepuzi; hongo, rushwa, chai, kadhongo, mvugulio; pesa - njenje, ngwenje, fedha, hela; lengo - dhamira, nia, azma, kusudi; maskini, mlalahoi, fukara, mkata, fakiri) kwa kutumia kapu la maneno, kadi za maneno, mti wa maneno, tarakilishi, n.k.,  kueleza maana ya maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa kwa kujadiliana na wenzake,  kuambatanisha maneno zaidi ya matatu yaliyo na maana sawa katika kapu la maneno, mti wa maneno, ubao, chati, vyombo vya kidijitali, kadi za maneno n.k.,  kuhusisha visawe na vifaa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Unajua maneno gani ya Kiswahili yaliyo na maana sawa? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwnafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu visawe mwafaka.  Ujuzi wa kidigitali - mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua visawe. Maadili Sentensi zitakazorejelewa zijumuishe maadili mbalimbali k.v. umoja, uzalendo, uwajibikaji na upendo. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama – mwanafunzi anapohusisha visawe na vifaa halisi, picha, michoro kwenye chati akirejelea suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili linafunza dhana ya visawe.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 8.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili sifa za mchezo wa kuigiza ili kuzibainisha, b) kusoma mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na msamiati wa suala lengwa, c) kuonyesha ufahamu wa mchezo wa kuigiza kwa kujibu maswali na kutoa muhtasari, d) kuonea fahari nafasi ya mchezo wa kuigiza katika jamii. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kueleza maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza akishirikiana na wenzake,  kujadili na wenzake sifa za mchezo wa kuigiza (k.v. huwa na wahusika, kuna mazungumzo, maelekezo),  kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza akizingatia wahusika, maelekezo na ujumbe,  kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza (k.v. kiboko, samaki, mamba, chura, kasa),  kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu msamiati uliotumiwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Je, mchezo wa kuigiza una sifa gani? 2. Umewahi kushiriki katika mchezo gani wa kuigiza? katika mchezo wa kuigiza, kujibu maswali kutokana na mchezo aliousoma,  kutoa muhtasari wa ujumbe ulio katika mchezo wa kuigiza,  kutazama mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza shuleni au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,  kushiriki katika mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mchakato wa ujifunzaji.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapofikiri kuhusu ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza.  Kujiamini – mwanafunzi anapong’amua ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu uigizaji wa wenzake.  Umoja – wanaposhrikiana kuigiza mchezo kuhusu suala lengwa. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama – mwanafunzi anapotambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kuigiza suala lengwa na masuala mengine yanayohusiana na jamii.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anaposaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake kusakura na kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza kwenye mtandao. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia mchezo wa kuigiza.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 8.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili mtiririko wa hoja katika insha ya masimulizi, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri katika uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadili mtiririko wa hoja katika insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kujadili muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,  kuonyesha ubunifu kwa kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 200 inayosimulia tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini akizingatia nomino na vivumishi mbalimbali, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka, lugha ya kiubunifu na urefu unaotarajiwa,  kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya masimuizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni nini unachoweza kufanya ili uwe mwandishi bora wa insha? mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,  kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini na kumwelekeza Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala akiwa na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimuizi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimuizi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzikuandika Insha za wasifu zinazolenga watu ambao wanajulikana kwa uaminifu, uwajibikaji, wenye mapenzi na wazalendo. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha ya masimuizi  katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English – somo hili pia hushughulikia uandishi wa insha za masimulizi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 8.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 8.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vitenzi katika hali ya kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua katika matini, b) kutumia vitenzi katika hali za kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua ipasavyo katika sentensi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika hali ya kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vitenzi katika hali za kutendeana, kutendesha na kutendua katika chati, jedwali, kapu la maneno, mti wa maneno, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,  kunyambua vitenzi katika hali lengwa akiwa peke yake, akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutumia vitenzi katika hali lengwa kwenye sentensi,  kujaza mapengo katika jedwali la mnyambuliko we vitenzi kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, vitenzi vinaweza kubadilika vipi mwishoni ili kuleta maana mbalimbali? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –- mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali.  Kujiamini –mwanafunzi anapotoa majibu na kushiriki katika shughuli mbalimbali. Maadili  Maadili mbalimbali k.v. upendo, umoja, heshima, uzalendo n.k. kutokana na sentensi zilizotungwa. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama – mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapotumia vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali ipasavyo kuonyesha na kuendeleza mahusiaano katika jamii. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia suala la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 9.1.1 Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika mawasiliano ili kuitofautisha, b) kutumia lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi ili kufanikisha mawasiliano, c) Kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuimarisha maadili yafaayo. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua miktadha mbalimbali kunakotumiwa lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi (k.v. ofisini, hospitalini, nyumbani, sokoni),  kusikiliza mazungumzo rasmi na yasiyo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo kwenye vyombo vya kidijitali (k.v. video, rununu, runinga, tarakilishi,  kushiriki katika maigizo ya mazungumzo ya miktadha rasmi na yasiyo rasmi akishirikiana na wenzake,  kushiriki katika mazungumzo rasmi nje ya darasa k.m. akiwa kwenye gwaride, majilisini n.k na yale yasiyo rasmi kama vile uwanjani, kwenye bweni, katika safari ya kwenda nyumbani KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni wapi katika shughuli zetu za kila siku tunaitumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi? 2. Ni nini kinachofanya mazungumzo yawe rasmi au yasiyo rasmi kutoka shuleni,  kutambua nidhamu ya lugha inayozingatiwa katika mazingira rasmi (k.m lugha ya heshima na adabu anapowasiliana). Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anapokushirikiana na wenzake darasani.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapobuni na kushiriki katika mazungumzo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – unakuzwa mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza na kutazama mazungumzo. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake wakati wa kuigizaji na kushiriki katika mazungumzo. Masuala mtambuko:  Afya ya akili – mwanafunzi anapotambua miktadha tofauti ya matumizi ya lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapotumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika miktadha faafu ili kuimarisha mahusiano ya kijamii. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia mazungumzo katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia, b) kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa, c) kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,  kusoma matini alizochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,  kutoa wenzake muhtasari wa kile alichosoma kwenye matini ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,  kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambazo wamesoma kwa kuzingatia ukuzaji wa msamiati. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Ni habari zipi unazopenda kusoma kwenye matini? 2. Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini za kusoma? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposimulia na kujadiliana na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi na mtandao kupata matini za kusoma.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kuzisoma. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza matini anazosoma.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu alichosoma. Masuala mtambuko:  Afya ya akili – mwanafunzi anapotambua na kusoma matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotambua matini zinazomvutia mtandaoni na kuzisoma. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia kusoma kwa mapana.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 1.3.1 Insha za Maelezo (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada, b) kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha, mawasiliano c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wenye mapambo ya lugha. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kukuza uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo kwa kueleza  maudhui kutokana na mada ya insha ya maelezo,  kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,  kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea. Pia akizingatie anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inaojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,  kukuza umilisi wa ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni mada gani kuitathmini,  kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji  Upendo – wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi pamoja. Masuala mtambuko:  Afya ya akili – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotumia ujuzi wa kidijitali kuandika insha ya maelezo.  Katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine: English –somo hili linashughulikia mada kuandika

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 9.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 9.4.1 Vinyume vya Vivumishi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi katika matini, b) kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vinyume vya vivumishi katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi (k.v. zuri- baya, kali- butu, refu- fupi) katika chati, kadi za maneno, kapu la maneno, mti wa maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,  kutafuta vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kurejelea orodha ya vivumishi alivyopewa,  kutalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi,  kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni vivumishi vipi unavyoweza kutambua vinyume vyake? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kazi ya vikundi.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya mazingira – mwanafunzi anapotalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya vinyume.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 10.1.1 Sitiari za Tabia (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili dhana ya sitiari ili kuitofautisha na dhana zingine za lugha, b) kutambua sitiari za tabia katika matini mbalimbali ili kuzibainisha, c) kutumia sitiari za tabia kwa usahihi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano, d) kufurahia matumizi ya sitiari katika mawasiliano ya kila siku. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadili na wenzake maana ya sitiari,  kutambua sitiari za tabia (k.v. yeye ni sungura, yeye ni fisi, yeye ni kasuku, mimi ni kobe safarini) katika vitabu, matini, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutoa mifano ya sitiari za tabia akisaidiana na mwenzake,  kueleza maana ya sitiari mbalimbali,  kutumia sitiari katika sentensi . KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Ni maneno gani unayoweza kutumia kulinganisha kitu na kingine kwa njia ya moja kwa moja? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano –mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi ya vikundi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – kutokana na kutambua sitiari katika matini.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua sitiari. Maadili  Heshima – anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake.  Umoja – anaposhirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Kukabiliana na ugaidi – mwanafunzi anapotoa mifano ya stiari akirejelea suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu – mwanafunzi anaposaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi, kutunga sentensi mbalimbali akitumia sitiari za tabia na anapotambua sitiari za tabia katika matini. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia dhana ya sitiari.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi, b) kuonyesha uelewa wa hatua za kiusalama kwa kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma kutumia vyombo vya kidijitali, c) kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini zilizohifadhiwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali (k.v. kutofuta kazi za wenzake zilizohifadhiwa katika vifaa vya kidijitali) akishirikiana na wenzake,  kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo, kutowasiliana na watu usiowajua, kutofichua nywila yako kwa wenzake),  kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,  kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake  kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Unakumbuka habari gani uliyoisoma mtandaoni? 2. Ni hatua gani za kiusalama unazozingatia unapotafuta habari mtandaoni? endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,  kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni, kusimulia wenzake habari alizosoma. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – matumizi ya vifaa vya kiteknolojia katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.  Hamu ya kujifunza – mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni. Masuala mtambuko:  Usalama wa mitandaoni- mwanafunzi anapotambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni na anapotambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake.  Usalama na ulinzi – mwanafunzi anapofahamu namna anavyoweza kujizuia na ulaghai wa mtandaoni kwa kutowasiliana na watu asiowajua na kutoa habari kwa mwalimu au mzazi endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  Masomo yote kwa vile yanatakiwa kuzingatia ujuzi wa kidijitali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo, b) kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,  kujadili mada na vidokezo vya insha ili kuvitumia katika kuandika insha yake,  kuelezea maudhui atakayotumia kuandikia insha ya masimulizi,  kuandika insha ya masimulizi (k.v. kuhusu ugaidi, uhalifu, ajali, safari n.k) isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia mada, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka, lugha ya kiubunifu na urefu unaotarajiwa. Pia azingatie aina mbalimbali za maneno, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, na nyakati ili kejenga picha dhahiri ya anachokiandikia daftarini, KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Insha ya masimulizi ina sifa gani?  kuandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,  kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini na kumwelekeza. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – wakati vifaa vya kidijitali vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya mawasiliano.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masiliano.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anaposhiikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapowajibika katika matumizi ya vifa vya kidijitali. Masuala mtambuko:  Kukabiliana na ugaidi – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. kuhusu ugaidi, uhalifu)  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine:  English – somo hili hufunza uandishi kama mojawapo ya stadi za lugha.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 10.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 10.4.1 Hali ya Masharti (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti kwenye kitenzi, b) kutumia vitenzi katika hali ya masharti kwenye sentensi, c) kufurahia matumizi ya hali ya masharti katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti (nge, ngali, ki) kwenye vitenzi katika chati, ubao au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,  kutumia vitenzi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi kwa kuandika daftarini au kupiga chapa kwenye tarakilishi/kipakatalishi,  kubadilisha sentensi kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine,  kutunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti mtandaoni na kuwatumia wenzake waweze kuzisoma na kutathmini usahihi wake. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, unajua viambishi vipi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anashiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani na mtandaoni.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.  Hamu ya ujifunzaji – mwanafunzi anapoendelea kutunga sentensi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia kipakatalishi au tarakilishi kutunga sentensi na vile vile kuzisambaza mtandaoni. Maadili  Heshima – anapojifunza kuthamini maoni ya wenzake.  Upendo – anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Kukabiliana na ugaidi – mwanafunzi anapoatunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti mtandaoni na kuwatumia wenzake waweze kuzisoma na kutathmini usahihi wake. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  English – somo hili pia hushughulikia hali ya masharti.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.1 Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza. SUB-STRAND: 11.1.1 Kuzungumza na Kujieleza kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo mwanafunzi aweze: a) kubuni na kusimulia kisa mbele ya wenzake akizingatia b) mada lengwa, c) kutumia ishara zifaazo kuimarisha masimulizi yake d) kufurahia usimulizi wa visa mbalimbali kuhusu maisha SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali ambazo huweza kusimuliwa kuhusiana na mambo na hali za maisha (k.v. hadithi za  mashujaa, shughuli za sikukuu za kitaifa, usomaji wa bajeti, ulipaji wa ushuru, hekaya),  kusikiliza kisa cha kisimulizi kuhusu mada lengwa kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa, tepurekoda, video na tarakilishi ili kupata sifa za usimulizi mzuri, kusimulia kisa kuhusiana na mada fulani akizingatia mtiririko  matukio, kanuni za kisarufi, kupanda na kushuka kwa sauti, ishara za uso, viziada lugha, tasfida, na wakati ili kuufanya utungo wake uvutie,  wa mawazo, mfuatano wa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Masimulizi kuhusu ushuru yana umuhimu gani?  kuuliza na kujibu maswali kutokana na visa vilivyosimuliwa darasani. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga na kusimulia kisa kuhusu mambo mbalimbali katika jamii.  Kujiamini – anaposimama mbele ya hadhira na kusimulia kisa.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – anaposikiliza masimulizi kupitia vifaa vya kielektroniki. Maadili  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapojitahidi kusimulia.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoa masimulizi. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya kifedha – mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali ambazo huweza kusimuliwa kuhusiana na mambo na hali za maisha ikiwemo ulipaji wa ushuru.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikisha hadhira kupitia uimbaji, kupiga makofi, kucheza, kuitikia ili kuupa usimulizi wake uhai zaidi na kuteka makini ya wasikilizaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  English – somo hili pia hushughulikia suala la kutoa masimulizi.  Social Studies – somo hili pia hushughulikia kuhusu masuala ya kiuchumi na rasilimali.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.2 Kusoma. SUB-STRAND: 1 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha, b) kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, c) kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo, d) kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo, e) kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo, f) kuchangamkia kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya usomaji. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,  kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,  kusoma kifungu cha habari kwa kasi ifaayo kuhusu suala lengwa,  kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),  kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono zinazozingatia tamaduni),  kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, kusoma kwa ufasaha kuna umuhimu gani? Umilisi wa Kimsingi Unaokuzwa  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.  Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.  Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu. Maadili  Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzajiwanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.  Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji.  Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.  Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora. Masuala Mtambuko Mshikamanio wa kijamii na kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa hasa kuhusu suala lengwa. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English: somo hili pia linashughulikia stadi ya kusoma.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.3 Kuandika. SUB-STRAND: 11.3.1 Barua Rasmi (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, b) kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi, muundo na mtindo ufaaoili kuwasiliana ipasavyo, c) kuchangamkia utunzi wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua mada ya kuandikia barua rasmi,  kujadili na wenzake maudhui yafaayo kulingana na mada ya insha ya barua rasmi,  kuandika vidokezo vya kumwongoza,  kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya aya,  kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu daftarini kuomba msamaha na kuiwasilisha kila hoja katika aya yake,  kutumia sentensi inayobeba wazo kuu mwanzoni mwa kila aya  kuandika kwa hati safi au kwa kutumia tarakilishi huku akizingatia kanuni zifaazo,.  kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Uandishi wa barua rasmi huzingatia vipengele gani? 2. Unazingatia nini ili kuunda aya nzuri? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano-anaposhirikiana na wenzake.  Ubunifu – mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – anapoandika barua kwa kutumia tarakilishi. Maadili  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili maudhui ya barua rasmi.  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapozingatia maoni ya wenzake wakati wa mijadala.  Uwajibikaji – mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kuomba msamaha. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya kifedha – mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine  Social Studies – somo hili pia hushughulikia kuhusu w atu mashuhuri katika jamii  English – somo hili pia hushughulikia kuhusu uandishi wa barua rasmi.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.1 Ukanushaji wa Maneno (Vipindi 3). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi, b) kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi, c) kufurahia ukanushaji wa viambishi hali ya masharti katika sentensi. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti (nge, ngali, ki) katika vitenzi kwa kuvipigia mistari kwenye vitabu au kuvikolezea wino kwenye tarakilishi,  kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika hali kanushi (k.v. singe, singali, sipo),  kusoma sentensi zenye viambishi lengwa kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi katika hali yakinishi na kanushi,  kukanusha maneno na sentensi akizingatia hali ya masharti kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,  kutunga sentensi sahihi zenye viambishi vya hali ya masharti na kuzikanusha,  kusikiliza au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji wa hali ya masharti kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika vitenzi ni vipi? 2. Viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika ukanushaji ni vipi? Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika vikundi ili kujadili kuhusu ukanushaji.  Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo – mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukanusha maneno na sentensi.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika somo. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika wenzake.  Umoja – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenazake katika kazi ya vikundi. Masuala mtambuko:  Elimu ya kifedha – mwanafunzi anapotambu viambishi vya hali ya masharti kuhusu suala lengwa na kutunga sentensi. .  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapojifunza kukanusha kwa njia ifaayo bila kuleta mtafaruku baina yake na wenzake kwa minajili ya mahusiano mema  Usalama wa mtandaoni – mwanafunzi anaposikilizea au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji wa hali ya masharti kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili pia hushughulikia ukanushaji.

chunks.subject: Kiswahili
chunks.text: STRAND: 11.4 Sarufi. SUB-STRAND: 11.4.2 Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Vipindi 2). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: Kufikia mwisho wa mada ndogo, mwanafunzi aweze: a) kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ki- katika kundi la maneno b) kubadilisha nomino, zinazoanza kwa Ki- katika hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo, c) kutunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino zinazoanza kwa Ki- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo huku akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi, d) kufurahia kutumia nomino zinazoanza kwa Ki- kwa usahihi katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Mwanafunzi aelekezwe:  kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ki- (k.v. kiti, kitabu, kitanda) kwa kutumia kadi za maneno, mti wa maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali,  kushiriki kwenye mjadala wa kutambua viambishi vinavyotumika kudhihirisha ukubwa na udogo wa nomino,  kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo,  kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi ambapo kikundi kimoja kitataja wastani wa nomino na kingine kutaja ukubwa na udogo wa nomino hiyo, kutunga sentensi kwa KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Je, ni nomino gani zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ki- unazozijua? kutumia nomino hizo katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi. Umilisi wa kimsingi unaokuzwa:  Mawasiliano na ushirikiano – mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu mada ya ukubwa na udogo wa nomino.  Ubunifu – unadhihirika anapotunga sentensi sahihi katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo.  Ujuzi wa kidijitali – mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali wa wastani, ukubwa na udogo. Maadili  Heshima – mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.  Umoja – katika kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake. Masuala mtambuko:  Utangamano wa kijamii – mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.  Mahusiano ya kijamii – mwanafunzi anapoashiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi ambapo kikundi kimoja kitataja wastani wa nomino na kingine kutaja ukubwa na udogo wa nomino hiyo. Uhusiano na Masomo Mengine English – somo hili hushughulikia sarufi.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.1 Whole Numbers (20 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to: a) use place value and total value of digits up to millions in real life, b) use numbers up to millions in symbols in real life, c) read and write numbers up to 100,000 in words in real life, d) order numbers up to 100,000 in real life situations, e) round off numbers up to 100,000 to the nearest thousand in different situations, SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner is guided to:  work in pairs/groups or as individuals to identify place value of digits up to millions using place value apparatus.  work in pairs/groups or as individuals to read numbers up to millions in symbols from number charts/ cards.  work in pairs/groups or as individuals to read write numbers up to hundred thousand in words from number charts/ cards.  work in pairs/groups or as individuals to read numbers up to millions in symbols from number charts/ cards.  discuss in pairs/groups and form different numbers by rearranging digits of a number up to 100,000.  discuss in pairs/groups and round off numbers up to hundred thousand to the KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we read and write numbers in symbols and in words? f) apply squares of whole numbers up to 100 in different situations, g) apply square roots of perfect squares up to 10,000 in different situations h) appreciate use of whole numbers in real life situations. nearest 1,000 from number cards and share with other groups.  in pairs/groups or as individuals to multiply a given number by itself and identify the answer as the square of the number.  work out the square root of a given number and recognize the value which when multiplied by itself results in the given number.  play games involving whole number using digital devices or other resources. Core competencies to be developed: Critical thinking and problem solving; learners form different numbers by rearranging digits of a given number. Values: Unity: learners in pairs or groups harmoniously identify total value of digits up to millions using place value apparatus. PCIs: Learners in groups or pairs work cohesively and identify the square root of a given number as a value which when multiplied by itself results in the given number to enhance Social cohesion. Link to other subjects: Learners read and write numbers in words which they can use in compositions in languages Work in pairs/groups or as individuals to read numbers up to millions in symbols from number charts/ cards.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.2 Multiplication (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) multiply up to a 4-digit number by a 2-digit number in real life situations, b) estimate products by rounding off numbers being multiplied to the nearest ten in real life situations, c) make patterns involving multiplication of numbers not exceeding 1,000 in different situations, d) appreciate use of multiplication in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner is guided to:  multiply up to a 4-digit number by a 2- digit number using; - fact families - skip counting - multiplication chart - expanded form - digital devices.  estimate products using; - rounding off factors - compatibility of numbers  make patterns involving multiplication with products not exceeding 1,000 using number cards.  learners in pairs/groups or as individuals play games using digital or other resources involving multiplication. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we multiply numbers? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination; learners make patterns involving multiplication with products not exceeding 1,000 using number cards. Values: Learners multiply up to a 4-digit number by a 2-digit number using skip counting and demonstrate honesty in their results. PCIs: Learners develop confidence as they estimate products using rounding off factors which builds self-esteem. Link to other subjects: Learners estimate quantities of seeds or fertilizer required for sowing different crops as part of Agriculture and nutrition.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.3 Division (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand the learner should be able to; a) Divide up to a 4-digit number by up to a 3-digit number where the dividend is greater than the divisor in real life situations, b) Estimate quotients by rounding off the dividend and divisor to the nearest ten in real life situations, c) Perform combined operations involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division up to 3-digit number d) appreciate use of division of whole numbers in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner is guided to:  divide up to a 4-digit number by up to a 3-digit number and share the answers where the dividend is greater than the divisor using; - relationship between multiplication and division - long method.  work out quotients by rounding off the dividend and divisor to the nearest ten.  work out questions involving two, three or four operations up to 3 digit numbers.  divide whole numbers using digital devices or other resources. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Where is division used in real life? Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration; learners in pairs/groups discuss the relationship between multiplication and division. Values: PCIs: Learners divide whole numbers using digital devices or other resources as they observe safety. Link to other subjects: Learners divide quantities such as seeds or seedlings when planting crops in learning session of Agriculture and nutrition.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.4 Fractions (12 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to; a) add fractions using LCM in different situations, b) subtract fractions using LCM in different situations, c) add mixed numbers in different situations, d) subtract mixed numbers in different situations, e) identify reciprocal of proper fractions up to a 2- digit number in different situations, f) work out squares of fractions with a numerator of one digit and denominator of a 2- digit number different situations, g) express a fraction as a percentage in different SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: Learner is guided to:  identify LCM of numbers given from number cards.  add and subtract fractions using LCM by listing multiples.  add and subtract mixed fractions by converting the fractions to improper fractions.  add and subtract mixed fractions by adding and subtracting whole number and fraction parts separately.  list the inverse of numbers between 1 and 10  calculate the reciprocal by dividing the one by the number. They should always start by working out the reciprocal of whole numbers before solving the reciprocal of proper fractions up to a 2- digit number.  discuss the various reciprocals of a proper fraction.  calculate squares of fractions through KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How do we add or subtract fractions? 2. Where is percentage used in day to day life? situations, h) convert percentage to fractions in different situations, i) appreciate use of fractions in real life. multiplication / practically.  change fractions to equivalent fractions with denominator 100 through multiplication.  identify a percentage as a fraction with denominator 100  Learners in pairs/groups or as individuals to change fractions to percentages and vice versa.  Learners to play digital games involving fractions Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn; learners work out the reciprocal of whole numbers before solving the reciprocal of proper fractions. Values: Unity; learners in groups/pairs work together harmoniously and discuss the various reciprocals of a proper fraction. PCIs: Learners in groups/pairs cohesively work together to calculate squares of fractions through multiplication to enhance social cohesion. Link to other subjects: Learners use fractional parts of a canvas or drawing materials to draw different patterns in Creative Arts.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.5 Decimals (12 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify decimals up to ten thousandths in different situations, b) round off decimals up to 3 decimal places in different situations, c) convert decimals to fractions and fractions to decimals in different situations, d) convert decimals to percentages and percentages to decimals in different situations, e) add decimals up to 4-decimal places in different situations, f) subtract decimals up to 4- decimal places in different situations, g) appreciate use of decimals in SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  work out place value of decimals up to ten thousandths using place value apparatus.  relate place value of decimals up to ten thousandths to number of decimal places.  Discuss and round off decimals up to 3 decimal places.  change decimals to fractions using a square/ rectangular grid.  change fractions to decimals using a square/ rectangular grid.  add decimals up to 4-decimal places using shared place value apparatus.  subtract decimals up to 4- decimal places using  place value apparatus.  Play games involving decimals using KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Where are decimals applicable in real life? real life situations. digital devices or other resources. Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration; learners discuss and relate place value of decimals up to ten thousandths to number of decimal places. Values: Responsibility: Learners add decimals up to 4-decimal places using place value apparatus and show responsibility by taking care of the apparatus. PCIs: Learners add decimals up to 4-decimal places using place value apparatus and share answers or working strategies with one another as part of Peer education. Link to other subjects: Learners acquire new mathematical terms as they discuss and round off decimals up to 3 decimal places as part of Languages.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 1.0 Numbers. SUB-STRAND: 1.6 Inequalities (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) Form simple inequalities in one unknown involving real life situations, b) Simplify inequalities in one unknown involving real life situations, c) Solve simple inequalities in one unknown involving real life situations, d) Appreciate use of inequalities in real life situations. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss meaning of inequality symbols ‘> ‘and ‘< ‘  form inequalities in one unknown using different operations.  simplify inequalities in one unknown using cards or charts.  working out simple inequalities involving one unknown  play games involving inequalities using digital devices or other resources KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we solve simple inequalities? Core Competencies to be developed: Self-efficacy; learners in groups or pairs confidently work out simple inequalities involving one unknown. Values: Responsibility; as learners in pairs or groups use IT devices carefully to simplify inequalities. PCIs: Learners in groups or pairs work together harmoniously to form inequalities in one unknown using different to enhance Social cohesion.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.1 Length (14 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) use the millimetre (mm) as a unit of measuring length in different situations, b) establish the relationship between the millimetre and centimetre in different situations, c) convert centimetres and millimetres to millimetres in different situations, d) add centimetres and millimetres in different situations, e) subtract centimetres and millimetres in different situations, f) multiply centimetres and millimetres by whole numbers in real life situations, g) divide centimetres and SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  Discuss and identify the millimetre as a unit of measuring length using a ruler.  measure length of objects in millimetres using a ruler.  measure a given length in cm and mm to establish the relationship between mm and cm.  Convert mm to cm and cm to mm when measuring lengths of different objects and comparing results.  measure lengths of different objects in the environment.  determine lengths in mm and cm in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division and discuss the answers. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. Why do we measure distances in day to day life? 2. What do we use to measure length in real life? millimetres by whole numbers in real life situations, h) determine the circumference of a circle practically, i) identify the relationship between circumference and diameter in different situations, j) appreciate use of length in real life situations.  sketch the circumference, diameter and radius of a circle practically.  measure the circumference of a circle practically.  divide circumference by diameter to get pi (π).  Play games involving length in centimetres and millimetres using digital devices or other resources. Core Competences to be developed: Creativity and imagination; learners sketch the circumference, diameter and radius of a circle practically. Values: Unity; learners in pairs/groups work amicably to determine lengths in centimetres and millimetres in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division and discuss the answers. PCIs: Learners choose appropriate units to measure lengths of different objects in the environment to enhance Environmental education. Link to other subjects: Learners handle objects with care when measuring lengths of different objects in the school compound for play activities in Creative Arts.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.2 Area (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) work out area of triangles in square centimetres (cm2), b) work out area of combined shapes involving squares, rectangles and triangles in cm2, c) estimate the area of circles by counting squares, d) appreciate the use of cm2 in working out area in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  establish that the area of a triangle is equal to a half of the area of a rectangle or a square when the rectangle or the square is divided by a diagonal.  work out the area of triangles in cm2 using the relationship between a rectangle and a triangle (Area of a triangle is equal to ½ area of a rectangle or square. A = ½ (Lx W).  sketch a circle on a unit square grid and count the full squares to estimate the area of circles and compare answers.  prepare own combined shapes involving rectangles, squares, triangles and ask other groups/pairs to determine the area.  play games involving area using digital tools or other resources. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Where is area used in real life? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination; learners in groups or pairs work out the area of triangles in cm2 using the relationship between a rectangle and a triangle. Values: Love; learners sketch a circle on a unit square grid and count the full squares to estimate the area of circles and compare answers with one another. PCIs: Learners confidently establish that the area of a triangle is equal to a half of the area of a rectangle or a square when the rectangle or the square is divided by a diagonal to enhance self-esteem. Link to other subjects: Learners explore their environment to calculate area of different places such as play fields within the community as part of Social Studies.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.3 Capacity (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify the relationship among cubic centimetres (cm3), mililitres and litres in real life, b) convert litres to mililitres in different situations, c) convert capacity in millilitres to litres in different situations, d) appreciate use of cm3 and litres in measuring capacity in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  work out the relationship between cm3, mililitres and litres through measuring practically.  measure capacity in millilitres and litres, discuss answers and share with others.  change capacity in litres to millilitres using containers from the environment by comparing sizes of different containers.  work out conversions of capacity of millilitres to litres.  play games involving capacity using containers of different capacities. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can we measure capacity? 2. Where is capacity applicable in real life? Core Competencies to be developed: Critical thinking and problem solving; learners work out the relationship between cm3, mililitres and litres through measuring practically. Values: Peace; learners in groups or pairs work together harmoniously to measure capacity in millilitres and litres and agree on answers. PCIs: Learners change capacity in litres to millilitres using containers from the environment as part of Environmental education. Links to other subjects: Learner take accurate measurements of liquids using different containers from the immediate environment as part of Science and Technology.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurement. SUB-STRAND: 2.4 Mass (14 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify the tonne as a unit for measuring mass in real life, b) identify items measured in tonnes in real life, c) identify the relationship between the kilogram and the tonne, d) estimate mass in tonnes in different situations, e) convert kilograms to tonnes and tonnes to kilograms in real life situations, f) add tonnes and kilograms in real life situations, g) subtract tonnes and kilograms in real life situations, h) multiply tonnes and kilograms by whole SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss tonne as a unit of measuring mass  discuss items in the environment such as loaded lorries, whose mass may be measured in tonnes  establish the relationship between the kilogram and the tonne (1000kg = 1 tonne).  Estimate masses in tonnes of various objects found in the environment.  change kilograms to tonnes and tonnes to kilograms.  determine mass of items in tonnes and kilograms using different operations KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: 1. How can we measure large amounts of mass? 2. In what situations would the tonnes be more applicable to use when measuring mass? numbers in real life situations, i) divide tonnes and kilograms by whole numbers in real life situations, j) appreciate use of the kilogram and tonne in measuring mass. involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.  Use digital weighing machines to measure masses of different items. Core Competencies to be developed: Digital literacy; learners use digital weighing machines to measure masses of different items. Values: Integrity; learners honestly determine mass of items in tonnes and kilograms using different operations involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. PCIs: Learners discuss items in the environment such as loaded lorries, whose mass may be measured in tonnes to enhance Environmental education;. Link to other subjects: Learners discuss the transit trucks that carry grains in tonnes to different places as part of Agriculture and nutrition.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurements. SUB-STRAND: 2.5 Time (10 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify time in a.m. and p.m. in day to day life experiences, b) write time in a.m. and p.m. in day to day life, c) relate time in a.m. and p.m. to the 24h clock system, d) convert time from 12h to 24h and 24h to 12h system, e) interpret travel timetable in different situations, f) appreciate use of time in both 12h and 24h systems. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss time in a.m. and p.m. from digital and analogue clocks.  determine time in a.m. and p.m. from digital and analogue clocks.  equate time in a.m. and p.m.to the 24h clock system using a chart.  change time from the 12h to 24h system and 24h to 12h using a chart.  interpret travel timetables to create travel schedules for different events.  determine time durations of traveling using travel timetables within the country.  check local time using digital clock or analogue in 12h and 24 h systems. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we read and tell time? Core Competencies to be developed: Learning to learn ; learners determine time in a.m. and p.m. from digital and analogue clocks. Values: PCIs: Learners determine time durations of travelling using travel timetables within the country to enhance Citizenship. Link to other subjects: Learns record time taken to perform in different games such as athletics as part of Creative Arts.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 2.0 Measurements. SUB-STRAND: 2.6 Money (8 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) prepare simple budget in different situations, b) determine buying and selling prices of different items in the community, c) work out profit from sales of different items in the community, d) calculate loss realized from sales of different items in the community, e) identify types of taxes in different situations, f) appreciate use of money in real life situations. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  identify different shopping items in the community or at home especially food items and draw a simple budget.  discuss the meaning of buying and selling price.  determine buying and selling prices of different items in the community.  discuss the meaning of profit and loss in real life situations and share with other groups.  discuss and determine profit and loss by practicing buying and selling in the classroom model shop.  discuss income and value added tax (VAT) from receipts issued by shops and retailers as a form of tax. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How can you make profit in a business?  use IT devices or other resources to explore more on money. Core Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration; Learners discuss the meaning of profit and loss in real life situations and share with other groups. Values: Integrity; Learners honestly determine buying and selling prices of different items in their classroom model shop. PCIs: Learners discuss income and value added tax (VAT) as a form of tax as part of Financial literacy. Links to other subjects: Learners participate in making budgets for buying food at home as part of Agriculture and nutrition.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Geometry. SUB-STRAND: 3.1 Lines (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the sub- strand, the learner should be able to; a) draw parallel lines in different situations, b) bisect lines by construction, c) construct perpendicular lines in different situations, d) appreciate use of lines in daily life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  construct parallel lines using geometrical instruments and other writing materials.  bisect lines using geometrical instruments.  draw perpendicular lines using geometrical instruments.  share digital devices and other resources to draw parallel lines. KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Why do we need to draw lines? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination; Learners in groups or pairs bisect lines by construction. Values: Responsibility; Learners in pairs/groups or as individuals carefully share digital devices and other resources to draw parallel lines. PCIs: Learners exercise caution as they use geometrical instruments in construction of parallel lines as they observe safety measures. Link to other subjects: Learners construct lines that can be used in creative drawing as part of Creative Arts.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Geometry. SUB-STRAND: 3.2 Angles (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify angles on a straight line at a point in different situations, b) measure angles on a straight line at a point in different situations, c) work out sum of angles on a straight line in different situations, d) determine the sum of angles in rectangles and triangle s e) construct equilateral, right angled and isosceles triangles, f) measure the interior angles of equilateral, right angled and isosceles triangles, g) appreciate use of angles in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss angles on a straight line using concrete objects that have straight edges.  draw a line that cuts the straight line to form an angle. Measure and write the size(s) of angles formed. Compare the sizes of angles with your classmates.  work out the sizes of various angles on a straight line.  practically establish the sum of angles in a triangle and rectangles using different objects in the environment.  identify and draw equilateral, right angled and isosceles triangles using geometrical instruments.  practically establish the sum of the interior angles in a rectangle and triangle.  use geometrical instruments or digital resources to practice drawing KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: Where can you use angles in real life? Core Competencies to be developed: Self-efficacy; Learners confidently and practically establish sum of the interior angles in a rectangle and triangle. Values: Unity; Learners in groups or pairs harmoniously compare the sizes of angles with their classmates. PCIs: Learners in groups or pairs practically establish the sum of angles in a triangle and rectangles from different objects in the environment to enhance Environmental education. Link to other subjects: Learners draw lines and angles that can be used in drawing and painting in Creative Art.

chunks.subject: Mathematics
chunks.text: STRAND: 3.0 Geometry. SUB-STRAND: 3.3 3-D Objects (6 lessons). SPECIFIC LEARNING OUTCOMES: By the end of the Sub Strand, the learner should be able to; a) identify vertices, faces and edges in cuboids and cubes in different situations, b) identify faces and edges of cylinders in different situations, c) describe plane figures in 3- d objects in the environment, d) appreciate use of 3-D objects in real life. SUGGESTED LEARNING EXPERIENCES: The learner is guided to:  discuss and collect 3-D objects and safely keep them as part of their role in environmental conservation.  identify and relate cuboids and cylinders in the environment.  open up nets of cuboids, cubes and cylinders and sketch the layout.  discuss the rectangular, square and circular shapes on the nets.  manipulate 3- D objects using containers or digitally using IT devices KEY INQUIRY QUESTION: How do we use containers in daily life? Core Competencies to be developed: Creativity and imagination; Learners open up nets of cuboids, cubes and cylinders.
